But when her ex-husband and his lover get wind of this, they’re set on sabotage.

Dear Sa-chan, if only I’d had sex with you that time, perhaps I wouldn’t have wandered down this disastrous path. A story of true love and it’s downfall, brought to life by an unconventional protege. (Source: MANGA Plus)

Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he’s determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies?

The Fourth Holy Grail War has begun, and seven mages must summon heroes from history to battle each other to the death. Only one mage-and-hero pair will remain to claim the Grail and have their wishes granted! Kiritsugu Emiya was once an assassin but now fights in this war to save the world from those who would destroy it with the Grail’s power. (Source: Dark Horse)

sy: I Only Came to Find My Dad
I Just Wanted to Find My Father
Why Did You Come To My House?
entries.d: The cruel chains of destiny threaten to condemn Louise to a life of slavery. Benjamin, an evil man obsessed with her mother even after her tragic death, takes Louise into his custody, intent on marrying her. Louise tries to escape this horrid fate and awakens eight years in the past. She’s set on making things right but is unable to stop tragedy once again.

t.r: One Room, Hi Atari Futsuu, Tenshi Tsuki.
t.e: Studio Apartment, Good Lighting, Angel Included
t.n: ワンルーム、日当たり普通、天使つき。
t.u: One Room, Hi Atari Futsuu, Tenshi Tsuki.

sy: One Room, Naturally Lit, Comes With Angel
entries.d: Shintaro Tokumitsu is a high schooler living all alone, but things take an unexpected turn when a girl named Towa shows up on his balcony! Not only is she incredibly pure and sweet, but there’s something different about her—something… divine. Just who is Shintaro’s new roommate, and what adorable high jinks lie in store?! (Source: Yen Press)
On June 24, 1989, 21 people, among them children, were found poisoned to death in the elementary school of Otousu village in Hokkaido. Bungo Sano, a police officer of the same village, was arrested.

After being reborn for the umpteenth time, 7-month-old Lee Seojun finally gets the chance to fulfill his original dream of becoming a superstar actor! Using magic abilities from his past lives, baby Seojun captivates his playmates and becomes an overnight sensation with a viral mukbang video that helps fussy kids eat.

Mutsumi Oribe is a high school student who drifts ashore to an island after her plane crashes on its way to a field trip. However, the island has become a nest for giant, carnivorous insects. Can these high school students, who have now become prey to these monsters, escape the hell that is this island?! (Source: Akita Publishing)

t.n: モンスターハンター オラージュ

entries.d: The story takes place in a fictional world full of monsters and adventurers called Monster Hunters, who, as their name implies, hunts these monsters. The plot revolves around a young Monster Hunter, Shiki, whom was taken in as an apprentice to a Monster Hunter named Gurelli as a child.

A boy and a girl are forced to join hands for all eternity!? In a land ravaged by an epidemic known as "Troy", the only people with healing arts capable of stopping the seizures caused by the disease are the Sisters. Although they have a high resistance to the disease, they are searching for a person who is truly immune, so that they can find a cure.

t.r: Meizi Tai Duo, Zhihao Feisheng Le
t.u: Meizi Tai Duo, Zhihao Feisheng Le

sy: My Harem Grew So Large, I Was Forced to Ascend
entries.d: Tsundere shaman, demonic master, yandere kouhai, barefoot alchemist, and the sword-saint in white silk. Ye Gulou, the young, handsome, and most powerful cultivator on the continent, is surrounded by five beautiful ladies, all of whom are out to kill him! The only way out is to attempt ascending to immortality, but he transmigrated to another world instead, along with his five pursuers!

Kako gets tangled up when she lies about her age in order to attend a company-mixer party for singles and ends up totally infatuated with her young local policeman! And it looks like it’s mutual with Kota… until he finds out Kako’s still in high school.

Beautiful but unassuming schoolgirl Kisaragi Honey has a secret–she’s actually an android! Through her father’s amazing technology, she can transform into the unstoppable Cutie Honey. It’s a power that the nefarious criminal organization known as Panther Claw will stop at nothing to possess, even if it means destroying that which Honey loves the most. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Considered a slacker by his peers, Jaden battles teachers and students alike to make his mark in the Duel World. Can he bring his low-level dorm, Slifer Red, to the top of the deck? Or will the champions in the Obelisk Blue dorm hang onto their winning hand? (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Despite her family's protests, Aoi Sakuraba decides that she is going to marry Kaoru Hanabishi, her love of eighteen years. Once he realizes that her intentions are genuine - and that she's not just trying to get him to reconcile with his estranged (and domineering) family - he begins to definitely warm up to the idea, too. What obstacles must the two overcome in order to be together?

After touring America in an attempt to start a new life, Hui-Su boards a plane back to her homeland of Korea. She soon realizes that it is not so easy to escape her unfortunate destiny when the plane spirals out of control and she is warped to a strange world that is distant from Earth and full of zombie-like creatures called “maenok.” Luckily enough, she is unintentionally rescued from a dire sit…

This is not your typical invasion story. Gigantic oxygen-doped bees are attempting to dominate the human race by reversing the food chain. Lee is a middle-manager at a large company who has only one thing on his mind: save his family from the bug-apocalypse. (Source: WEBTOONS)

Sensing shifts in mana, successfully manifesting it, and attending the most prestigious school at the top of his class at a young age, Ruin Ardell is on track to become a great mage. Everything was going smoothly until he discovered that he had a condition preventing him from expelling mana. Ruin’s tumble from grace gave those jealous of him the opportunity to toy with him.

Nanase, a polite, a little old-fashioned girl, got a boyfriend for the first time. He, a pure and kind guy, is a good friend of her brother. However, both of them have no idea what they should do next... For Nanase, holding hand would be too embarrassing, and 'date' is something mature people would do.

After Jonathan's Death, his son, George Joestar II travels with Erina to live in La Palma of the Canary Islands in Spain. There he pledges his love to Lisa Lisa and eventually grows to be a World war Air Pilot.

Poor Mugi Tadano . . . The sixteen-year-old is heartbroken after his girlfriend moves away. To ease his troubled state, Mugi takes a summer job at his friend Kazuki's beachside snack bar/hotel on a tropical island. It seems like the perfect plan-until Kazuki sets Mugi up on a date with Yuu, who's supposed to be, well, a little less than perfect.

t.r: Seirei-tachi no Rakuen to Risou no Isekai Seikatsu
t.n: 精霊達の楽園と理想の異世界生活
t.u: Seirei-tachi no Rakuen to Risou no Isekai Seikatsu

entries.d: It's the Golden Week, and Yuuta Morizono (Age 25) can't wait to spend the next 11 days staying home and conquering all of his games and manga. After a trip to the supermarket to stock up on food however, he found himself stranded in a wasteland with no sight of human - how is he going to survive with just the food he just bought?

t.n: 世界最速のレベルアップ

entries.d: Years have passed since dungeons popped up all around the world. When dedicated adventurer Amane Rin awakens to a unique skill called Dungeon Teleporting, he finds he no longer needs to abide by the rules of dungeon diving like everyone else. Follow Rin’s journey to become the strongest adventurer in the world—at the fastest speed possible! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

t.n: ゆき姉ちゃんの官能ごっこ。

entries.d: First year Highschool boy Shin Yuki stumbles one day upon his naked childhood friend reenacting a sensual novel with an mannequin in an empty classroom. Yukino Kurose, a third year student, loved to reeanact stories with Yuki's help from books when she was a child, to discover how the characters in the story felt.

t.n: 小百合さんの妹は天使

sy: An angel who had swooped down was my little sister.
Sayuri's Little Sister Is An Angel
entries.d: Sayuri-san no Imouto wa Tenshi follows the story of the Kobayashi siblings, Sayuri and her little sister Makoto. Due to a divorce they were seperated 13 years prior to the beginning of the story. One day Makoto suddenly appears near Sayuri's workplace, a flower shop, with wings on her back and a halo above her head.

Hiroshi Mori is an ordinary college student leading an unremarkable life, until one day he hears someone ringing his neighbor's doorbell over and over again. He goes out onto the landing and finds a strange woman in a trenchcoat―whose tenacious attention soon transfers to him.

The year is 203X, and Earth is under attack. The enemy? Extraterrestrials. Park Hyunsung, a militia commander, valiantly lays down his life to take down the enemy base. One moment, he’s caught up in a malfunctioning teleportation device; the next… he’s in the body of Ian Alberon, a 15-year-old lord!

t.r: Aoi Uroko to Suna no Machi
t.e: Mermaid Scales and the Town of Sand
t.u: Aoi Uroko to Suna no Machi

sy: A Blue Fish Scale and the Town of Sand
El pueblo de arena y escamas azules
W miasteczku piasku i błękitnych łusek
entries.d: After her normal, happy life shatters, Tokiko and her father move to a small seaside town to live with her grandmother as sixth grade starts. There, the sound of the waves brings back a distant memory from when she visited seven years ago, a memory of almost drowning in the sea and being saved by a merman. Are there really mermaids in that sea?

t.r: In Bura!: Bishoujo Kyuuketsuki no Hazukashii Himitsu
t.n: いんブラ!~美少女吸血鬼の恥ずかしい秘密~
t.u: In Bura!: Bishoujo Kyuuketsuki no Hazukashii Himitsu

entries.d: After an accident our protagonist Amagami Kouichi becomes involved with Itanami-san a well known beauty of his school and secretly a vampire.

Ma-Ru Kang was just an ordinary kid with ordinary interests, until one day his father forces him to watch a soccer game on TV, sparking an obsession with the sport. Filled with determination, he sets a new goal for himself -- to become an amazing soccer player! The only problem is, he has already been proclaimed the “King of the Losers” at his high school.

Koizumi Yuta is a 14 year old boy who has quite a bit of a problem. The princess of the magical world, Lucia, has to procreate with him. That child would have the ability to engulf the entire world for 7 whole days. Mikamoto El and Kasukabe Rie are the two angels assigned to make sure that doesn't happen. Kasukabe Rie happens to be the girl he likes. Just how is he going to survive this ordeal?

I've become a big, hairy beast! After getting into a car accident, Hanbyul wakes up in the body of a princess. But something's wrong; she's doubled in size, grown hair everywhere, and seems to terrify everyone who looks her way — she's become a beast! How will she live on as the cursed Princess Alexa? (Source: Manta)

t.n: 君の横顔しか見れない

sy: I Can Only See Your Side Profile
entries.d: The popular Fujimori Sachi never faces Kishimoto Arata, who sits next to her in class. No matter how hard Kishimoto tries to see her face, she brilliantly turns away from him. As a result, he has only ever seen her side profile. But she talks to him normally otherwise. This mysterious girl seems to have a secret...?

Konohoshi Umika is a high-schooler who is very bad at communicating with others. Feeling almost like an alien trapped on Earth with nowhere to belong, one day she meets a girl who claims to be an actual alien! Note: Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2021 Award in the Print Manga Category.

t.r: Sen no Skill wo Motsu Otoko: Isekai de Shoukanjuu Hajimemashita!
t.e: A Man with A Thousand Skills 1000
t.n: 千のスキルを持つ男 異世界で召喚獣はじめました!
t.u: Sen no Skill wo Motsu Otoko: Isekai de Shoukanjuu Hajimemashita!

entries.d: Hinoharu Kota is newly married but his wife is never home. Bored, Kota imagines being on a relaxing ski trip to clear his mind. In his "dream" everything goes sideways. Still dreaming, Kota walks through a couple of doorways to shockingly find himself springing into action to save a female knight from a giant spider.

t.r: Hoshi to Kuzu: Don't Worry, Be Happy!
t.u: Hoshi to Kuzu: Don't Worry, Be Happy!

entries.d: Anzu is poor but very ambitious and aims for a bright future. Her first step is to be student council president but that chance is destroyed by the equally ambitious and egocentric Yamabuki. She just has to settle for being the vice-president.

Being an adolescent girl is just one problem after another. Middle-schooler Arihara Ayumi receives a note from a high-schooler, a very large and intimidating boy, Zaitsu Misao, asking her out. Frightened and intrigued, she doesn't know what to do!

Through a strange series of events, a young man named Yakumo Fuuji becomes the immortal slave of the last of a race of 3 Eyed immortals. The immortal, Pai, absorbs his soul to save his life, making him immortal in the process. Now, he begins a journey with the female immortal in an attempt to find a way of becoming human.

A Catholic school where everything seems tranquil and fine. But for Ayeon, a day doesn't pass without getting bullied until one day, Yeonhwa steps in against the bullies. Ayeon is grateful for Yeonhwa but what she doesn't realize is that there seems to be something more than just good intentions behind that beautiful smile. (Source: Lezhin US)

t.n: ギャンブルフィッシュ

entries.d: The story is set at Shishidou, a school attended by rich and elite people. Tom Shirasagi, a gambler, is a mysterious new transfer student who has come from a public school (instead of a prestigious private one) and faces the elitist environment. There, he declares a challenge toward any student and claims he will bring to the ruin the whole school through a series of gambling matches.

Hatori is an ordinary teacher leading an ordinary life at an ordinary high school. One day, he notices that one of his students, Spica Tsumugi, is being bullied. On his way home from school, he ends up alone with Tsumugi in the rain.

Meet Mimi, a college grad working part-time at a convenience store. Once an aspiring idol, she abandoned her dream when her group failed to make it big. Enter Ibuki, a rising star inspired by Mimi’s past. Their unexpected encounters reignite Mimi’s passion for the spotlight. Together, they decide to audition for a high-stakes idol competition show.

sy: Arata & Shinju – Bis dass der Tod sie scheidet
entries.d: Arata Natsume works at a child guidance center, is in his thirties and single with no plans for marriage. But one day, he receives a request from the child he was in charge of, Takuto, to "meet the criminal who killed his father". That serial killer is Shinagawa Shinju, also known as the "Shinagawa Pierrot". Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Manga Category.

t.r: Shingeki no Kyojin Gaiden: Kuinaki Sentaku - Prologue
t.e: Attack on Titan: No Regrets - Prologue
t.n: 進撃の巨人 外伝 悔いなき選択 -プロローグ-
t.u: Shingeki no Kyojin Gaiden: Kuinaki Sentaku - Prologue

entries.d: Prologue chapter that was included only in separate booklet sold together with limited special edition of volume 1.

Money can’t buy her love, but it can help her get sweet, sweet revenge. Take a seat at Lady Ilya Bloden’s table and watch Ilya charm her way out of a loveless engagement, help the “Bloodthirsty Butcher of the Battlefield’' find the courage to speak to the manager, and single-handedly destroy one of the most influential families in the Ishtar Empire. Tea and crumpets will be served! (Source: Tapas)

Under the table is the angel's secret. The boy's name was Hitori. A stork brought the angel into the lives of a middle-aged couple who were not blessed with children. His parents were kind, his house spacious, and his meals hot. But to protect the happiness he had received, Hitori continued to hide an important secret from his parents...

t.r: Tonari no Kuuderella wo Amayakashitara, Uchi no Aikagi wo Watasu Koto ni Natta
t.n: 隣のクーデレラを甘やかしたら、ウチの合鍵を渡すことになった
t.u: Tonari no Kuuderella wo Amayakashitara, Uchi no Aikagi wo Watasu Koto ni Natta

entries.d: Katagiri Natsuomi, a high school student living alone for two years, has a beautiful black-haired, blue-eyed girl move into the next room. The girl, Yui, is actual nobility, and her nickname is “Cool-de-rella” because of her indifferent attitude at school. When Natsuomi finds out that Yui doesn’t want to rely on others, but is actually quite naive, he decides to help her out.

Kasane Shibata, a graphic designer at a toy development company, was feeling troubled. It began when she accidentally touched the buttocks of her colleague, Subaru Enokida. Kasane was intrigued, as Enokida's butt felt like the costume of her favorite character. But at the same time, she couldn't shake the feeling that she might have made Enokida felt uncomfortable.

Bookworm - Soo-Hyuk. Reading fun number one, always looking for a new way to read books. Even joined new game so no one could disturb him from reading books. The moment Soo-Hyuk finished reading his first book and closed it, he received notification: Wisdom +1 level...
The direct sequel to Blue Giant, a manga about the evolution of the young saxophonist Dai Miyamoto in the jazz world. Blue Giant Supreme sees the hero arrive in Europe!

t.r: Watashitachi ni wa Kabe ga Aru.
t.u: Watashitachi ni wa Kabe ga Aru.

entries.d: "If you want a boyfriend that bad, I'll go out with you." Growing up next-door neighbors, Reita Kikuchi and Makoto Sakurai's parents are friends, and the two of them have known each other forever. But one day Makoto is suddenly thrown into a relationship with that narcissistic and self-absorbed playboy, Reita—her old childhood friend!

sy: Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie
entries.d: A special one-shot connected to the 9th Naruto movie, "Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie."

Growing up in their single-parent household, Kanna knows that her mom and big sister Yayoi always do their best to make sure she has the best life has to offer. So when said big sister asks Kanna to help out with work, she can't help but say yes - but will Kanna ever be ready to lend her voice to the kind of video games Yayoi has been making? (Source: Manga Planet)

This is the first version of "Romance Dawn", which one might call a One Piece prototype. Notes: - It's 50 pages in length and was first published as a one-shot in the Shōnen Jump 1996 Summer Special (an issue dedicated to the work of up-and-coming artists) on August 4th.

t.n: 焼きたて!! ジャぱん

sy: Yakitate Ja-pan!! Un pain c'est tout
entries.d: Azuma Kazuma isn't terribly clever, but he's got a good heart and great skill - at baking. Since childhood, he's been on a quest to create the perfect bread to represent Japan internationally. Now, he seeks to enter the famous bakery Pantasia, in hopes of reaching his goal. But plots abound... (Source: Anime News Network)

From the author of Double Arts here comes another interesting creation. Ichijou Raku is an honor student with outstanding grades and an admirable conduct. He has a female childhood friend named Kirisaki Chitoge who has slightly better grades than him, or so he says.

Chansol never experienced friendship before he met Park Hanhoo, a troubled boy who terrifies school gangs and hides his face with an unruly haircut. But when a horrific event turns Chansol's world upside down, he is forced into hiding and reneges on his promise to stay by Hanhoo's side.

t.r: Touhou Ibarakasen: Wild and Horned Hermit
t.n: 東方茨歌仙 ～ Wild and Horned Hermit
t.u: Touhou Ibarakasen: Wild and Horned Hermit

entries.d: Continuing in the Touhou series, this one follows the footsteps of Silent Sinner in Blue, Inaba of the Moon & Inaba of the Earth, and the Sangetsusei trilogy. This time, Marisa comes across a mysterious hermit outside the Human Village. However, as she tells Reimu about her, the hermit is seen sneaking around the Hakurei Shrine.

A group of students finds themselves on a sinking capsized ship. Together with some zombies. What happened to the ship and why are there zombies aboard? It's a battle against time and the zombies, to save themselves.

t.n: ゴーストフィクサーズ

entries.d: Following a certain event, Mikurigaoka New Town transformed into a crucible of supernatural phenomena known as GHOSTS! In said town lives Hifumi, a middle school boy, who one day encounters a girl who just moved in... Help "correct" the supernatural in this action-packed tale from Yasuki Tanaka, creator of Summer Time Rendering! (Source: MANGA Plus)

"Only do good deeds."—Asura follows his late mother's teachings and always strives to do good in life. No matter how much he is bullied, he goes on with a smile, firmly believing that evildoers will receive divine punishment. Until one day, an ominous old man offers him a key that can open the doors to hell... (Source: MANGA Plus)

t.r: Tanaka: Nenrei Equal Kanojo Inaireki no Mahoutsukai - The Comic
t.n: 田中～年齢イコール彼女いない歴の魔法使い～ THE COMIC
t.u: Tanaka: Nenrei Equal Kanojo Inaireki no Mahoutsukai - The Comic

entries.d: Tanaka, a middle-aged man, is reincarnated into a fantasy game world with healing magic as a "cheat" ability. Despite all his requests to be reborn as a handsome man, his adventure begins with an unchanged and unattractive appearance. Treated as a suspicious person and imprisoned by the town's gatekeeper, all the girls he meets end up giving him a cold shoulder….

t.r: Go-toubun no Hanayome: 122 + 1 - Itsutsugo-chan wa Himitsu wo Gotoubun Dekinai
t.n: 五等分の花嫁 122＋1話『五つ子ちゃんは秘密を五等分できない』
t.u: Go-toubun no Hanayome: 122 + 1 - Itsutsugo-chan wa Himitsu wo Gotoubun Dekinai

t.e: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
t.n: どうせ、恋してしまうんだ。

sy: Vou Me Apaixonar por Você Mesmo Assim
entries.d: Mizuha's 17th birthday is the pits. Her parents totally forgot, and the senpai she likes isn't interested in her. But when her longtime childhood friend asks her out, Mizuha has to sort out what this change in relationship could mean. And her feelings may not be the only ones changing...! (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The acclaimed financial reporter Sylvie Jaine is cheated on? No way she'd sit back and watch that scumbag and his sweet-faced side piece ride off into the sunset! But when she sees that mistress's uncle's luxurious Rolls-Royce, she has an idea: she'll go after the CEO herself! So this bastard wants to take a shortcut to success? No problem. Watch her become their aunt-in-law instead!

No one would have ever guessed that nerdy-looking Seongbin Cha is actually Neon Mask, the internet hero popular for punishing violent, bullying teens on ViewTube. He won’t rest until he eradicates every last delinquent in the country. Can he stomp them all out with the help of his bodyguards, or will they come back stronger than ever? (Source: WEBTOON) Note: Includes one extra chapter.
A butcher with a dark secret finds a little girl on a rainy night.

t.r: Shuuniichido Classmate wo Kau Hanashi: Futari no Jikan, Iiwake no Gosen Yen
t.e: Buying a Classmate Once a Week
t.n: 週に一度クラスメイトを買う話 ～ふたりの時間、言い訳の五千円～
t.u: Shuuniichido Classmate wo Kau Hanashi: Futari no Jikan, Iiwake no Gosen Yen

sy: Story About Buying My Classmate Once A Week
entries.d: Once a week, high schooler Shiori Miyagi pays her classmate Hazuki Sendai five thousand yen for the right to make the girl follow her orders for the afternoon. Their sessions start with normal activities like snacking and chatting…until a mood strikes Miyagi, and she gives Sendai commands that veer into risky territory. No matter the order, Sendai follows, even if it means licking Miyagi’s feet.

Wan Jia, the protagonist, was killed in the game KOG by a sneak attack from his own teammate and therefore disqualified. However, the moment he left the game, he went back to one year ago, the first day of this game. This time he'll never trust anyone easily! This is for revenge! And more importantly, for winning the game! (Source: Webnovel)

t.e: The Returned C-Rank Tank Won't Die!

entries.d: Betrayed by her team and abandoned to die in a dungeon, timid C-rank hunter Cho-i Hyeon discovers a cursed ring that keeps her alive by endlessly regenerating her body. Time stretches into years as she’s killed over and over, unable to escape. When she finally does, she’s no longer the girl who was left behind.

On the night of a full moon, Do-Gyeong runs into a vampire with blood dripping from the corners of his mouth. Haunted by the encounter, he tries to dismiss it as a dream...but not only does the vampire go to the same school as him, he begins following him around everywhere!

Ye-Sul Hong has a secret – when she kisses someone, she can see flashes of their future. It’s hard to believe she’s ever met the right guy when she can’t even see herself in their destiny. She doesn’t get much use out of her ability until one day, when she accidentally kisses her evil boss, Min-Hu Cha, who’s got a secret of his own.

t.e: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life

sy: Return of the Back Alley Wizard
entries.d: Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master? (Source: WEBTOON)

The year is 12,090 A.D., and what little is left of humanity has finally crawled out from the ashes of war and destruction. From the darkness of the fallout, mutants and a race of vampires known as the Nobility have spawned. They rule the weak with no remorse. Once bitten by a Nobility, one is cursed to become a member of the undead.

t.n: 新妹魔王の契約者(テスタメント)

sy: The Testament of Sister New Devil
entries.d: When his oddball father suddenly decides to remarry, high school student Toujo Basara is about to acquire some very peculiar new family members. Enter his new seductive step-sisters, Mio and Maria. When Basara discovers that one of his step-sisters is a succubus and his other a recently crowned demon lord, all hell breaks loose!

sy: Leaves of the Deep Blue Tree
entries.d: Only in autumn when the dead leaves flutter about can Akino meet the mysterious boy who lives inside the deep blue tree.

An illegitimate daughter of Emperor Berthold Amaryllis of Visio, Ludis has spent her entire life being mistreated and pushed into the shadows. Now, with the Visio Empire standing on the precipice of destruction under the threat of Demonspawn hordes, her father finds a new use for her in becoming the sacrifice necessary to summon an ancient god.

t.r: Kenshi wo Mezashite Nyuugaku Shita noni Mahou Tekisei 9999 Nan desu kedo!?
t.n: 剣士を目指して入学したのに魔法適性9999なんですけど!?
t.u: Kenshi wo Mezashite Nyuugaku Shita noni Mahou Tekisei 9999 Nan desu kedo!?

sy: I Applied as a Swordsman, But My Magic Aptitude is 9999?!
entries.d: Laura who had received special education to be a swordsman from her A-Rank adventurer father since a young age, enters the Royal Capital's Adventurer's school at the age of 9. Laura filled with expectation in her heart in hopes to make many swordsman friends. At the day of the entrance ceremony, Laura's sword aptitude value was measured at 107.

t.r: Tsuujou Kougeki ga Zentai Kougeki de Ni-kai Kougeki no Okaasan wa Suki desu ka?
t.e: Do You Love Your Mom and Her Two-Hit Multi-Target Attacks?
t.n: 通常攻撃が全体攻撃で二回攻撃のお母さんは好きですか？
t.u: Tsuujou Kougeki ga Zentai Kougeki de Ni-kai Kougeki no Okaasan wa Suki desu ka?

entries.d: High school gamer Masato Oosuki is stoked to be transported into a video game world and given the chance to show off his chops...but why is his doting, embarrassing mother in the game with him too?! And why is she so good at it?! Welcome to a whole new kind of momcom role-playing adventure based on the original light novel series! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes one extra chapter.

t.n: 僕に花のメランコリー

entries.d: When Hana was a child visiting her mother' grave, she got to know a young boy named Yuzuru. He was Hana's first love. When she heard that he ended up moving away, she thought that it wouldn't be possible to see him anymore, but...? (Source: Shoujo Hearts) Included one-shot: Volume 11: Yurayura, Yureru

t.e: I Got Pregnant with the Tyrant's Child

sy: I Gave Birth to the Tyrant's Child
entries.d: For Elan the royal knight, the masquerade festival is a rare chance to let loose and relax. But her night of fun quickly turns into a morning of horror when she wakes up beside the ruthless Emperor Kylart. Knowing how cruel he can be to clingy women, Elan makes a run for it, hoping he hasn't seen past her disguise.

The continent Murgenia, where they master swordsmanship and magic: The small country Sunkwoll is in a tight spot because it's under attack of the great country Zarmine. But the general, Rain, who's reputed to be an exceptionally gifted swordsman, is against the war and won't enter the battle. But how is one supposed to wage a war like this anyway? (Source: Storm in Heaven)

t.e: My BFF is a Tyrant in Training

sy: I Raised My Childhood Friend as a Tyrant
J’ai élevé mon ami d’enfance comme un tyran
entries.d: A young Korean woman is reincarnated inside a novel as Viche Amelian, who according to the story, is to be executed in place of the young prince Jade for assassinating the emperor. After facing her death, she expects to get her old life back, but instead wakes up as a 10-year-old Viche! Could it be that her death failed to turn Jade into a tyrant, as the story foretold?

t.r: Tensei Majo wa Horobi wo Tsugeru
t.n: 転生魔女は滅びを告げる
t.u: Tensei Majo wa Horobi wo Tsugeru

sy: In Which a Witch casts the curse of Death
Mein neues Leben als Hexe in einer fremden Welt
entries.d: On her eighteenth birthday, shut-in Sena Shirai gathers her resolve and steps out into the world for the first time in a long while—only to be hit by a truck! Reborn as a witch in another world, she is only able to master two spells: Explosion and Destruction.

When his clan is wiped out by a beautiful demon, young Taikobo finds himself in charge of the mysterious Hoshin Project. Its mission: find all immortals living in the human world and seal them away forever. But who do you trust--and whose side are you really on--when you've been trained to hunt demons by a demon? (Source: VIZ Media)

Ju-Won Lee works as a doppelganger who poses as a hero’s alter-ego, and fills in for them in their social life while they perform their duties as heroes. One day, Justice, the strongest hero, approaches Ju-Won and requests his services with the promise of a hefty payment in return for his work.

sy: There's Something Wrong With My Popularity
Wo De Renqi Kending Chuxian le Wenti
entries.d: Si-Won Cha is obsessed with his popularity. Having transformed everything from his weight to his demeanor to remake himself into the perfect popular guy, he loves being the center of attention. What happens when he is challenged by over-eager and equally narcissistic rival Da-Un Hyeong? And why does Da-Un somehow think Si-Won has a crush on him?! (Source: Manta)

t.n: ばけものれっちゃん／きのこたけのこ

sy: Bakemono Recchan/Kinoko Takenoko: Asano Inio Tanpenshuu
entries.d: 1. Bakemono Recchan (ばけものれっちゃん) 2, 6, 11. Funwari Otoko (ふんわり男) 3. Toshinose (としのせ) 4. Yuugatou (誘蛾灯, Light Trap) 5. D 7. Sayonara Bye-bye (さよならばいばい) 8. Tempest (TEMPEST) 9. Natsu no Nioi wa Mahou Shoujo wo Nido Korosu (夏のにおいは魔法少女を二度殺す) 10. Himawari (ひまわり) 12. Kinoko Takenoko (きのこたけのこ) 13. Itoshi no Kengo (愛しの健吾)

t.r: Hiota no Kanojo ga Ore no Motteru Eroge ni Kyoumi Shinshin Nanda ga......
t.n: 非オタの彼女が俺の持ってるエロゲに興味津々なんだが……
t.u: Hiota no Kanojo ga Ore no Motteru Eroge ni Kyoumi Shinshin Nanda ga......

sy: I'm Curious About Eroge My Non-Otaku Classmate Girl Has....
entries.d: Kazuma, a highschool student who loves eroge, has been confessed to by the honour student and beautiful girl, Misaki Honoka, who's the school's prodigy. What's more, Honoka had declared that she would try her best to become a "heroine" that Kazuma likes?! "Can you..... train me?" What kind of eroge is this?

I treated you like a brother, so how could you confess to me?! I only wanted to avoid you but I ended up hurting you through an accident. I’m sorry. If I had another chance, I definitely won't run away again. However… That chance came so fast. I suddenly traveled back three years ago and met you again. The you who doesn’t yet know me.

sy: I Became a Legendary Archmage by Reading a Book
entries.d: 300 years. That was how long it had been since he had last been opened. For 3 whole centuries, the mysterious book of magic, also known as Grimoire, has been stuck on the shelf of the Le Temis Royal Academy Library. Just then, an apprentice mage opens the Grimoire, only to die in a freak accident.

t.n: きよく, やましく, もどかしく.

entries.d: The intimidating gyaru Enjoji is always butting heads with Fujii, the chairman of the school discipline committee, for dressing outside of school regulations. But his disciplinary actions are a bit strange!? Or even perverted!? An action-packed battle between a strict disciplinarian and a strong-willed gal! Note: Chapter count includes seven volume-extra chapters.

A senior disciple from a countryside martial academy returns as the world’s best! Dragged into a brutal political war, senior disciple ‘Hyeok Musang’ didn’t return after the bloody war ended. No one knew whether he was still alive for 5 years. Upon barely returning to his hometown, he found his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy being persecuted and destroyed by a third-rate gang.

t.e: Sakura Hime: The Legend of Princess Sakura

entries.d: Sakura is a princess who lives alone with a few maids in a mansion deep in the mountains. She’s been engaged to the prince of the country since she was born. She doesn’t like that fact, as she wants to decide her fate on her own. However, one day, a messenger from the prince suddenly came to take her to the capital… Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Kang Eun-Joo loses both her house and job at the same time. When she discovers a working position at a mansion, she immediately grabs the chance! How will her life as a live-in caretaker in a mansion play out, with a rude employer she immediately butts heads with? A story of unusual people in an unusual mansion!

Meet “the Killing Machine” Owaru Endou: the cold-blooded and strongest hitman of a massive underworld organization, who has decided to retire out of the blue. His reason? To stan his favorite underground idol with his head held high! But old habits die hard, especially for a man whose hands are stained with blood.

When I open my eyes, I find myself in an unfamiliar car, in an unfamiliar town, in front of the on-ramp to an unfamiliar highway. Before I can process any of this, I see the fiery explosions of multiple car crashes in the distance, and without thinking, I stomp on the accelerator and race toward the scene.

Note: This is the volume version of Himegoto which contains the franchise's serializations from Waai!, Waai! Mahalo, Comic Rex and Febri. Hime Arikawa is a high-school boy with a huge debt, and he is saved by the girls of his school's student council after being chased down by yakuza debt collectors.

Set in a high school baseball club, it is a "coming-of-age sideline story," focusing on the three team managers with very different personalities: Nagisa, who barely knows the rules of baseball, Ichinose, a flamboyant gal, and Himemiya, the quiet girl with a surprisingly nasty side. (Source: Natalie, translated)

t.e: Writing My Male Lead's Happily Ever After

sy: I Will Take Responsibility for the Welfare of the Male Lead
entries.d: A madman with a tragic childhood and a disease that brings on insanity, destined to fall obsessively in love with the saintess of the holy nation… This was the male lead of the melodramatic novel I wrote. He is also the very person who kills Laria Sherwood, the villainess I possessed, and whom I must stay away from to survive… or so I thought, until I saw the terrible reality I created.

Love is the new kid on the block when he runs into the Peach Club, the local gang. Simple and gentle, with an interest in sex toys, Love isn't looking for trouble. Too bad the gang's got plans for him. And so does their leader, Peach. (Source: Lezhin)

t.r: Mask Danshi wa Koishitakunai no ni
t.e: Mask Danshi: This Shouldn't Lead to Love
t.n: マスク男子は恋したくないのに
t.u: Mask Danshi wa Koishitakunai no ni

entries.d: Sayama is a pessimistic guy who always wears a face mask to school. When the most popular boy in class, Saikawa, rips off the mask out of curiosity, Sayama flips out. Despite his harsh words, he's somehow captured Saikawa's interest, who offers to tutor him with a bizarre condition: to let him do as he pleases with what's under Sayama's mask.

One day, 10-year-old Yamato and his friend Miku discover a man in a back alley who's suffering from vicious stab wounds. The man recognizes Yamato, and uses his last breath to share a secret with the children: Yamato's father was the perpetrator of a bank robbery that is known throughout the country as the most puzzling unsolved crime of the 20th century.

t.r: Sekai no Owari no Pen Friend
t.n: 世界のおわりのペンフレンド
t.u: Sekai no Owari no Pen Friend

sy: Pen Pal at the End of the World
entries.d: In a post-apocalyptic stationery store, a girl and a former animator exchange letters. A dystopian correspondence story. (Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

t.r: [Rouhou] Ore no Iinazuke ni Natta Jimiko, Ie dewa Kawaii Shikanai.
t.n: 【朗報】俺の許嫁になった地味子、家では可愛いしかない。
t.u: [Rouhou] Ore no Iinazuke ni Natta Jimiko, Ie dewa Kawaii Shikanai.

entries.d: “Onii-san, congratulations on your marriage. This person is your bride.” “M-my name is Watanae Yuuka… I’m in the same class as you…” My name is Sakata Yuuichi. I’m in my 2nd year of high school. Due to my parents’ circumstances, I’m suddenly getting married..? Furthermore, my partner is a plain girl, Watanae-san. During my 3rd year of middle school, I went through a bad experience.

It's been little over a month since the first semester of high school started. Shinobu runs into her classmate, Okachimachi, in the art room and tries to start some small talk with him. However, she was met with a cold and emotionless response. The next day, Shinobu runs into Okachimachi in the infirmary and finds out a surprising secret that he has been keeping, both of them...
An ordinary boy witnesses a mysterious floating object from his room. Upon investigating he discovers a bizarre creature. He decides to take it with him...

t.r: Gal Maid to Akuyaku Reijou: Ojoo-sama no Happy End shika Katan!
t.n: ギャルメイドと悪役令嬢 ～おじょーさまのハッピーエンドしか勝たん！～
t.u: Gal Maid to Akuyaku Reijou: Ojoo-sama no Happy End shika Katan!

sy: Gal Maid & Villainess: Only Milady's Happy End Will Win!
entries.d: The gal Selina is reincarnated in the world of an otome game that her otaku friends liked to play! Selina, reincarnated as an anonymous mob character, becomes a maid for the villainess Almeria. In this fantasy yuri romantic comedy, a maid with "previous life: gal" tries her best to make the villainess happy! (Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

t.n: ギャルにぱちゃんはせまられたい

sy: Gal niPA-chan wants to be hit on
entries.d: The popular teen model niPA, aka Futaba Asahino, is strong willed and refuses dance by someone else's tune, but the plain guy who is her seatmate refuses to budge before her... "Damn that four-eyed nobody, how dare he tell me off!" But at the same time, remembering that makes her feel somehow strange.

t.r: Dame Skill [Auto Mode] ga Kakusei Shimashita: Are, Guild no Scout no Minnasan, Ore wo "Iranai" tte Ittemasen deshita?
t.n: ダメスキル【自動機能】が覚醒しました～あれ、ギルドのスカウトの皆さん、俺を「いらない」って言ってませんでした？～
t.u: Dame Skill [Auto Mode] ga Kakusei Shimashita: Are, Guild no Scout no Minnasan, Ore wo "Iranai" tte Ittemasen deshita?

t.r: Densha Otoko: Net Hatsu, Kakueki Teisha no Love Story
t.n: 電車男~ネット発、各駅停車のラブストーリー~
t.u: Densha Otoko: Net Hatsu, Kakueki Teisha no Love Story

entries.d: A hopeless geek, a beautiful woman, and a fast connection--could the Internet be his ticket onto the express train to romance? A real-life thread on an Internet forum sparks a nationwide phenomenon! A nerdy otaku meets a girl on a train and posts an urgent query on the Web--How the heck do you talk to girls? What should he wear on their date? Where should they go?

t.r: Douyara Boku no Hanayome wa Onnakishidan na You de.
t.n: どうやらボクの花嫁は女騎士団なようで。
t.u: Douyara Boku no Hanayome wa Onnakishidan na You de.

sy: Apparently My Bride is Like a Knight
entries.d: Adventures of a guy who has a harem full of magical knights! Will he able to chose the bride that is perfect for him? Let's find out!

Ayato transfers into a new school, hoping for a fresh start. Sadly for him, the school turns up to be filled with delinquents, and the most feared of them all has his eyes set on him. And it doesn't help, that whenever Ayato accidentally takes off his glasses, everyone around him suddenly becomes completely smitten by him.

sy: Beneath the Surviving Princess' Joyful Façade
Ce qui se cache derrière son sourire
entries.d: When the king offers Aerik Cladinae his own sister's hand in marriage for his meritorious deeds in battle, he didn't expect to get saddled with a limping, drooling woman like Miesa Esquillre. Driven insane by her brother's physical and psychological torture, Miesa rolls around on the ground, spills food all over herself, and screams unintelligibly as a way of communicating.

t.r: Kanpeki Sugite Kawai-ge ga Nai to Konyaku Haki Sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru
t.e: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold To Another Kingdom
t.n: 完璧すぎて可愛げがないと婚約破棄された聖女は隣国に売られる
t.u: Kanpeki Sugite Kawai-ge ga Nai to Konyaku Haki Sareta Seijo wa Ringoku ni Urareru

entries.d: Philia’s family has produced saints for generations. It’s no surprise that she’s known as the greatest saint of all time—and set to marry the second prince, Julius. What no one expects is for Julius to call off the engagement, claiming that Philia’s perfection makes her charmless and unlikable.

When a meteorite struck the Earth, it shattered more than just the land—it broke reality. A wave of madness swept the globe, twisting people into monsters and leaving a cursed few unable to die. Now, in a world of chaos and grotesque wonders, two immortals wander in search of the only thing they still desire: an end.

Goshima is a boxer who has held the world championship title for years and never once lost a match - thus earning himself the nickname 'Zero'. His coach, Araki, describes him as 'a flower that blooms only within the ring'. But with his 30th birthday approaching, everyone begins to question Goshima's worth. Thus he decides to look for the ultimate opponent to give him his final match.

sy: Surviving in a Romance Fantasy Novel
entries.d: I, Seo Tae-Pyung, ended up transmigrating as the younger brother of the heroine in the fantasy romance novel Celestial Love. As romantic as this place is supposed to be, I was too busy just trying to adapt to my new life. Romance? Yeah, right.

t.e: Lord Baby Runs a Romance Fantasy With Cash

entries.d: Romance fantasies were my happy little refuge. I’ve read countless novels and left tons of top comments in RF forums, and where did that lead me? To getting hit by a reincarnation truck! Now I’m stuck in a zero-star rated story fighting for my life! My father, the vile Duke Phaeraton, abandoned me. I’m barely surviving, no thanks to my thieving uncle, Marquess Tarenka.

t.n: 僕はお姫様になれない

entries.d: Shindou Rei (Cinderella) comes from a very poor family. Her only clothes are hand-me-downs from her brother, even her school uniform. So everyone always mistakes her for a boy. Even her close friend Hakuba Ouji (white horse prince), who starts developing confusing feelings toward her all the while believing she’s a boy.

t.r: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Spin-off: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Bakuen wo!
t.e: Konosuba: An Explosion on This Wonderful World!
t.n: この素晴らしい世界に祝福を! スピンオフ この素晴らしい世界に爆焔を!
t.u: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! Spin-off: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Bakuen wo!

sy: Gifting this Wonderful World with Explosions!
entries.d: My name is... One year before a certain useless goddess and NEET extraordinaire hit the scene, Megumin, the "Greatest Genius of the Crimson Magic Clan," is hard at work. Ever since a life-changing encounter in her youth, the young wizard has dedicated her every waking moment to the pursuit of the ultimate offensive magic, Explosion!

t.e: The Many Sides of Voice Actor Radio
t.n: 声優ラジオのウラオモテ

sy: The Two Sides of Seiyuu Radio
entries.d: Yumiko Sato works as a voice actress with a stage name "Yasumi". She hides that she is a "Gyaru", plays an innocent character in front of the audience. She respects Yuhi Yugure, who is also a voice actress and a highschooler. Yuhi's popularity is on the rise, and she had even done a concert in front of her fans. Yumiko is anxious...

Garam has always loved to draw, but his dreams of being an artist have been on hold ever since his mother passed away. Wanting to become more independent and focus on his art, he moves into his grandmother's empty house by the ocean. There, he meets his greatest muse: a mystical water creature with no memories of her past. Now it’s up to Garam to help her uncover what she has forgotten.
A collection of short stories that look to mankind's exploration of space, and examine the possibilities that we could face when we decide to take those first fateful steps into the unknown.

"There are three murderers hiding in your midst." These are the ominous words given to the six survivors of a tragic bus accident, followed by an ultimatum: Within one week, the murderers must anguish over their crimes and find some way to answer for them, or the evidence of their sins will be given to the police. But when every person has a secret, who can you trust…?

t.r: Last Boss, Yametemita: Shujinkou ni Taosareta Furi Shite Jiyuu ni Ikitemita
t.e: Final Boss Fake-out: The Protagonist Thinks She Killed Me So Now I'm Free!
t.n: ラスボス、やめてみた ～主人公に倒されたふりして自由に生きてみた～
t.u: Last Boss, Yametemita: Shujinkou ni Taosareta Furi Shite Jiyuu ni Ikitemita

entries.d: The strongest final boss in RPG history figures out a way to get super rich in his own world! Demon Lord Menas, ruler of the Noa Empire, finds the Resistance's forces on his doorstep. While Alex, a determined, beautiful, blonde young lady stands before him, he gets this weird feeling of deja vu... Isn't this just like the prologue of 'ResNoa', the video game he plays in his dreams?!

Bokko takes place 2300 years ago in China. The town of Ryo has requested the help of a clan called Bokk to aide them as their town is facing attack. The Bokk clan's representative, Kakuri, responds to their call for help and attempts to save Ryo from an almost inevitable defeat, from not only outer forces, but also from those who doubt him within. Is he up to the challenge?

t.n: ケンガンアシュラゼロ

entries.d: A prequel for Kengan Ashura.

t.n: うさみさんは構われたい！

entries.d: Usami Nagisa is a yankee who suffers from a rare disease which causes her health to decline if she feels lonely. Sewa Natsuhito, the boy who sits next to her in class realizes this and keeps her company, but the only way Usami believes she can cure her illness is to make lots of friends, a process she might find quite difficult due to her aggressive looks and personality.

sy: The Genius Tamer of The Academy
entries.d: Shunned as the weird kid at school, Han Siha wakes up one morning to find he is not quite himself anymore. Instead, a former vet intern who died from overworking has taken over Siha's body!

t.n: これはゆがんだ食レポです

sy: Straying Warrior Kabi Nagata: Go Gourmet!
迷走戦士・永田カビ グルメでGO！
This Is a Distorted Food Review
entries.d: This diary comic details the complexities of Nagata Kabi’s fraught relationship with food, from eating disorders and habits to food preparation, with unflinching and detailed honesty. This short manga (originally 50 pages long) was written after My Wandering Warrior Existence and was only released on digital platforms in Japan.

t.n: 一条かれんは誘惑する

entries.d: Karen is head over heels in love with her childhood friend, the brusque and fierce-looking Mii-kun. Day after day, she makes amorous advances toward him in hopes of making him her future husband. But when it's just the two of them, she can't help but feel a little nervous...?

t.r: Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryaku-chuu
t.e: The Do-Over Damsel Conquers the Dragon Emperor
t.n: やり直し令嬢は竜帝陛下を攻略中
t.u: Yarinaoshi Reijou wa Ryuutei Heika wo Kouryaku-chuu

sy: Win Over The Dragon Emperor This Time Around, Noble Girl!
entries.d: Jill Cervel, the magically gifted daughter of a noble family, dedicated her life to training for war. It was all for her fiancé and one true love, Prince Gerald der Kratos... until he sentences her to death for discovering his dark secret! In her final moments, Jill wishes for another chance at a normal life.

A collection of stories featuring young adults navigating the workforce and trying to understand romantic relations as their lives are intertwine in unexpected ways. 1. It's nice to be young. [Originally published in the magazine as Dare Datte Skylark (誰だってスカイラーク)]. Kishi works in the anime industry but doesn't really like his job.
The story of two people brought together by the fluttering feelings that they know nothing about. Note: Discontinued due to author's death.

t.r: Wuxian Shitu Yu Shier Zhan Ji
t.e: The Limitless Apostle and the Twelve Battle Maidens
t.u: Wuxian Shitu Yu Shier Zhan Ji

sy: Infinite Apostles And Twelve War Girls
entries.d: He is recognized as the strongest existence, standing at the top of the world. Wealth? fame? Power? It was not worth mentioning in his eyes. The strongest apostles fled and startled the human continent for the reason: “Don’t get me wrong! Lao Zi came to look for his future wife! ”Yes, it’s a story about the strongest single apostle ever looking for a wife.

t.n: あつもりくんのお嫁さん（←未定）

entries.d: Nishiki, who lives out in the countryside, loves studying. But due to the arranged marriage her parents have planned for her, she’s finding her hometown a bit cramped. One day, she happens to meet Atsumori, a high schooler from Tokyo. Motivated by his unique sense of values, Atsumori suggests that Nishiki run away with him and get married!

The battle romantic comedy manga centers on a boy named Taiga and a girl who lives next door to him. He has always liked her, but when he finally gets the chance to talk to her she brings him back home as a human sacrifice to revive Marie Antoinette's daughter. After the ritual goes wrong, he wakes up in the princess' body. (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

A two-chapter prologue of Another about Reiko during her high school days. Note: The manga was first released as a bundle with a prequel OVA to the anime then later republished in hardcover format with a side story novel to the main series, subtitled “Episode S”.

I keep saying that I don't have any spiritual power, but they won't believe me! The random doorkeeper claims that I'm the greatest martial artist in the world, and they take his word for it! Wake up guys! I'm really not the martial god you're looking for!! (Source: Tencent, translated)

The novel centers on Asuka, a high school student who sees the apparition of a dead student named Haruka, asking Asuka to find her body. As the story progresses, Asuka and her friends attempt to find the eight scattered pieces of Haruka's corpse in the school and learn more about the Red Person that is hunting them as they do so.

The Great Thousand World. It is a place where numerous planes intersect, a place where many clans live and a place where a group of lords assemble. The Heavenly Sovereigns appear one by one from the Lower Planes and they will all display a legend that others would desire as they pursue the road of being a ruler in this boundless world.

As the illegitimate daughter of Duke McKellion, Lilian was never fully embraced by her father or society. So, when she has the opportunity to take her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to Emperor Kael Lu Kaldorf, Lilian jumps at the chance.

Twenty years ago, legendary player Lee Suhyeok was killed by a trusted friend during a tower raid. Now he’s back, reincarnated in a much weaker body and forced to restart from level one. Fueled by vengeance, he begins the climb again, but without money or his former abilities, there’s no way he can get his revenge… until he starts streaming.

t.r: Classmate no Moto Idol ga, Tonikaku Kyodou Fushin nan desu.
t.n: クラスメイトの元アイドルが、とにかく挙動不審なんです。
t.u: Classmate no Moto Idol ga, Tonikaku Kyodou Fushin nan desu.

entries.d: Saegusa, who retired from idolry when she went to high school, is good-looking and intelligent. She is always cheerful and friendly, and is the most popular person at school. Takuya, however, knows a certain side of the highbrow Miss Saegusa. Today, too, a suspicious-looking woman in a dubious disguise appears at the convenience store where he works part-time.

Mimei shares the hobby of listening to a late-night comedy radio show with the funny and mysterious Kurage from his class. And she's famous for sending in hilarious comments that are read on the show? But Mimei wants to be just as funny as her! Are they friends, are they rivals, are they something more...? This radio rom-com is on the air! (Source: MANGA Plus)

t.n: オーク英雄物語 忖度列伝

entries.d: The manga centers on Bash, a heroic orc who distinguished himself with great deeds in the great war between the 12 races, and has earned the respect of all orcs. He sets out on a journey as the pride of his race, carrying the honor of all orcs with him, but he hides the fact that he also set out on the journey in order to lose his virginity. (Source: Anime News Network)

t.r: Ore ga Watashi ni Naru made
t.u: Ore ga Watashi ni Naru made

entries.d: Serialization of the original doujinshi with the same title Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

t.r: Maou to Yuusha no Tatakai no Ura de
t.e: Reincarnated Into a Game as the Hero’s Friend: Running the Kingdom Behind the Scenes
t.n: 魔王と勇者の戦いの裏で
t.u: Maou to Yuusha no Tatakai no Ura de

sy: Behind the Battle of The Hero and The Demon King
entries.d: A modern man is reincarnated into the world of a fantasy game he knows well: as Werner, the son of a powerful noble. The thing is, Werner isn’t the hero or even the villain–he’s a background character likely to die during a climactic siege! Werner seeks out and befriends the hero, but he doesn’t have powerful enough skills to be a hero himself.

t.r: Isekai desu ga Mamono Saibai shiteimasu.
t.n: 異世界ですが魔物栽培しています。
t.u: Isekai desu ga Mamono Saibai shiteimasu.

entries.d: One day, Kyouji Himuro hears a knock on his door. Opening it up, he finds that he is transported to another world. But his new life is not good. He has no fighting skill, no money, and no way to make food. While dumpster diving, Kyouji discovers seeds and comes up with a plan to grow his own food. However, his plans change when he realizes that these seeds grow monsters...

The delinquent Tong Yang was suspended after getting into a fight on the first day of school. Upon return, he was shunned by all his classmates. The top-scorer Xiao Zhen ran into Tong Yang hidden away crying by himself. Tong Yang tried to act tough, but his bluster only got him beat up instead.

Only after Empress Lizzie died did Emperor Leon realize his foolishness and regretted it too late, but the time had already passed. With Leon's wishes, the Witch of the Clock Tower turned back time to the day Leon first met Empress Lizzie, and all Leon had to do, after returning to the past, was to make Lizzie happy. But the influence of turning back time was greater than he thought.

Shirou, a laid-back and absentmindedly seductive umbrella craftsman, is (surprisingly) a close friend of Koujirou, a hot-blooded young police officer who stands against all things undisciplined. With their mutual knack for attracting trouble, the pair soon find themselves involved in a bloody and erotic thrill-ride in their off-kilter town full of equally off-kilter people.

A new official spin-off of the popular weekly series Haikyuu!!, in which our protagonists are the members of the rival schools. A comedy series about their ridiculous antics that you can't read in the original story!
Oneshot from Nisioisin and Kawada Yuuya. A boy suddenly wakes up to find out he's in the body of a High School girl. Who is she and how did he switch bodies?

sy: My Body Has Been Possessed by Someone
entries.d: Seven years ago, Kanna was thrown into the body of a Korean girl named Ju-Hwa. She had everything in her new life—a loving family, a great boyfriend, a hard-won medical license, even her own clinic! But that all changes when she's suddenly swapped back one day. Just as she's been in Ju-Hwa's body, Ju-Hwa has been in hers... and she's left Kanna's life a mess!

t.r: Misato-san wa Amasugi Joushi ni Chotto Kibishii
t.n: 三郷さんは甘すぎ上司にちょっとキビしい
t.u: Misato-san wa Amasugi Joushi ni Chotto Kibishii

sy: Misato-san is a Bit Cold Towards Her Boss Who Pampers
entries.d: Misato-san, a very beautiful office lady who is good at her job, and her boss—Konishikawa-san, a middle-aged man who spoils his subordinates. Misato-san has a strict attitude toward Konishikawa-san, but what are the hidden feelings behind it?! The gap between the seriousness and cuteness will make you faint in anxiety, and this office love comedy with a difference in age begins!

Ian is seemingly the perfect student – kind, trustworthy, and handsome to boot, he became known as “the Angel of Christmas” thanks to an innocent act of kindness from when he was a child. So when Yugun returns to school after an extended sick leave, no one is surprised when Ian is there to help him get through the day.

Wouldn't you just love to poke in a relationship between two young high schoolers who have a subtle distance between each other? Of course you would. Tsumiki and Io have this subtle distance that anyone would want to jump in between just to bug them. That's what the other characters are there for. Tsumiki, being a tsundere and all, won't be honest about her feelings toward Io.

t.n: 小説 進撃の巨人 LOST GIRLS

sy: Ataque a los titanes: Lost Girls (novela)
entries.d: Spin-off novel consisting of 3 stories about Mikasa and Annie. 1. Lost in the Cruel World 2. Wall Sina, Goodbye 3. Lost Girls

Amelie Bourbon is a witch, destined to die at the hands of her lover, the ruthless tyrant Serwin Hennessia. So when ordinary office worker Lee Suyeon is reborn as Amelie, she vows to change the ill-fated story. The problem is the “calamity” sealed inside Serwin’s body, which threatens to ruin him and the entire world, can only be calmed when he is near Amelie.

t.r: Atarashiku Dekita Tomodachi ga Omotteta no to Chigatta Hanashi
t.n: 新しくできた友達が思ってたのと違った話
t.u: Atarashiku Dekita Tomodachi ga Omotteta no to Chigatta Hanashi

sy: My New Friend Wasn't What I Expected
Omotteta no to Chigau Ano Ko no Hanashi
Story of the girl who is not what i thought she would be.
entries.d: My new friend has an absolutely beyond super cool sense of style! One day, just after becoming a second-year high school student, Hinata found herself captivated by a lovely beauty named Yuzuki and called out to her. They hit it off and agreed to meet outside of school. But when Yuzuki showed up at the meeting spot, she was decked out in a fiercely rock-inspired fashion.

Volume 1 1. Hachisu-sensei no Shosai (蓮先生の書斎, Hachisu-sensei's Study); Fellows! Vol. 8 2. Counterpunch (カウンターパンチ); Harta volume 3 3. Nekotakota (ねこたこた); Fellows! volume 22 4. Polter Poster (POLTER POSTER); Swimsuits Fellows! 2009 5. Ai no Touhikou (愛の逃飛行, Love Is In The Air); Harta volume 5 6. Kinmokusei no Kioku (金木犀の記憶, Memories of a Golden Sweet Olive); Fellows! volume 7 7.

t.r: Mutant wa Ningen no Kanojo to Kiss ga Shitai
t.n: ミュータントは人間の彼女とキスがしたい
t.u: Mutant wa Ningen no Kanojo to Kiss ga Shitai

sy: The Mutant Wants to Kiss His Human Girlfriend
entries.d: Most of humanity has perished in the wake of a nuclear war, and the world has been devastated. In such a situation, a mutant, a relic of the war, meets a human girl and falls in love with her. In a desolate land, a different kind of love burns fiercely, sadly, and purely...!

Aoki Kaoru is a 26-year-old woman who has never had a boyfriend. Normally unattached and unmotivated in her own life, Kaoru decides to start up a nail salon as a side business in addition to her regular job as a medical clerk. Although having a severe adversity to physical touch, she is forced to confront that fear when she meets a man who can’t help but touch others.

Middle school brawler Noboru Haitani has never lost a fight. But the bitter taste of a soccer defeat gradually warms him up to the sport, until one day Haitani finds himself in a match against a team featuring middle school soccer prodigy Takami. An outlaw fights his way into the world of soccer! (Source: MANGA Plus)

Iku Kasahara has dreamed of joining the Library Forces ever since one of its soldiers stepped in to protect her favorite book from being confiscated in a bookstore when she was younger. But now that she’s finally a recruit, she’s finding her dream job to be a bit of a nightmare. Especially since her hard-hearted drill instructor seems to have it in for her! (Source: VIZ Media)

A teacher named Kadomae Kazuma has the principal's daughter Noeda Kanade for his class in a new school semester. At first glance, she appears to be a quiet girl, but she's awakening her aberrant love towards Kazuma!? This is a psycho love story that accelerates thoughts and actions!

Panorama of Hell is a shocking, tortuous journey into the depths of one man's postnuclear Hell. Through the confessions of a fiendish Hell painter born in the aftermath of the bombing of Hiroshima, Hideshi Hino tells a nightmarish story, creating a manga masterpiece of black humor, stunning vision, and unflinching imagery. (Source: Blast Books)

t.e: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life

sy: The Ranker's Guide to Live an Ordinary Life
A Guide to the Right Life for Rankers
entries.d: In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she’s the strongest hunter in the world.

t.r: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Kanna no Nichijou
t.e: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: Kanna's Daily Life
t.n: 小林さんちのメイドラゴン カンナの日常
t.u: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon: Kanna no Nichijou

entries.d: After leaving her otherworldly home to find her fellow dragon, Tohru, young Kanna found herself unofficially adopted by Tohru and her human companion, Miss Kobayashi. From attending elementary school to making new friends, Kanna learns to adjust to the human world with the curiosity and cuteness that only a young dragon could have! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

sy: A Saint Who Was Adopted by the Grand Duke
entries.d: After being abused, tortured, and exploited by her best friend Lavienne for 14 lifetimes, Saint Dinah swears to get revenge. And luckily for her, she manages to capture the attention of Archduke Tersia, who adopts and renames her "Esther" to honor his late wife's wishes. With her new status and knowledge of Lavienne's true nature, Esther embarks on the long journey toward vengeance.

sy: I Have a Dragon in My Body
entries.d: Mo Nan, an Imperial Preceptor in the Celestial Realm, has returned to his senior high days. To his surprise, there is a dragon within him… What would a powerless person do in the face of bullies: fight or obey them? In his past life, Mo Nan did not fight. But he will not make the same mistake!

t.n: スーサイド・パラベラム

entries.d: From the creator of Voynich Hotel, the plot involves the main character chasing down a mysterious girl through various levels.

On his way back from work on Christmas night, Yamada (26) discovers a drunk and crying high school boy and takes him home. That boy was mulling over being in love with someone of the same sex. A straight adult and a gay high-schooler. It is a piece that sets gender aside as their hearts grow ever closer. This is Mita Ori's long-awaited series.

t.r: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 2-bu - Shinden no Miko Minarai
t.n: 本好きの下剋上~司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません~ 第二部「神殿の巫女見習い」
t.u: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 2-bu - Shinden no Miko Minarai

entries.d: Part 2 of Honzuki no Gekokujou. With her baptism ceremony complete, Myne begins work in the temple as an apprentice shrine maiden. Awaiting within is what she always wanted: a room full of books! But her new life isn't quite the dream she was hoping for; she's surrounded by nobles who scorn her commoner origins, and even her own servants are causing her trouble.

As an illegitimate princess, Anastasia Entimos has died in just about every way imaginable. Every time she dies, she is brought back to the moment of her birth and forced to relive her tragic fate. It is only in her 10th life that she discovers her father is the esteemed knight and war hero, Paeon Parschel!

t.r: Hazure Skill “Gacha” de Tsuihou Sareta Ore wa, Wagamama Osananajimi wo Zetsuen Shi Kakusei Suru: Bannou Cheat Skill wo Getto Shite, Mezase Rakuraku Saikyou Slow Life!
t.n: ハズレスキル『ガチャ』で追放された俺は、わがまま幼馴染を絶縁し覚醒する ～万能チートスキルをゲットして、目指せ楽々最強スローライフ！～
t.u: Hazure Skill “Gacha” de Tsuihou Sareta Ore wa, Wagamama Osananajimi wo Zetsuen Shi Kakusei Suru: Bannou Cheat Skill wo Getto Shite, Mezase Rakuraku Saikyou Slow Life!

entries.d: Crest was born as the fifth son of a duke. However, as the fifth son, he was in no position to talk. His childhood friend and also his fiancée, Ellis, treated him just like a slave. And on Crest's coming-of-age ceremony, he received a skill called "Gacha." Yet, he wasn't able to learn how to use it and was banished away from his home.
We look into a day of the life of Suu and Kina that have recently moved in together.

t.r: Tsumi to Batsu: A Falsified Romance
t.e: Crime and Punishment: A Falsified Romance
t.u: Tsumi to Batsu: A Falsified Romance

entries.d: Taking inspiration from the Russian classic Crime and Punishment and then placing the behemoth of a book into a modern metropolis, Ochiai Naoyuki retells Dostoevsky's drama from the eyes of a struggling Japanese writer. In the 2006 remake Crime and Punishment ~A Falsified Romance~ Ochiai's lead is an incredible talent with award winning abilities.

Following a devastating military conflict, countries fight their wars in the shadows. One unusual spy, Klaus, has never failed on the job despite his quirks, and he is building a team to take on an Impossible Mission-one with over a 90 percent chance of failure. However, his chosen members are all washouts with no practical experience.

t.n: 寄宿学校のジュリエット

entries.d: "To Love, or not to Love" Juliet Percia and Inudzuka Romeo are archenemies. They lead two high-school dormitories from to two rivalling countries. Both factions are dead set on defeating the other to gain control over the island they have to share. Beneath the feuding exterior, however, Percia and Inudzuka long for love and peace for their budding relationship...
What happens when the greatest martial artist of the Murim world meets a genius magician from a fantasy world? (Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

The future. The people that migrated to an alternate dimensional space, seeking a new world to live in, started an armed rebellion in order to declare independence from Earth. Thus, multi-dimensional war broke out with the United Army of Earth. The battlefronts spread, and the fight grew long.

Kaito wants to become a magician like his father. But 8 years after his father's death, Kaito discovers his biggest secret! He was the famous Phantom Thief... and he was murdered! Who is the murderer?! To find out, he puts on his father's suit... and brings Phantom Thief Kid back to life! (Source: Kana, translated)

In a prison world, there are few good stories, and this is the world of Kubikiri Asa, the beheader and master samurai under the Shogun. It's a world full of vengeance, greed, and violence. A world of depravity and sin. One man can set things straight if he can keep his wits.

t.e: I Can't Choose a Childhood Friend!

sy: I Can't Choose a Childhood Friend!
entries.d: For Yu Suzukaze, reuniting with the childhood friend he adored feels like a dream come true. After ten long years apart, they can finally enjoy high school life together. But it turns out, this girl isn’t exactly "single"! (Source: Manga UP!)

How to avoid an execution! After being murdered, Yeonwoo is reincarnated into her colleague's novel as Tara Elias, the unremarkable 5th daughter of the Elias family. But the entire household is fated to meet a grisly end, and it's not long before they're headed for the guillotine. Can Yeonwoo escape death this time around? (Source: Manta)

t.n: 学戦都市アスタリスク

entries.d: The school-city of Rokka-also known as "Asterisk." Here boys and girls of the Starpulse Generation all compete in the Seibusai-the "star battle festival," fighting for glory on the greatest combat entertainment stage of the world.

t.e: YoRHa: Pearl Harbor Descent Record – A NieR:Automata Story
t.n: ヨルハ 真珠湾降下作戦記録

sy: YoRHa: Pearl Harbor Descent Operation Record
YoRHa: บันทึกปฏิบัติการเหนือน่านฟ้าเพิร์ลฮาร์เบอร์
entries.d: The distant future. Invaders from another world attack without warning, unleashing a new type of threat: weapons known as "machine lifeforms." In the face of this insurmountable threat, mankind is driven from Earth and takes refuge on the Moon. It is the year 11941, and the long war against the machines rages on.

Kaji Ritsuko, an author of short stories, finds herself unable to write. On a certain day, a remnant from Ritsuko’s past reemerges. Aoi, a male friend she used to completely confide in, appears in a dream and asks her, “Your life… is that really it?”. The next morning, Ritsuko is awakened by a phone call. Aoi has committed suicide.

t.r: Koi wa Tsuzuku yo Doko Made mo
t.n: 恋はつづくよどこまでも
t.u: Koi wa Tsuzuku yo Doko Made mo

entries.d: After witnessing a handsome and charming young doctor save a stranger’s life five years ago, Nanase Sakura trained to become a nurse. But when she meets the doctor again and they start working together, she finds Kairi Tendo to be nothing like the man she imagined him to be! (Source: VIZ Media)

t.r: Kino no Tabi: the Beautiful World
t.u: Kino no Tabi: the Beautiful World

entries.d: “So, who’s the kid?” “My name is…” ××××× hesitated for a moment, turning slightly to look back along the road they were traveling. Beyond the red horizon, her homeland’s gates sank into the distance, never to be seen again. Facing forward once more, ××××× looked past Kino’s side to focus intently on the path ahead before answering.

sy: The World Without My Sister Who Everyone Loved
The World Where the Beloved Sister Disappeared
entries.d: After being taken in by the noble house of Nacht, Sienna grew up with her adopted sister, Lorena, who she believed to be the sweetest, kindest person in the world. But after Lorena attempts to kill her, Sienna realizes how much her "loving" sister actually hated her. She tries to end her life with a magic potion but ends up going back in time instead.

t.r: Oyaku ni Tatsu node Chi wo Kudasai
t.n: お役に立つので血をください
t.u: Oyaku ni Tatsu node Chi wo Kudasai

sy: Please Give Me Your Blood, I Will Serve You In Gratitude
entries.d: A young man picked up a vampire girl who collapsed in the street. Although she tries to serve him wholeheartedly to repay him for his blood, she is too clumsy to succeed. A warm slife-of-life interspecies vampire comedy where nobody is left behind or abandoned! (Source: Shueisha, translated) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

“Don’t ever, ever get involved with her.” The warning Jeong Won receives is clear - stay away from Kim Jisoo at all costs. But the thing is, there’s just something so…intriguing about the other woman. Try as she might, Jeong Won can’t seem to tear her eyes away whenever Jisoo Is in the room. One night, Jeong Won misses the bus, and the only way to get home is the back of Jisoo’s motorcycle.

Hana and Hina are two high school girls working at the same character goods shop, but they are completely different from one another. Hana is petite, uncertain and shy, while Hina is tall, confident, and trendy. Yet they share a secret: their school has a strict policy against taking part-time jobs.

t.r: Tonari no Kuroki-san wa Nomu to Yabai
t.n: 隣の黒木さんは飲むとヤバイ
t.u: Tonari no Kuroki-san wa Nomu to Yabai

sy: Next Door Kuroki-san Is Dangerous When She Drinks
entries.d: So begins a new adventure in the big city for fresh-faced college student Hajime Goto. What's more, he is thrilled to meet Asami Kuroki, his new next-door neighbor-she's drop-dead gorgeous and excel at work. Could student life have started any better for this country boy? Little does he know, Kuroki-san has one fatal weakness...

Japan in the Reiwa XX era, where sexual activity is illegal. Hikaru Inuta, an honor student whose father is the director of the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's Sexual Enforcement Division, witnesses something shocking at a club he visits for the first time with her friend. There are a lot of people who enjoy sex with a great deal of alcohol and music!

Yamaboshi Academy’s Student Cultural Society consists of five weirdos (Himeko, Iori, Yui, Aoki, and Taichi) who just don’t fit in anywhere else. While they seem as close as friends can be, when they mysteriously start swapping bodies with one another, their bond is put to the test.

A young princess of the mountainside country of Helentar, Arsinoe, awakens and finds that a month has passed since the day the Empire of Ilia invaded. On that day, her mother was killed, an evil dragon reawakened, and her homeland razed by fire.
A story of Yumi and her brain cells. (Source: WEBTOONS) Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

t.r: Rokudenashi Majutsu Koushi to Akashic Records
t.n: ロクでなし魔術講師と禁忌教典
t.u: Rokudenashi Majutsu Koushi to Akashic Records

sy: Akashic records of bastard magic instructor
Rokudenashi Majutsu Koushi to Kinki Kyouten
entries.d: Sisti is a magic-user in training who attends a prestigious magical academy where she hopes to be trained by the best of the best. However, when her instructor suddenly retires, his replacement is anything but what Sisti had hoped for—idle, incompetent, and always late! Can Sisti still learn magic and unravel the secrets of the mysterious Sky Castle with such a terrible teacher as her guide?

A young man with poor eyesight named Hazuki works part-time in a flower shop and falls hard for the shop-owner Rokka. But what happens when he discovers that residing in her apartment is the spirit of the man she can never forget? (Source: Stiletto Heels) Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

Sanghyeon has the uncanny ability to absorb powers of magical artifacts—by devouring them. But it took him thirty years to master, and at fifty-five, it’s too late to escape mediocrity. Then one day, he’s miraculously sent back in time to the fateful day he awakened his powers as a monster-hunting player.

t.e: The Hero, the Demon, and the Villain

sy: Hero x Demon King x Villain
entries.d: The three arts of swordsmanship are all that swordsmen seek to master in this world. Eager to learn, some will take dangerous paths, others will trick, and some will even kill. Serena R. Lavail, a possible hero, is one of those who seek to master the arts to save her family. To do so, she embarks on a mission that starts right in the enemy's lair. There she meets the villain, Kane S.

t.e: The Vexations of a Shut-in Vampire Princess
t.n: ひきこまり吸血姫の悶々

sy: The Vexations of a Shut-In Vampire Princess
entries.d: Though she was born into a prestigious vampire family, Terakomari Gandesblood, or Komari, is unable to use magic because she refuses to drink blood. After having chosen the life of a professional shut-in, a maid named Villhaze suddenly appears and informs Komari that she has been chosen as the newest General of the Moolnight Empire’s Seventh Battalion (comprising solely of mutinous ruffians)!

t.n: リスタートはおなかをすかせて

sy: Khởi đầu mới từ bữa cơm nhà
entries.d: Mitsuomi and Yamato fell for each other beneath the endless, unchanging countryside sky. Now, as the days go by in the small town where Mitsuomi was born and raised, and the foundling Yamato made his home, the two men are searching for the shape of their own happiness. (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

t.r: Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.
t.e: In Another World With My Smartphone
t.n: 異世界はスマートフォンとともに。
t.u: Isekai wa Smartphone to Tomo ni.

sy: In a Different World with a Smartphone.
entries.d: After a freak accident involving some lightning winds up zapping him dead, 15-year-old Mochizuki Touya wakes up to find himself face-to-face with God. “I am afraid to say that I have made a bit of a blunder...” laments the old coot. But all is not lost! God says that he can reincarnate Touya into a world of fantasy, and as a bonus, he gets to bring his smartphone along with!

t.e: I Can't Keep Up With My Stallion Duke

sy: My Second Husband Is Desperate and Depressed
entries.d: Not a single soul in Olivia Florence's life, including her own husband, provided the warmth that she craved, and she lived her life alone, growing strong. Waking up two decades earlier right after her regretful arranged marriage to the Duke, Lord James Parnell, she plans to live a different life.

Following up on the high note of family ties on which the previous instalment concluded, but preceding it chronologically, we find Araragi and his little sister Tsukihi, the heroine of the last volume, in full sibling rivalry mode as they bicker about love. The conversation that cannot end unfolds in its unabashed original glory herein.

t.n: でこぼこ魔女の親子事情

entries.d: A witch who lives alone in the forest picks up a child. 16 years later, she grows up bigger than expected. Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.
A one-shot about a strange curse visited on a family after an archaeological dig. One-shot in celebration of 30 years of Itou Junji's career.

Tomie Kawakami is a femme fatale with long black hair and a beauty mark just under her left eye. She can seduce nearly any man, and drive them to murder as well, even though the victim is often Tomie herself. While one lover seeks to keep her for himself, another grows terrified of the immortal succubus.

t.r: Meido no Koi wa Enma Shidai!
t.u: Meido no Koi wa Enma Shidai!

entries.d: Tomari, a low-level administration worker in Hell, has suddenly been appointed to Enma Hall to be the aide to the King of Hell himself.
