Within this chaos, everyone is given a gift — a unique superpower and interface that lets them see data about themselves.

t.n: 告白 コンフェッション

entries.d: Two miles up in the unforgiving heights of Mt. Owari, hikers and friends Asai and Ishikura are hit by a blizzard and lose their way. Injured and sure of his imminent death, Ishikura confesses to killing a member of their university hiking club five years ago.

No-Rang and Pa-Ran are known at school to be the perfect couple — minus the fact that they’ve already broken up. But unable to back out of a promise to participate in their school’s dance festival as their class’s representative couple, they decide to keep their split a secret, just until the competition is over.
Welcome to the first other world exchange program. An encounter and everyday life with people from other world in a 4.5 tatami mat room.

As a successful captain in the military, Yun-A is an icon of success and power. But after an accident on the battlefield, she finds herself trapped in a romantic fantasy novel. Stuck in a supporting role as the best friend of the main protagonist, Yun-A is determined to overturn the plotline. Will she be able to change Rosalie’s fate and find happiness in the new world?

sy: Choose the Color of Your Wife
entries.d: Saku had a normal life, living with his cousin Kuran and being tormented daily by his childhood friend, Karin. That is, until the day a girl named Kiiro showed up out of nowhere claiming to be Karin's and Saku's daughter from the future. Convinced she will disappear from existence unless Saku and Karin get married, she makes life a lot more complicated for everyone.

sy: Kamen Rider  – The Classic Manga Collection
entries.d: Fans the world over have long been enthralled by tales of Kamen Rider, the masked, motorcycle-riding superhero who protects the world from injustice. Kidnapped and experimented upon by the evil terrorist organization known as Shocker, Hongo Takeshi manages to escape their clutches and use his newfound strength to fight against their schemes.

"Here be monsters": this expression has always been used to speak of the ocean - a dark, impenetrable world that can only conceal unimaginable horrors that the human can't see...often not until it is too late. A series of unexplained accidents happen at a submarine platform 6,000 meters beneath the surface and, in response, a group of scientists and cadres are sent to investigate.

Lokheun’s name means "happy morning," but her life takes a tragic turn when her mother is murdered and her father becomes a fugitive after exacting revenge. To save him, Lokheun devotes her life to Garyun, the dashing emperor who’s committed to right the wrongs of his father.

t.r: Einen Koyou wa Kanou Deshou ka: Buaisou Mukuchi na Mahou Tsukai to Hajimeru Sai Shuushoku Life
t.n: 永年雇用は可能でしょうか～無愛想無口な魔法使いと始める再就職ライフ～
t.u: Einen Koyou wa Kanou Deshou ka: Buaisou Mukuchi na Mahou Tsukai to Hajimeru Sai Shuushoku Life

sy: Reemployment Life With an Unsociable Untalkative Magician
entries.d: Lucille was recently fired from her job as a maid after an adultery scandal. This is her re-employment life story with a silent unfriendly magician in a quiet town, away from the scandals.

After seeing her family slaughtered, Aiko is surprised to wake up on a laboratory table, apparently intact. But when she notices the horribly disfigured arm grafted onto her body, she soon realizes that life as she knew it before the attack is now over. Infused with the DNA of a mysterious monster known as Chimera, the arm acts on the urges of its master — leaving Aiko powerless to stop it.

Tough luck for Sayo, who was suddenly presented with the sight of her boyfriend cheating on her while at work. Thereafter, her boss forces a close coverage program on her, but the composer, Kobuchi Chizuru, outright rejects her! However, he will agree to do the program if Sayo agrees to be his contract lover?!

t.n: エンペラーといっしょ

entries.d: One day something emerges from high school girl Kaho’s refrigerator—an emperor penguin, the largest of all penguins! When this emperor joins the household, fun and wacky antics with family and friends ensue! (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Includes six extra chapters.

t.r: Death Game Manga no Kuromaku Satsujinki no Imouto ni Tensei shite Shippai shita
t.n: デスゲーム漫画の黒幕殺人鬼の妹に転生して失敗した
t.u: Death Game Manga no Kuromaku Satsujinki no Imouto ni Tensei shite Shippai shita

entries.d: One day, Mai remembers that her perfect stepbrother is a character in a death game manga, and that one year later he will hold a death game involving all of his classmates, killing his sister in the process.

t.r: Madougushi Dahlia wa Utsumukanai: Dahliya Wilts No More
t.e: Magic Artisan Dahlia Wilts No More
t.n: 魔導具師ダリヤはうつむかない ～Dahliya Wilts No More～
t.u: Madougushi Dahlia wa Utsumukanai: Dahliya Wilts No More

sy: Dahlia lässt den Kopf nicht hängen
entries.d: Reincarnated in a fantasy world, Dahlia immerses herself in the art of crafting magical items. Using manufacturing knowledge from her previous life and the skills her new father has taught her, she invents blow dryers and other specialized tools, finding pleasure in everyday activities. Dahlia won’t hang her head in depression like she used to. She’s determined to enjoy her second chance at life!

This is a continuation of Koko Tekken-den Tough which ran for 42 volumes and followed the main character, Kiichi, when he was younger and was training under his father Seiko Miyazawa. This is a mixed martial arts fighter manga about the Miyazawa school of martial arts.

t.r: Isekai ni Kita Boku wa Kiyoubinbode Subayasa Tayorina Tabi wo Suru
t.n: 異世界に来た僕は器用貧乏で素早さ頼りな旅をする
t.u: Isekai ni Kita Boku wa Kiyoubinbode Subayasa Tayorina Tabi wo Suru

entries.d: Late at night in the middle of my part time job at a convenience store, I had an encounter with a robber and was mercilessly stabbed to death. As I was about to lose my consciousness, I thought about how much I wanted to do this and that when I heard a voice…… 『The wish to be summoned has been confirmed.

Xiao Lang was a young man blessed with a powerful Mystic Soul, but others failed to see its potential. Ridiculed and persecuted for his ""useless"" Soul, he had no choice but to break away from his clan. He would not let anything keep him from achieving his glorious destiny."Even if heaven itself tries to stop me, I'll break through it!

Weak, bullied and pessimistic about life, that's Setsuna Kashiwagi. On the verge of jumping off a bridge, a mysterious man appears behind him and offers the contract "10 million yen in exchange for your life in a year." Skeptical at first, he accepts.

The space ship "Leviathan" was once the arena for a cruel battle of survival. The only hope: a cryogenic chamber—but there's only room for one person Note: This is the doujin in which the French manga serialization published by ‎KI-OON, that was later licensed on Japan by Shueisha, was based on.

t.r: Yopparai Touzoku, Dorei no Shoujo wo Kau
t.n: 酔っぱらい盗賊、奴隷の少女を買う
t.u: Yopparai Touzoku, Dorei no Shoujo wo Kau

sy: A Drunk Thief Bought a Slave Girl

t.n: 表情が一切わからない白銀さん

sy: I don't understand Miss shirogane facial expression at all.
entries.d: It's July of his second year of high school. Yotsuya-kun develops feelings for the girl who sits at the front of the class. Her name is Shirogane-san. They're both members of the beautification committee, and although they don't talk much, his gaze seems to follow her whenever they're together. However, Shirogane-san always wears a mask while at school. What is she hiding?

sy: What Kind of Rice Cake Is This
entries.d: Si-Ru is devastated when her crush, the dreamy Gi-Baek Seol, effectively friendzones her. She goes out that night to drown her sorrows, but after one too many drinks, ends up accidentally kissing someone. The next day, two people in her class show up with a swollen lip. One is Gi-Baek, and the other is Cheong, a tall and quiet guy who’s always been a bit of an enigma to her.

t.n: そのとき修羅場が動いた

sy: At That Time, the Battle Began
entries.d: There is no right or wrong way to love! You're sure to find a heroine to your liking...? Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

t.n: デスティニーラバーズ

entries.d: An alternative version of Desu Raba manga. Misato Takuma, who has a crush on a classmate, is suddenly kidnapped at the infirmary when he comes to have a second checkup. When he wakes up, he's strapped to a bed and forced to do "something" by a beautiful nurse he doesn't know! It's a mysterious hospital where men are locked in an isolation ward and managed by beautiful women!

t.n: モブから始まる探索英雄譚

sy: A Nobody's Way Up to an Exploration Hero LV
entries.d: Kaito Takagi is a low status high schooler. A background mob character, you might say. He is just a low-level explorer who hunts slimes every day in the dungeons that appeared all around Japan, earning pocket money while admiring his childhood friend, the class queen, from afar. One day, a golden slime he had never seen appears before him.

t.n: サキュバスとはじめる真剣交際

entries.d: Yoshiki Tsuyoshi is the captain of Seizai High Karate Club which prohibits impure relationships. Akuno (a succubus) begins to tempt Yoshiki after he saved from her from a molester. How far can he go in the face of this clumsy but far from innocent girl? How far can he go in his pure, single-minded love?

t.n: このヒーラー、めんどくさい

entries.d: Fantasy adventuring comedy with a dark elf cleric who invested too much on her insulting skills and her companion, the swordsman who has to put up with her antics. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

t.r: Mahou Sekai no Uketsukejou ni Naritai desu
t.e: I Want to Be a Receptionist in This Magical World
t.n: 魔法世界の受付嬢になりたいです
t.u: Mahou Sekai no Uketsukejou ni Naritai desu

sy: I Want to Be a Receptionist of The Magic World!
entries.d: Nunnally's always wanted to be a receptionist of the Hall. She enrolls in the kingdom’s magic academy to hone her skills, but she feels out of place amid a classroom of nobles—including a genuine prince. (Source: Yen Press)

Maeda Hachibei is peculiar, because, when most males lusting after gorgeous females, he instead lusts after discrete parts. When he relocates to Tokyo to attend school, he finds himself living in a dormitory with five females, each possessing a distinct ideal physical trait he desires: gorgeous blue eyes, bullet-train breasts, a deep dulcet voice, and straight "anime-esque" legs.

t.r: Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta...: Zettai Zetsumei! Hametsu Sunzen-hen
t.e: My Next Life as a Villainess Side Story: On the Verge of Doom!
t.n: 乙女ゲームの破滅フラグしかない悪役令嬢に転生してしまった… 絶体絶命！破滅寸前編
t.u: Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta...: Zettai Zetsumei! Hametsu Sunzen-hen

entries.d: What if, when Katarina Claes was reincarnated in the dating sim from the original series, she didn’t regain the memories of her past life until she was fifteen? With less than a year to go before her destruction, Katarina must find a way to avoid all possible bad endings! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

Living in poor neighborhoods of Osaka, Kumada watch over his wife and two young children. He is huge and riddled with scars and he works hard, smokes and drinks of sake as if it were mere water, gruff and scary, he talks little.

Do gods play dice with the fate of entire cities? Yul Choi’s city is suddenly transported to become a piece in a board game of the gods. Just when Yul thinks he can work together with people to overcome the monsters and challenges, he realizes he must become the city’s greatest villain to save the city.

After giving up his dream of becoming a boxer, Park Kang-tae joined a gang. He was a well-known member of the gang but got killed in the end. His only dying regret is giving up his dream of being a boxer. Did God know about his regret? In a world where boxing exists in the form of pugilist games, Park Kang-tae pursues his unfulfilled dream. (Source: KakaoPage, translated)

t.r: Yomotsuhegui: Shisha no Kuni no Kajitsu
t.n: ヨモツヘグイ 死者の国の果実
t.u: Yomotsuhegui: Shisha no Kuni no Kajitsu

sy: Yomotsuhegui: O Fruto Do Mundo Dos Mortos
entries.d: Nawa Kanetsugu used to be a police officer, until his wife and child were murdered and he sought revenge by any means necessary. In a new quest for vengeance after he’s released from prison, he discovers that a mortal wound won’t kill him.

t.n: 今度は殺されたくないアザラシさん

sy: Ms. Seal: I don't wanna be killed anymore
entries.d: For some reason, Mahiru is able to see people’s past life. In her own past life, she was a seal born in the Arctic, in which she ended up savagely eaten by a polar bear. The occasional nightmares about her past life still trouble her until this day. <br Then one day, the said polar bear from her past life suddenly appeared before her in the form of a handsome man!

t.r: Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made
t.e: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster is Stronger Than He Realized!
t.n: 雑用付与術師が自分の最強に気付くまで
t.u: Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made

entries.d: Wim Strauss is a “granting caster”—a support mage who can increase the strength of his allies through the power of his spells. It’s a useful talent, but since it can’t be used directly in battle, it gets zero respect from the other members of his party. As far as they’re concerned, support magic is dead weight.

t.r: Isekai kara no Kigyou Shinshutsu?!: Motoshachiku ga Isekai Tenshoku shite Nariagaru! Yuusha ga Kouryaku dekinai Meikyuu wo Tsukuriagero
t.n: 異世界からの企業進出!? ～元社畜が異世界転職して成り上がる！ 勇者が攻略できない迷宮を作り上げろ～
t.u: Isekai kara no Kigyou Shinshutsu?!: Motoshachiku ga Isekai Tenshoku shite Nariagaru! Yuusha ga Kouryaku dekinai Meikyuu wo Tsukuriagero

entries.d: Former black company employee, Jiro Tanaka leaves his job due to overwork. In his home, he founds a job recruitment template which is from another world company. The job is to test the dungeon created by the demon king. There, the days of diving into the dungeon as a "dungeon tester" were waiting for him to complete the dungeon that even the hero would not be able to clear.

Have you ever skipped studying to play video games? Unfortunately for high school senior Yu-Sin Lee, the stakes are a little higher than flunking, as he finds himself trapped in a VR-based MMORPG. Yu-Sin was selected to beta test the game, only to be forced to fight for his life in a seemingly endless loop.

t.n: “尊すぎて読めなァァァァァァい!!”4Pショート・ストーリーズ

sy: "It's So Precious It's Hard to Reaaaaaaad!" 4P Short Stories
“Touto sugite yome na ~a~a~a~a~a~a i! ! ” 4 P Short Stories
“It’s Too Precious and Hard to Read !!” 4P Short Stories
entries.d: Collection of cute and sweet short stories for all to enjoy.

t.n: 血潜り林檎と金魚鉢男

sy: Blood Diver Ringo and the Fishbowl Man
entries.d: A terrible creature has been plaguing the community: a man with a fishbowl for a head. When he attacks someone, the goldfish leaps out of his bowl and drinks their blood. The victim is irreversibly transformed into a goldfish! This terrible crime has happened to high-schooler Kousuke's little sister. With no other option, he takes care of his goldfish-sister as best he can.

t.r: Jujutsu Kaisen: Iku Natsu to Kaeru Aki
t.e: Jujutsu Kaisen: Summer of Ashes, Autumn of Dust
t.n: 呪術廻戦  逝く夏と還る秋
t.u: Jujutsu Kaisen: Iku Natsu to Kaeru Aki

sy: Jujutsu Kaisen: The Passing Summer and The Returning Autumn
Jujutsu Kaisen LN - Odchodzące lato, powracająca jesień
Jujutsu Kaisen - Light Novel: Der Sommer ist vorbei
entries.d: A novel version that depicts a blank story from just before the death of Itadori to the start of the exchange party is now available! After the incident at Satosakura High School, Itadori meets a boy who suffers from a curse. However, the curse was a special curse that revived even if it was defeated and afflicted the boy!

t.r: Lady Rose wa Heimin ni Naritai
t.e: Lady Rose Just Wants to Be a Commoner!
t.n: レディローズは平民になりたい
t.u: Lady Rose wa Heimin ni Naritai

sy: Lady Rose Wants to be a Commoner
entries.d: When Felicia Schwarose’s engagement to the crown prince is broken off due to false charges, you’d expect her to be torn to pieces...but instead she’s jumping for joy! She may have been reincarnated as the protagonist of an otome game, but she wants nothing to do with high society. Thus, she becomes Fii Crow, a humble commoner earning her daily bread at a village bakery. All’s well that ends well?

t.n: ガイコツ書店員本田さん

entries.d: Ever wonder what it's like to sell comics at a Japanese bookstore? Honda provides a hilarious firsthand account from the front lines! Whether it's handling the store, out-of-print books, or enthusiastic manga fans, Honda takes on every challenge! (Source: Yen Press) Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

sy: The Bride of the Water God
A Esposa do Deus da Água
entries.d: When Soah's impoverished, desperate village decides to sacrifice her to the Water God Habaek to end a long drought, they believe that drowning one beautiful girl will save their entire community and bring much-needed rain.

t.r: Éclair: Anata ni Hibiku Yuri Anthology
t.e: Éclair: A Girls' Love Anthology That Resonates in Your Heart
t.n: エクレア あなたに響く百合アンソロジー
t.u: Éclair: Anata ni Hibiku Yuri Anthology

sy: Eclair: Anata ni Hibiku Yuri Anthology
entries.d: Full of beating hearts and fluttering feelings, this anthology of girls' love stories will leave you breathless. With contributors like Canno (Kiss and White Lily for My Dearest Girl), Sakuya Amano (Gosick), and Nio Nakatani (Bloom into You), this collection is sure to satisfy the desire for a sweet love story (or sixteen!). (Source: Yen Press) A collection of yuri one-shots by various authors.

t.n: ハングリージョーカー

entries.d: In the 2100s, a new virus has arisen that has dramatically evolved the wildlife into deadly monsters. Humans have been left behind by the virus's explosive evolution, and they are facing extinction. The only protection humanity has is the government's battle scientist organization, known as the White Jokers.

t.r: Zelda no Densetsu: Fushigi no Boushi
t.e: The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap
t.n: ゼルダの伝説　ふしぎのぼうし
t.u: Zelda no Densetsu: Fushigi no Boushi

entries.d: On the day of the Picori Festival, Link and Princess Zelda go to watch the sword-fighting tournament. The winner is a strange man named Vaati, who has come to claim the Light Force which is sealed within the Bound Chest. When the Light Force turns up missing, Vaati turns Princess Zelda to stone!

t.n: ケンシロウによろしく

entries.d: The "love, revenge, and slight euphoria" story centers on a young man who swears revenge against the yakuza. He studies the art of the "assassination fist" with all his might, and becomes an adult. But this man who is a genius at his martial art form realizes his techniques cannot actually be used to kill anyone.

t.r: Konya wa Tsuki ga Kirei desu ga, Toriaezu Shine: last
t.n: 今夜は月が綺麗ですが、とりあえず死ね-last-
t.u: Konya wa Tsuki ga Kirei desu ga, Toriaezu Shine: last

sy: I love you so I kill you. Last
รักเธอสุดหัวใจแต่ยังไงก็ฆ่าต้องเธอ -last-
entries.d: The final arc of The moon is beautiful tonight, but first, die, taking up exactly where the previous series ended. Kamishiro and Hanazono must face all odds, and his former allies, to save her from a fate worse than death and find a cure for the bloodlust disease, ID, which causes the infected to desire to kill their beloved.

t.r: Wangyou: Shen Ji Cike, Wo Ji Shi Anying
t.n: 网游：神级刺客，我即是暗影
t.u: Wangyou: Shen Ji Cike, Wo Ji Shi Anying

sy: God-Level Assassin, I Am the Shadow
entries.d: In a world where people sleep and enter a realm abandoned by God, Qin Feng, who sacrificed everything for his sister, faces betrayal from her. However, fate offers him a second chance, sending him back nine years before the abandoned world emerges. This time, Qin Feng decides to abandon his sister and concentrate on becoming the strongest. (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

This time the series is about Jack Hanma, the brother of the current main character Baki. The Baki Rahen series focuses on the character of Jack, his own path in life and his constant struggle to gain more and more strength.

A blind boy, Shinobu, lives a peaceful life with the support of his kind teacher and girlfriend, Mikoto, training daily to learn the ancient martial art of self-defense known as “Mibuchi Toshujutsu”. Until one day, when all is stolen from him by a strange visitor who appears at the dojo. This man, defeating both Shinobu and his teacher, steals away Mikoto with him.

The continent of Halkeginia is tumultuous--a place where the various kingdoms, princedoms, dukedoms, and fiefdoms strive against each other to expand their domains. They nobility scheme and plot among themselves to gain influence to their lieges or to even foreign lieges. In the middle of Halkeginia is the small but important kingdom of Tristein.

The story revolves around Masamune Izumi, a light novel author in high school. Masamune's little sister is Sagiri, a shut-in girl who hasn't left her room for an entire year. She even forces her brother to make and bring her meals when she stomps the floor. Masamune wants his sister to leave her room, because the two of them are each other's only family.

Humanity’s once peaceful world was turned upside down when monsters suddenly emerged from a portal in the sky. When all hope was lost, special people with powerful abilities called “attributes” appeared—they called themselves Hunters. To survive, humanity turned to education, creating academies to produce the best Hunters.

Not having any friends is bad enough, but being swallowed by mysterious black sludge in the middle of class? The worst. Yijun is no stranger to solitude, until a school project plants the seed for a delicate bond with another loner, Suni.

sy: Satou-san Who Sits Next To Me
entries.d: Yamaguchi is the smart, popular boy in school. After a recent classroom seat change, he's forced into the unfortunate situation of sitting next to Sato-san, a girl who - in Yamaguchi's mind - is as plain and boring as they come. But does he truly feel that way about Sato-san? Although her cluelessness is an issue, Sato-san has endearing qualities as well.

sy: Una Sonrisa hasta el Fin del Mundo
Laughter in the End of the World
entries.d: In an era of ruin, mankind lives in fear of those branded with the ‘Devil’s Mouth’ – immortals who are demonised, hunted and killed, only to return and exact vengeance on those who have harmed them. Amid the endless cycle of hatred, a young boy and girl appear in a distant town, offering to bury an undead that has been tormenting its people. But who is this boy who bears the mark of their enemy?

When they’re on their sugar-sweet dates, Akari’s always dressed to the nines in the cutest, trendiest fashion… meanwhile, her dear Shiho always looks like she just rolled out of bed. Despite their differences, both of them are alike in exactly one thing – they want their girlfriend to be the happiest woman in the world! (Source: Manga Planet)

t.e: Soul Land 3: Legend of the Dragon King

sy: Soul Land III - The Legend of the Dragon King
Douluo Dalu III - The Legend of the Dragon King
entries.d: With advancements in soul technology, humans on the continent of Douluo conquered the oceans and discovered two new continents. The soul beasts have also been hunted to the brink of extinction by human soul masters. The king of soul beasts awakens in the depths of the Great Star Dou Forest to lead remaining clan members to seek vengeance against humankind!

A requiem for the anguished, lost, and wandering in life over 50. With Japan entering a new era, the story centers on Shiosawa, a former manga editor for a major publisher. After going into early retirement, he now finds himself wondering about what the world of manga means to him: is it work, a form of expression, or friendship?

t.r: Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjo, Arui wa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen
t.e: Our Last Crusade or the Rise of a New World
t.n: キミと僕の最後の戦場、あるいは世界が始まる聖戦
t.u: Kimi to Boku no Saigo no Senjo, Arui wa Sekai ga Hajimaru Seisen

entries.d: Love is a battlefield. For years, a great war has raged on between the scientifically advanced Empire and a paradise of witches known as the Nebulis Sovereignty. This age-old battle sets the scene for a fateful encounter between two young combatants: an imperial swordsman, Iska, and the witch princess, Aliceliese.
In a world where sirens are common, the protagonist is a hybrid of a human father and a mermaid mother. He's always playing the piano under the sea, when a strange siren approaches him…

Earth is destroyed, and the sole survivor is the immortal being Seul Yun. After losing the only person she ever cared about, she is set out to seek revenge on the one behind it all – the emperor Horson. However, Seul finds herself lost in a strange world called Hetra. There, she must learn to harness her new abilities and fight against a new type of evil.

Azumi focuses upon the life of the female assassin Azumi. The manga begins an indeterminate number of years after the Battle of Sekigahara, but as the Azumi begins her assassination missions, the manga introduces the characters into mainstream history.

t.n: お菊さんはいちゃ憑きたい

entries.d: Okiku, an evil spirit that terrorized many during the Edo era, has been reborn after 360 years. Modern exorcists are helpless against its power, so they tried to negotiate.

Mizuno, the daughter of a mayoral candidate, is desperate to escape the suffocating pressure and scrutiny of smalltown life. Chayama, the heiress of the tea company Chayama-en, is adamantly walking down the path laid out for her, despite being forced to atone for her family’s apparent misdeeds.

Duke Carhel Luave is known as the devilish duke due to his uncontrollable magical ability to charm every single person who lays their eyes on him. But this is more of a curse than a blessing with several noble houses plotting to drive him out of power. Having no one he can genuinely like or trust, Carhel wonders if he will ever be able to feel the warmth of another human being.

At the age of 14, her first lover was her sister's former best friend, Kyoko. It was a time where Noriko would meet Kyoko after school and be thrilled by the smell of her adult perfume and enchanting eyes, nothing like spending time with her boring classmates. But why did Kyoko and her sister stop being friends in the first place?

Yun-Ho is a vocalist of a rock band with a painful past of losing all of his family in a car accident when he was just a little boy. One day, Yun-Ho went to a gathering to hear that his beloved Gyeong-Hun, who has always consoled him in his dark days, had fallen in love with another man. Yun-Ho runs out from shock and bumps into a mysterious man, Han-Ul who happens to be a mythical tiger.

t.n: 高嶺の花なら落ちてこい!!

entries.d: Shiraishi Kouta is a high school boy blessed with intelligence, good looks, popularity. There isn’t a girl that hasn’t fallen for him...that is, until the princely girl Kurokawa Kaori comes under his radar. While trying to get Kurokawa to fall for him, her badass ways get Shiraishi flustered instead! (Source: Manga UP!)

t.r: DARKER THAN BLACK: Shikkoku no Hana
t.u: DARKER THAN BLACK: Shikkoku no Hana

sy: Darker than Black: Jet Black Flower
entries.d: Taking place after the events of Darker than Black and replacing the events Ryūsei no Gemini completely, Hei (BK201) and Yin return to Tokyo to investigate how a Black Dandelion is granting Contractor-like powers to people who come in contact with it.

t.r: Yuujin ni 500-en Kashitara Shakkin no Kata ni Imouto wo Yokoshitekita no Dakeredo, Ore wa Ittai Dou Sureba Iin Darou
t.n: 友人に500円貸したら借金のカタに妹をよこしてきたのだけれど、俺は一体どうすればいいんだろう
t.u: Yuujin ni 500-en Kashitara Shakkin no Kata ni Imouto wo Yokoshitekita no Dakeredo, Ore wa Ittai Dou Sureba Iin Darou

entries.d: "Until my brother repays this 500-yen debt, I will gladly become senpai's property as collateral!" One summer day, Akari Miyamae, his friend's younger sister, came to the apartment of Motomu Shiragi, a university student. What is the secret behind this debt, and what is Akari's purpose...? An overly-sweet cohabitation comedy that starts with one coin! (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

t.r: Tokidoki Bosotto Roshiago de Dereru Tonari no Alya-san
t.n: 時々ボソッとロシア語でデレる隣のアーリャさん
t.u: Tokidoki Bosotto Roshiago de Dereru Tonari no Alya-san

entries.d: Oneshot promoting the first volume of the Light Novel "Alya, Who Sits Next to Me, Sometimes Whispers Sweet Nothings in Russian". Popularity may result in a serialization! Follow the story of the ice-cold perfect beauty, the half-Russian Alisa "Alya" Mikhailovna Kujo, and your average high school underachiever, Masachika Kuze.

t.n: ゆりでなる♥えすぽわーる

entries.d: After finding out she is to be forced into a marriage of convenience as soon as she graduates high school, Kokoro sees her life ending before her eyes at her father's wishes. And so in her final year of high school, she decides to indulge in her love of other women, and create an incredible sketchbook of lesbian romance to leave behind as her legacy.

t.r: Yinwei Wo Shi Kai Wuqi Dian De Dashu
t.n: 因为我是开武器店的大叔
t.u: Yinwei Wo Shi Kai Wuqi Dian De Dashu

sy: Because I'm an Uncle Who Runs a Weapon Shop
Because I'm a Weapon Shop Uncle
entries.d: An average-looking but extraordinarily strong weapon shop owner and a well-behaved but mysterious demon girl. What roles do they play in this ever-changing world? (Source: Webnovel)

t.r: Tengoku de Akuma ga Boku wo Miwaku Suru
t.e: In the Heavenly Prison, the Devil Enchants Me
t.n: 天獄で悪魔がボクを魅惑する
t.u: Tengoku de Akuma ga Boku wo Miwaku Suru

sy: The Devil Fascinates Me in Heavenly Prison.
entries.d: Kaoru Shabana's been coddled his whole life and yearns to remake himself into a splendid grown-up—a true man among men. Seeking a fresh start at achieving independence, he enrolls in a prestigious academy on a remote island. There, he meets Kanra, a tantalizingly tall young woman, who reveals that the school of his dreams is actually a nest of succubi!

t.r: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 3-bu - Ryouchi ni Hon wo Hirogeyou!
t.e: Ascendance of a Bookworm ~I'll do anything to become a librarian!~ Part 3 Let's spread books through the duchy!
t.n: 本好きの下剋上~司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません~ 第三部 「領地に本を広げよう!」
t.u: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 3-bu - Ryouchi ni Hon wo Hirogeyou!

entries.d: Manga adaptation of Part 3 of Honzuki no Gekokujou. To protect those she cares about from danger, Myne abandons the life she knows to become Rozemyne, the archduke’s mana-rich adopted daughter. But her passion for books hasn’t changed, nor does she hesitate to charge into another strange new world.

It's all about vampire hunting versus man hunting in the series. Akira's brother, Atsushi, was found missing for 2 years. And recently a mysterious woman appeared and told him that she can bring him to Higanjima (an island's name) where she saw Atsushi. But she also asked that he should brings a few more friends there...

t.r: Kono Class ni Gal wa Inai
t.n: このクラスにギャルはいない
t.u: Kono Class ni Gal wa Inai

entries.d: Mirei, a diligent honor student, longs for the flashy, fashionable ‘gyaru’ lifestyle she admires in manga. With newfound courage, she decides to give herself a makeover and reinvent her image upon entering high school. There, she meets Yushin, a rough-around-the-edges boy, and… they hit it off?!

No one could ever come close to “Battle God” Ye Qiu’s skills in Glory, a popular game that took the world by storm. His professional team, however, replaced him with another captain, and even seized his account. He was left to start anew at an internet cafe as a manager. When a new District 10 opened up in Glory, he dives back, armed with a decade of experience and an unfinished custom weapon.

For all her life, poor Lueri has been hanging by a thread, and the situation doesn't get any better when she is forced into an unwelcome marriage. But by miracle or design, a magical invitation presents her with a way of escaping her loveless life -- by joining the empire’s Jewel Box.

t.r: Kuuki ga "Yomeru" Shinnyushain to Buaiso na Senpai no Hanashi
t.n: 空気が「読める」新入社員と不愛想な先輩の話
t.u: Kuuki ga "Yomeru" Shinnyushain to Buaiso na Senpai no Hanashi

entries.d: New employee Shiho Satoko has a special skill. Rather than being able to read the mood, it would be better to say she can "see" it. With this special skill, what kind of hidden side can she see behind her senior's unfriendly exterior? Note: Sixteenth place of Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

t.r: Fukushuu Kansuisha no Jinsei Nishuume Isekaitan THE COMIC
t.n: 復讐完遂者の人生二周目異世界譚 THE COMIC
t.u: Fukushuu Kansuisha no Jinsei Nishuume Isekaitan THE COMIC

sy: Avenger's Second Lifetime Around In Another World
entries.d: Five years ago, in the middle of winter, Kosuke Kurono's beloved sister was raped and murdered. Ever since then, he has devoted his life to revenge. When he finally avenged his sister's death, Kurono had nothing left to live for, and he decided to end his own life, too. But instead, he was reincarnated into another world, and given the Black Magic wielded by the great heroes of the past.

t.n: 葉月カノンは甘くない。

entries.d: Hazuki Kanon is your average female High-School Delinquent. She is often late and skips class in the nurse office, occassionally talking to the male nurse BJ (Kuronada Jun). Tamaki Daiji likes to film stuff that captivates him the instant he encounters it, disregarding consequences.

t.r: Hero Girl x Healer Boy: Touch or Death
t.n: ヒーローガール×ヒーラーボーイ～TOUCH or DEATH～
t.u: Hero Girl x Healer Boy: Touch or Death

entries.d: In a world where heroes fight against evil from space sometimes they get hurt... and in comes a man with special powers... a massage that heals.

t.r: Hanazono-kun to Kazoe-san no Fukakaina Houkago
t.n: 花園君と数さんの不可解な放課後
t.u: Hanazono-kun to Kazoe-san no Fukakaina Houkago

sy: Hanazono And Kazoe's Bizzare After School Rendezvous
entries.d: Kazu grew up in a strict family, always being the good student and the good girl, innocent about all sexual topics. Hanazono, on the other hand, grew up in his parents' sex-toy shop, and was brought up to be open-minded and knowledgeable about the subject. So when Kazu wanted to learn more about sex and all its details, she knew exactly who to ask!

t.r: Tawawa na Oppai wa Suki desu ka? Kyonyuu Shoujo Anthology Comic
t.n: たわわなおっぱいは好きですか？ 巨乳少女 アンソロジーコミック
t.u: Tawawa na Oppai wa Suki desu ka? Kyonyuu Shoujo Anthology Comic

sy: Tawawa Na Oppai Ha Suki Desuka
Do you like fluffy boobs? Busty Girl Anthology Comic
entries.d: In a swimsuit, a bunny girl, and clothes that kill virgins. A little naughty anthology comic of girls in various situations and costumes by 9 writers!

Kurokami Medaka, a first year, is elected as Student Council President, and the first thing she does is establish a suggestion box. Since she was just elected as Student Council President, she's holding all the Student Council's responsibilities, and wearing their armbands. So she asks for her childhood friend, Hitoyoshi Zenkichi, for help.

t.r: Kuro no Senki: Isekai Teni Shita Boku ga Saikyou nano wa Bed no Ue dake no You desu
t.e: Record of Chrono’s War: Apparently I’m Only the Strongest in Bed
t.n: クロの戦記 異世界転移した僕が最強なのはベッドの上だけのようです
t.u: Kuro no Senki: Isekai Teni Shita Boku ga Saikyou nano wa Bed no Ue dake no You desu

entries.d: Three years ago, Chrono Crawford found himself sent to another world on the day of his high school entrance exams. Today, he serves as both a lord and general commanding an army of demihumans. In a world where his soldiers face discrimination and hardship, Chrono must use his experience in both worlds to bring about equality for all races.

t.r: Idol to Otaku no Risou no Kankei
t.n: アイドルとヲタクの理想の関係
t.u: Idol to Otaku no Risou no Kankei

entries.d: An otaku’s idol moves right next to him. And it’s a dream come true! But as it turns out, she’s a bit more sadistic then we expected. Are you seeing a trend here? There is no mercy. Submit to the bully girl of your dreams now. Note: this is the self published version on the author's Pixiv
Uru is a very short girl and is constantly mistaken for an elementary school kid, but despite that, she is ridiculously strong and decides to live by herself after her mother gets remarried.

Mincheol’s game Wings Online is going to be ruined for the sake of profit! But the new General Director has forgotten one thing: Mincheol knows every nook and cranny of his virtual world. Together with his trusty AI sidekick Oasis, will Mincheol be able to enact his revenge and create a Bad Ending for Wings Online’s season 6 update? (Source: WEBTOON)

One of the first Super Robot manga and the one that introduced most of the traits of the Mecha genre. Constructed with the Super-Alloy Z, Mazinger was built by Professor Juzo Kabuto as a weapon against the Mechanical Beasts of the evil Dr. Hell. Koji Kabuto, the grandson of Professor Kabuto, becomes the pilot of Mazinger Z when his grandfather is killed, and battles from there on against Dr.

X, a genius thief, and Ash, a boy with a mysterious past, decide to join the Azure Knights after a chance encounter with Ryu, the prime swordmaster. The entry exam for the Azure Knights is where the best of the best come to show exceptional skills. X and Ash must prove their might and win against the elite aristocrats! Will they be able to become knights?
Two young boys, feel very anxious to face the circumstances of reality, what kind of decision will they take?

Ukishima Shrine is located in an old, picturesque lakeside town. Shrine maiden Kisaragi Saya lives there along with her father, Tadayoshi. By day, she lives the life of a normal high school student at Sanbara Academy. By night, she hunts the Old Ones. Possessing supernatural physical prowess, the Old Ones prey on humans, and only Saya has the ability to defeat them. (Source: AniDB)

The world of Velveteen & Mandara is a dystopia. Tokyo where the youth used to waste their time search for answers, is now barren. For a pair of teens who still live along the outskirts of town, Velveteen and Mandala, Tokyo is a nightmare that can only compare to the nightmare that is slowly tring to take over the metropolis. These two teens are the last line of defence for a nation in ruins.

t.r: Goblin wa Mou Juubun ni Tsuyoi
t.n: ゴブリンはもう十分に強い
t.u: Goblin wa Mou Juubun ni Tsuyoi

entries.d: A goblin reached level 99... and now she keeps killing heroes. Includes 2 bonus chapters.

sy: I Was Just Having Fun With The Time Limit
entries.d: A terminally ill orphan is gifted a second chance when she is reborn into her favorite novel as Princess Isabelle Bilothian. Despite being born with a curse that will kill her at age 21, she eagerly embraces the opportunity to relish two decades with her loving family and friends.

t.r: Wakeari Akuyaku Reijou wa, Konyaku Hakigo no Jinsei wo Jiyuu ni Ikiru
t.n: 訳あり悪役令嬢は、婚約破棄後の人生を自由に生きる
t.u: Wakeari Akuyaku Reijou wa, Konyaku Hakigo no Jinsei wo Jiyuu ni Ikiru

entries.d: Leticia, a daughter of a duke, has her reasons for trying to get her engagement to a prince ended. She successfully achieves her goal, and the prince declares their engagement over. She believes all is good, until one day, the memories of her past life as a nurse suddenly come back!

After seven grueling years, Jihan Yu, a support hero, is expelled from his guild. But fate throws him a curveball -- a contract with an elemental grants him the ultra-rare power of a Wind Elementalist! In a world ravaged by monsters and invaders from other realms, Jihan joins the underdog Epic Guild.

t.r: Genkai Koe no Skill wa Tenseisha ni Shika Atsukaenai Over Limit Skill Holder
t.n: 限界超えの天賦は、転生者にしか扱えない ー オーバーリミット・スキルホルダ
t.u: Genkai Koe no Skill wa Tenseisha ni Shika Atsukaenai Over Limit Skill Holder

sy: Exceeding limits can only be handled by reincarnated people
entries.d: A fantasy adventure about bonds forged with people in a different world. The setting is a world, where everyone has eight skill slots. In these slots people can put skills like “Strengthen arm (1 star rarity)” and “Fire Magic (2 star rarity)” from skill orbs, abilities which prove extremely useful for survival. The total amount of stars your skills have can never exceed your slots.

t.n: 伯爵と妖精～あいつは優雅な大悪党～

entries.d: Edgar Ashenbert claims to be descended from the human ruler of the fairy kingdom, and he urgently needs Lydia’s help to find and claim his birthright, the legendary sword of the Blue Knight Earl. Things will never be the same for Lydia as she is pulled into a dangerous quest against dark forces! (Source: Shojo Beat)

sy: Encounter Between Polar Opposites and Their Dogs
Seihantai na Danjo to Inu no Deai
entries.d: Chiharu Kagura is content spending her days with her sweetie of a Rottweiler that probably weighs about as much as she does. Meanwhile, Kiyotaka Tsujii can’t get enough of his fluffy Pomeranian that barely comes up to his knees. When these two mismatched pairs chance upon each other at the park, could it be the start of an unlikely friendship—or maybe something more?

sy: Aisha: Ai to Satsuriku no Douwa
Aisha - Contes d'amours et de massacres
entries.d: Twins who have lost their parents had their inheritance stolen away by their evil stepmother. But the stepmother's three sons have a special feelings towards their non-blood-related stepsisters. Thus, a story of love and hate will unfold in this old mansion. This is a fairy tale of vengeance and romance. (Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After the funeral of an old friend, Deok-Chul Sim resolves to pursue something he had always wanted to try: ballet. Much to the surprise (and maybe~ horror) of his wife, children, and other acquaintances, this 70-year-old throws himself into following his heart and his passion.

Sequel to Immortal Regis. Reading the entirety of the prequel is highly recommended, otherwise, this story from chapter 4 on will spoil it and/or be confusing. Cavalier of the Abyss (so far) is set only in the world of Chaos. There is now a Regis of Chaos.

The four sisters of the Wakaba family are all in the midst of their “first love” right now. The eldest sister, Kokoharu, is in love with a senior at her part-time job. The second sister, Manatsu, likes a guy in the Archery Club. The third sister, Akira, is interested in a club-mate the same age as her. The youngest, Chifuyu, likes a boy in her class.

Year 2130 -- after the third world war, large contaminated areas known as "Blackspots" formed all over Japan. Large Walls were used to quarantine off these "Blackspots". In time, signs of inhabitance appeared within these wastelands.

t.r: Jidou Hanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu wo Samayou
t.e: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
t.n: 自動販売機に生まれ変わった俺は迷宮を彷徨う
t.u: Jidou Hanbaiki ni Umarekawatta Ore wa Meikyuu wo Samayou

entries.d: How far are you willing to go to protect your interests? For one Japanese vending-machine enthusiast, the answer is “to the grave.” Crushed by his favorite contraption, his life as a fanboy of dispensed goods may be over, but his close connection to vending machines can only grow—when he’s reborn as one in a fantasy world!

t.n: だーりん・いん・ざ・ふらんきす！

entries.d: Official 4-koma manga adaptation based on the anime series written by mato and serialized in Shounen Jump+. It features chibi versions of the characters and retells the story in a caricaturing way. Note: For every episode of DARLING in the FRANXX, there are 3 chapters/pages illustrating the events of the episode, with the exception of the final episode, which had 4 chapters.

In the medieval fantasy world of Alfheimr, succubus princess Astarotte Ygvar, the first princess of the kingdom of Ygvar, has just reached the age of 10. For the coming years of a young succubus' life, it is necessary for them to have a male harem. In order to maintain their body and preserve their beautiful appearance, they must consume a substance only found on males.

The bullied girl in class Sakura Rin and the honor student who doesn't want to make any waves, Komine Yuuya, were classmates and haven't once exchanged words with each other. Everything between them changes when Yuuya goes with the flow around him and tells her to go die. Rin jumps from the classroom window. She escapes death and claims that it was Yuuya's fault.

Scatterbrained Takara Takarada is an undiscovered genius actor who fully embodies every character he's cast as, delivering unforgettable performance after performance onstage. But this genius can only be brought forth by his best friend and fellow actor, Yuujin Kamoshima, who cares for Takara even as he envies him for his innate talent.

t.r: Manadeshi ni Uragirarete Shinda Ossan Yuusha, Shijou Saikyou no Maou toshite Ikikaeru
t.n: 愛弟子に裏切られて死んだおっさん勇者、史上最強の魔王として生き返る
t.u: Manadeshi ni Uragirarete Shinda Ossan Yuusha, Shijou Saikyou no Maou toshite Ikikaeru

sy: The Ex-Hero Who Resurrected as the Most Powerful Demon Lord
entries.d: The hero, Fried, confronts the demon lord with his student, Lyle. Fried killed the demon lord after a ferocious battle. “I'm going to put an end to this war!” Just as he was about to finish off the demon lord, he is betrayed by his student who attacked from behind. Fried, who was supposed to be dead, wakes up next to a demon girl who calls him the demon lord for some reason.

Naoto is Hajime's childhood friend. Naoto may look cute but then again, his attitude gets to everyone's nerves. Even though Naoto's like that, Hajime still has his eyes on him. But..... one thing to know about Naoto >>>> he hates homosexuals and wishes they will become extinct and rot in hell!!

From on high, the gods make sport of the mortals who toil below them. None know the cruelty of these beings better than Ganymede, a beautiful prince who was torn away from his family by the gods’ divine hands. Granted immortality, Ganymede now whiles away his days in an inescapable miniature garden for the amusement of the gods, particularly Apollo.

In a world of animals where the strong eat the weak, Monoko the tanuki stumbles across a strange creature the likes of which has never been seen before—a human baby! While the newborn has no claws or teeth to protect itself, it does have the rare ability to speak to and understand all the different animals. Can Monoko and the baby team up to protect the tanuki pack from vicious wildcats?

sy: I Was Just an Ordinary Lady
entries.d: Hansol is excited to begin her college career when a fatal accident whisks her away to a mystical land. Now in the body of Finea Macaira, the daughter of Drayfox nobility and a descendant of one of the five heroes of the empire, she must learn to forget about the past and embrace this magical new world.

t.n: 探偵はもう、死んでいる。

entries.d: I, Kimihiko Kimizuka, was an ordinary high school student. Sure, I had a penchant for getting dragged into all sorts of trouble, but was otherwise ordinary-until I met her. The detective, Siesta.

Nohara-san was seated next to me when we changed seats in class. Her hair is very beautiful, but she is clumsy and can't seem to tie it herself...? Haruki, who helps to do his sister's hair every morning, suddenly found himself helping Nohara with her hair. As he tied her precious hair, they gradually became more and more aware of each other and grew closer.

The boss of the Iwashi yakuza gang is a high school girl named Minoko Konomi. But don’t let her appearance fool you; she has done and seen things normal citizens can’t even imagine. Under her control are two assassins who have gained legendary status for their deadliness and ability to get any job done.

t.n: かぐや様は告らせたい ダークネス

sy: Kaguya Wants to be Confessed to Darkness
entries.d: 1. Yu complains about manga fanservice as the girls are taking a bath. 2. Yu and Miyuki comment on a stray porn mag. Note: Published in two separate issues of Young Jump GOLD.

A master gunman named Zero searches the land for the legendary Kurohime. She saved him as a child, impressing upon him the importance of justice and helping others. While on his journey he meets a young girl named Himeko and is suddenly attacked by overwhelming forces. Outnumbered, outgunned, and out of luck, he makes his last stand in order to protect this "helpless" girl.

t.e: The Reborn Prodigy of the Ducal Family

sy: The Unprecedented Prodigy of the Duke's House
entries.d: Once the commander-in-chief of Earth’s resistance and a legendary monster hunter, Han-Seong was dragged into another world and enslaved by the Empire through a binding spell. For ten long years, he fought their wars, crushed their enemies, and was discarded like a weapon. But death wasn’t his end. Revived by the Stone of Reincarnation, he awakens as Dale, the heir to a powerful ducal house.

t.r: Akujo wa Mata Shi wo Erabu
t.u: Akujo wa Mata Shi wo Erabu

sy: I’m a Villainess, Can I Die?
I'm an Evil Woman, So Can I Die Now?
entries.d: “I was reborn…and I want to die again.” Despite choosing to die in her previous life, our protagonist is reborn as Selena, the short-lived villainess from a novel. The character Selena was written to be so villainous she spends her final moments isolated in a dungeon.

t.n: キングダムハーツチェインオブメモリーズ

sy: Disney Square Enix's Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories
entries.d: The door to Kingdom Hearts was sealed, dealing a blow to the heartless and restoring the worlds to normal, but Riku and King Mickey were trapped inside!

Circling back to a middle school girl’s apotheosis, if we can call it that, in OTORIMONOGATARI, and the mortal threat it poses to the hero and his girl, this “Season Two” finale is narrated, for the first time in the series, by a grown-up—but if the word conjures a sense of reliability, of stability and certainty to you, dear reader, then the lesson to take home from this is to trust no one.

t.r: Yandere-kei Otomege no Sekai ni Tensei Shite Shimatta You Desu
t.e: Reborn into a World of Yanderes?!
t.n: ヤンデレ系乙女ゲーの世界に転生してしまったようです
t.u: Yandere-kei Otomege no Sekai ni Tensei Shite Shimatta You Desu

entries.d: "In a crazy turn of events, the Lycoris family has been targeted and reborn into the world of a yandere otome game. They can try to use their knowledge of their past lives to go straight to the ending of the game, but they have to watch out for the ""bad ending""... Drama ensues and relationships form...maybe even a little too fast.

From the moment she woke up in a foreign land with no memories of her past, Dia knew she was fated for misery. Taken in by a baron but beaten and abused for four long years, her only friend was the eldest son of House Knolls. Everything changed when the sadistic Emperor Caire, notorious for having a macabre hobby, barged into the mansion and gazed deeply into Dia’s eyes.

t.n: エヴァンゲリオン ANIMA

entries.d: An alternate universe ending for the legendary anime! What would have happened if the Human Instrumentality Project–from the final two episodes of the original Neon Genesis Evangelion anime–had never reached fruition? This official light novel series explores just that, allowing Shinji Ikari and the pilots around him to age three years and face a different future.

t.n: 私が15歳ではなくなっても。

entries.d: Iwashita, a middle-aged salaryman, is living a modest but repressed life, shunned by his daughter and nagged by his wife. Until one day he ran into a girl named Chyna. She offered Iwashita a meal for 20,000 yen - an invitation to become a daddy.

Hellsing, an organization devoted to the elimination of the vampire threat, has recently uncovered information regarding the attempted production of "man-made" undead. The world is presently in the thick of WWII, and the current leader of Hellsing fears the Nazis could potentially use these creatures as front-line super-soldiers.

t.n: 先輩が僕を殺(ト)りにきてる

sy: My Senpai is After My Life
entries.d: The romantic comedy story centers on a girl with giant breasts and a boy who is "like a small animal." Ken Yamada is a student council officer who starts to feel like his life is in danger. The beautiful and intelligent student council president Rei Jinjūji utilizes her giant chest for her own ends. When Rei presses her breasts against Ken, he feels like she is trying to kill him.

Narumi Rokurou is still adrift in life in his forties, unmarried, and working as an editor at a publishing company while writing hardly lucrative literary fiction. His days enjoying life at his own pace are brought to an end one summer night, when a strange twist of fate brings Rokurou together with a mysterious beauty, beginning the story of their crazed love.

After Kang Hu’s death from bullying, the family was torn into pieces. His younger brother suppresses his resentment and heads back to school. The story begins exactly one year after Kang Hu’s death when his brother seeks to destroy the delinquent circle...

Ichigo Hinamori has always looked up to her senpai Yaya Suou for her poise, impeccable grades, and kind heart. But that all changes the day Ichigo stumbles upon Yaya wailing like a little kid in the nurse’s office. It turns out everyone’s favorite honor student is desperate to get off her pedestal and be spoiled rotten instead—and now she’s hoping Ichigo will be the one to indulge her!

Panic disorder, depression, development disorder, PTSD.. Japan, secret home to many carrying a diseases in their souls, unable to share their pain with anyone and suffering alone from their latent mental illnesses. When suicide rates are the worst among the developed nations, one cannot help but wonder what the reasons for this downfall were.

t.r: FAIRY TAIL Gaiden: Kengami no Souryuu
t.e: Fairy Tail: Twin Dragons of Saber Tooth
t.n: FAIRY TAIL外伝 剣咬の双竜
t.u: FAIRY TAIL Gaiden: Kengami no Souryuu

entries.d: Now the guild master of Sabertooth, Sting faces the trials of leading a guild and the responsibilities that come with it. A number of challenges come his and Rogue's way, including the kidnapping of one of their guild members and a mage attempting to steal their dragon slayer powers. They must fight to keep their Sabertooth guild family together.

sy: Demon Slayer - Kimetsu no Yaiba: School Days
entries.d: Zenitsu is late for class, and the only thing between him and Giyu’s bamboo sword is one good excuse. Next, when Inosuke, Murata, and Zenitsu fail their midterm, they must endure the harshest math lesson of their lives. Then there’s Uzui’s explosive art class, Nezuko’s first cavity, and Rengoku’s forbidden pizza! (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Includes six extra chapters.

In the process of growing up, one gains greater freedom and is given more responsibilities at the same time. For Isaki, who had just turned 16, this adventure and challenge comes through his neighbor's Piper Cub. In exchange for paying gas bills and making deliveries, he is given the chance to meet new people and expand his horizons.

Bella is cursed with a poison that takes the lives of anyone she touches. The way to break the curse is to be given "true love." She was rumored to be a "poisonous witch" and lived alone in the forest, but one day she met Anna, a painter who couldn't sell her art...

t.r: Kanojo to Kare no Kankei: Heibon na Hayakawa-san to Heibon na Miura-kun no Hibon na Kankei
t.n: 彼女と彼の関係 ～平凡な早川さんと平凡な三浦くんの非凡な関係～
t.u: Kanojo to Kare no Kankei: Heibon na Hayakawa-san to Heibon na Miura-kun no Hibon na Kankei

entries.d: "I wish I had a girlfriend, I don't even care who—" "Really? Anybody? Even me?" Kaho, who has never had a boyfriend before, wanted to have a male-female relationship. Takumi, who wanted a girlfriend, just happened to be talking about it in front of her....... A heart-throbbing coming-of-age love story! (Source: Pixiv Sylph, translated)

t.r: Kagakuteki ni Sonzai shiuru Creature Musume no Kansatsu Nisshi
t.e: Creature Girls: A Hands-On Field Journal in Another World
t.n: 科学的に存在しうるクリーチャー娘の観察日誌
t.u: Kagakuteki ni Sonzai shiuru Creature Musume no Kansatsu Nisshi

entries.d: Weird Girls, Weird Science! Whether they're part cat, part horse, or part spider, Daisuke has always been fascinated with the uniquely exotic beauty of monster girls. When he finds himself whisked away to a fantastic world full of all manner of demihuman life, he swiftly gets to work meeting (and analyzing!) as many as he can.

sy: More Than Lovers, Less Than Friends
entries.d: Miyako, a former adult-video actress, was reunited with a former acting partner on a blind date...? Their pure and innocent love for each other, connected by their secret past, is more explosive than you can imagine! You will surely be healed by this cute romantic comedy with a unique twist.

After losing a fight with a runaway truck, a karateka is transmigrated to another world, one full of swords and sorcery straight out of fantasy books. The goddess who sent him there offers him a superpowered cheat skill to assist him in his upcoming heroics⸺but naturally, he turns her down. After all, he already possesses the only technique he needs: karate!

t.n: 乙女男子に恋する乙女

sy: A maiden in love with a man-in-drag
A Maiden in Love with a Maiden Boy
entries.d: Mizuguchi Mayu, a girl who hates men, fell in love at first sight with a... "man-in-drag"!? Does she likes "girls"? Or does she likes "boys"? Find out in this heart throbbing pure love comedy! Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

t.r: Boku no Hero Academia: Yuuei Hakusho
t.n: 僕のヒーローアカデミア 雄英白書
t.u: Boku no Hero Academia: Yuuei Hakusho

entries.d: Prose short stories featuring the everyday school lives of My Hero Academia’s fan-favorite characters. The U.A. High School hero course teaches young hopefuls everything they need to become heroes. Between killer events like the sports festival and internships, there’s even parents’ day! That’s when all the kids get the chance to show their parents what they’re made of! (Source: VIZ Media)

sy: I'll Retire After Saving the World
I Will Save the World And Then Retire
entries.d: The only way out is through. In the midst of a disastrous monster attack fated to end the world, a strange device throws Hee-Jae back in time 20 years where he meets the students of his foster father, Seok-Young. Now it's up to him to take them under his wing and stop the apocalypse so he can finally set off for a peaceful life. (Source: Manta)

t.r: Iki Dekinai no wa Kimi no Sei
t.n: 息できないのは君のせい
t.u: Iki Dekinai no wa Kimi no Sei

sy: It's Your Fault I Can't Breathe
Por tu culpa no puedo respirar
entries.d: Jun Shizuki and Yukiji Yano are both in the same woodwind choir. Shizuki is a bartender who plays the sax and hits on anything that moves. Yano is a gifted flute player who is incredibly nice and is well-regarded within the choir. No one would ever suspect that these guys would have anything in common, but could these two polar opposites actually be in a relationship?!

Yukino Tachibana is a calligraphy prodigy. At the tender age of 16 she is already one of Japan's most exciting young artists, performing live calligraphy demonstrations to sell-out crowds on worldwide tours. With her refined, beautiful, and mysterious air, she is so popular at her new high school that she has earned the appellation of 'The School Madonna'. She is also as dumb as a post.

sy: That Year We... Early Summer Is Great!
entries.d: At Midsummer High, Yeon-Su Guk is at the top of her class, while Wung Choi is ranked dead-last. And it’s not just their grades -- their personalities couldn’t be more different, as Yeon-Su is a no-nonsense stickler and Wung is a care-free slacker.

Sumire wants to experience romance...but will she get the chance, when her new seat-mate is a 20-year-old with swirling rumors surrounding him? A dangerous new romance from the author of Kiss Me at the Stroke of Midnight, Kira-kun Today, and Love's Reach! (Source: Kodansha USA)
A manga adaptation of Adolf Hitler's Mein Kampf.

t.r: Douyara Ore wa Imadoki Gal na Toshiue Osananajimi kara Gekiomo Kanjou wo Mukerareteirurashii
t.n: どうやら俺は今どきギャルな歳上幼馴染から激重感情を向けられているらしい
t.u: Douyara Ore wa Imadoki Gal na Toshiue Osananajimi kara Gekiomo Kanjou wo Mukerareteirurashii

entries.d: Yuito Kujo, a high school student, constantly compares himself to his exceptional older brother and sees himself as a lesser, "degraded version." Caught in a spiral of self-deprecation, his adolescence turns even darker when he discovers that his childhood crush, Suzuno, is in love with his older brother.

t.r: Tokyo卍Revengers: Baji Keisuke Kara no Tegami
t.e: Tokyo Revengers: A Letter from Keisuke Baji
t.n: 東京卍リベンジャーズ　～場地圭介からの手紙～
t.u: Tokyo卍Revengers: Baji Keisuke Kara no Tegami

sy: Tokyo卍Revengers: A Letter from Keisuke Baji
Tokyo Revengers – List od Keisuke Bajiego
Tokyo Revengers. Carta de Keisuke Baji
entries.d: The Tokyo Manji motorcycle gang has carved out a reputation as the toughest band of delinquents in Tokyo. No matter who stands against them in a fight, no matter how bad the odds, Toman always emerges undefeated. Yet its members all carry the scars of “Bloody Halloween,” the night when a showdown with a rival gang saw their First Division Captain, Keisuke Baji, get senselessly murdered.

t.n: みなと商事コインランドリー

entries.d: "Minato-san, I have a sex drive." When Akira Minato inherits an old, run-down laundromat from his grandfather, he sees it as an opportunity to recover from his grueling corporate job and spend his days in laid-back leisure. But all that changes when a new customer comes knocking—one who's maybe a bit too good-looking.

Yamada is a castaway on an island without any ships passing by and he is unable to recall why he is there. After finding his sports bag, he assumes he was on a school trip. With only 7 days worth of food, he eventually decides to make a boat to leave the island. He thought he was alone on the island until finding a girl named Imaise Chika eating his food. Volume 3 contains chapter 30.5.

t.r: SSS-geup Teukseongeul Badatjiman Jeokdanghi Salgo Sipda
t.e: The Carefree Life of an SSS-Class Knight
t.n: SSS급 특성을 받았지만 적당히 살고 싶다
t.u: SSS-geup Teukseongeul Badatjiman Jeokdanghi Salgo Sipda

sy: I have an SSS-rank Trait, but I want a Normal Life
entries.d: The world now swarms with supernatural beings called Celestials and the Awakened, people with newfound special powers. But none of this means anything to Yoo Sungwon, an ordinary man trying to live an ordinary life. Unfortunately for him, his peaceful days end when he gets a mysterious text and becomes a rare SSS-class knight with perks to die for.

t.n: さよならピアノソナタ

entries.d: Enter Hikawa Naomi, son of a music critic and Ebisawa Mafuyu, a young prodigy pianist who suddenly disappeared from the music world. Together they formed a rockband with members involved in classical and rock music.

Kate is a maid at the Baron's estate in Muiella, a country where warlocks and witches are shunned. One day, the new servant Ian arrives… but he's much too proper and handsome for his lowly rank. As they keep running into each other, Kate's suspicion of Ian's disarming demeanor only grows when strange incidents crop up in the manor.

High schooler Hajime Tsukiyoda went to Shibuya that day hoping only to find inspiration for his next film. he never expected to find himself smack-dab in the middle of a real-life horror movie. Without warning, schools of massive goldfish descend upon the crowded streets, and the mystified onlookers' confusion quickly turns to terror as the fish begin to feed.

t.r: Gaikotsu to Koi wa Dekiru no ka?
t.n: 骸骨と恋はできるのか？
t.u: Gaikotsu to Koi wa Dekiru no ka?

sy: Can you fall in love with the skeleton?

t.n: フルメタル・パニック! Σ

entries.d: Tells the same story as Full Metal Panic Second Raid and is as such, also based on the novels The End Of Day By Day. Leaving off after the original series, this series tells of Sousuke and Mithril as they fight Amalgam. Like the original series, but both sides have gotten a bit more aggressive...

t.n: いちばんうしろの大魔王

entries.d: The story of "love, magic, and battles" revolves around Akuto Sai, a boy who aims to become part of his country's highest order of magicians and contribute to society as one of its clergy.

t.n: 合鍵くんと幸せごはん

entries.d: Nagisa, an office worker, ends up (almost) living together with Hiro, a long-distance driver. Food tastes even better than usual with "Aikagi-kun" and his big appetite. The casual time they spend together begins to color their days... A heartwarming story about a thirty-something office worker and a younger man (almost) living together!

The story revolves around Haruki and his four sisters: Mutsuki, Yayoi, Uzuki, and Satsuki. While their life may seem monotonous—aside from the fact that Haruki's sisters don't give him a single opportunity to rest, lecturing him about every perceived mistake and playing tricks on him—Haruki still likes his life.

Essie Ash can see how and when people will die. One day, she finds an injured man in her backyard and discovers that he is Prince Pell. To her shock, she notices that her parents' and other residents' death dates have moved up since Pell's arrival. Essie asks him to leave, hoping things will change, but changes her mind when Pell saves her from his brother's assassins.

Baili Jin, a fairy who was living in heaven, eating and drinking without a care, broke her Majesty’s colourful, stained-glass plate at her birthday and got banished to the mortal realm. Now she has to begin her adventures in the mortal realm with all of her spiritual powers gone! In order to survive, the former fairy has to deliver take-out....
Shuu Kaidou is sent away to an all boys boarding school with a very strange rule: half the students must take turns to dress as girls!

t.r: Succubus ni Tensei shita node Milk wo Shiborimasu
t.n: サキュバスに転生したのでミルクをしぼります
t.u: Succubus ni Tensei shita node Milk wo Shiborimasu

sy: Because I Reincarnated as a Succubus
entries.d: To drown men into dazzling pleasure and show them their loved ones in their dreams, that is a succubus. Due to an accident, a young 17 years old boy named Riichi Hourai is reincarnated into a succubus due to a misunderstanding by the Reincarnation Support Department.

Having fought his way into the top grade of Mechanical Martial Arts, Levius faces an ever-changing world that grows more threatening by the day. The shadowy megacorporation Amethyst wields its military might across the world through advancements in the arena. Can Levius be the fighter who changes the course of the world’s fate? (Source: VIZ Media)

t.n: スピリット・マイグレーション

entries.d: A spirit was floating in another world's dungeon, missing its memories. Eventually "he" learned to possess other creatures and using the bodies of the beasts in the dungeon, made his way to the outside world. Dragging a young female knight, a pretty young lady, and even a beautiful mercenary into the mix, our protagonist begins his great adventure in this world!

sy: The Genius Who Sees Through the World
The Genius Who Reads the World
entries.d: As a child, Shin Woo-Jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people.

Humans may be considered at the top of the food chain, but when people are in the presence of cockroaches, they cower in fear. Who can they turn to when faced with these insects? The Gokiburi Busters, who have yet to fail to eliminate a threat!

As the saying goes - never judge a book by its cover. Da-Im is a lovely elementary school teacher, as well as a savage who can rip anyone apart with the fiercest comebacks. On-Gyum is a florist with a heart of gold, who often gets misunderstood because of his intimidating looks. But as incompatible as they seem, their shared love of cats starts pulling the unlikely pair closer together...

Growing up a target of bullying, a senior high student, Shiroishi Hajime, is a skilled karateka, but goes completely weak at the knees with fear when it comes to fighting. Among all this, a power junkie and classmate of Ichi who does nothing but fighting, Akakuma Dai, sets his eyes on Ichi. When Ichi starts to shed tears, all of a sudden a violent impulse that resided inside him is unleashed.

The kingdom of Dowa, which is subdivided into 13 states, is celebrating its monarch's 99th birthday. These thirteen states have many agencies that are controlled by the giant organization known as ACCA. Within ACCA, Jean Otis is the second-in-command of the inspection agency. His agency has 10 people placed in each of the 13 states, with a central office in the capital city.

It's been a few months since the neighborhood Chinese restaurant closed down, and when I stopped by for the first time in a while, I found that it had been transformed into a flashy, mysterious restaurant with its old signboard still intact. When I went inside, there was a gal there... This is a story about a Chinatown restaurant where gals are hospitable.

Dakyung Lee, an elite member of a criminal organization, learns of the death of her beloved boss. Upon discovering that Chairman Lee was behind it, she vows to take revenge. Yet, since he’s protected by the Sa Yeong Group, all her attempts appear futile. Just as Dakyung is about to give up, she uncovers details about the chairman’s son.

"Hey, don't get confused. I've never thought of you as my little brother. You don't even know your right place." That was the dagger that hurt the most. Myeong-U Han. A child of a wealthy family with a quick mind. But God didn't give him everything. A near incurable genetic heart disease. He did his best in order to earn the respect of the people around him.
More collections of chilling short stories dealing with urban legends, ghosts and superstitions all organized around a specific theme (School, Visitors etc.).

t.r: Butsuri-san de Musou shitetara Motemote ni Narimashita
t.n: 物理さんで無双してたらモテモテになりました
t.u: Butsuri-san de Musou shitetara Motemote ni Narimashita

entries.d: His harem consists of demi-human girls?! I was forced to withdraw from my world to learn magic with an alchemist, and while learning, I come upon a moment that only with my eyes could make any girl fall in love. (Source: Japanese Publisher, translated)

t.n: くれよん・でいず~大キライなアイツ~

entries.d: Because she loved drawing and wanted to do something special, she went to a famous art school. And there she met... (Source: Chibi Manga)

t.n: 江口くんは見逃さない

entries.d: Eguchi Hajime is a normal primary school boy you can find anywhere, but compared to his peers he is a little different. No slightly erotic moment of daily life, no matter how small can escape the attention of his eyes. Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
Mio and Subaru live together in a small apartment avoiding attention. While they masquerade as siblings with an age gap, Subaru holds a secret. Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

t.r: Kumo desu ga, Nani ka?: Kumoko Sisters no Nichijou
t.e: So I'm a Spider, So What? The Daily Lives of the Kumoko Sisters
t.n: 蜘蛛ですが、なにか？ 蜘蛛子四姉妹の日常
t.u: Kumo desu ga, Nani ka?: Kumoko Sisters no Nichijou

sy: Kumo Desu ga, Nani ka? Daily Life of the Four Spider Sisters
Ich bin eine Spinne, na und? - Die vier Schwestern
entries.d: I was a normal highschool girl but then I was reincarnated as a monster spider in a parallel world. To survive in this labyrinth full of monsters, I used a skill " Parallel Will" and split my mind in 4 but now each will has their own body ... ?

Inamine-kun, an aspiring young manga artist, is a total failure at whatever he does, but some of his work has caught the eyes of a busty beautiful mysterious editor from a B-rate magazine. Will he turn around his fortunes through her? Will he form a relationship between boss and subordinate? Read Koimoku and find out!

My name is Rosaria von Valencia, but I didn't always have this name. According to a book I read, I'm supposed to be murdered in place of the saint, Cordelia, just because I look like her. I decided to run away to avoid ever meeting my future killer, Duke Valencia, but ended up running into him as he was on the brink of death.

While working as a small supporting actor in a movie, Ki Man-Seong has nothing else going for him. However, that was when, through mysterious circumstances, the movie set had become reality during filming. With the sound of the director’s cut, during that short take, he’s not an actor but actually thrown into the events occurring, showing the pain and emotions he faces at that moment.
Set during the Goryeo military regime, a hero that arises from a slave to be reborn as a general.

He stood at the pinnacle of the world. Surpassing all since birth in the art of the sword. But fate has left him crippled moments before reaching the apex. But the story continues and the legend will rise again... (Source: Mangatoon)

t.r: Mendokusagari Danshi ga Asa Okitara Onnanoko ni Natteita Hanashi
t.n: めんどくさがり男子が朝起きたら女の子になっていた話
t.u: Mendokusagari Danshi ga Asa Okitara Onnanoko ni Natteita Hanashi

entries.d: Published version of the original Pixiv doujinshi. After a guy wakes up as a girl one morning, his roommate wants him to turn back. Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

sy: I Have to Be a Monster
entries.d: Xiao Qiu anonymously defended humanity with all his strength, but he remained unappreciated and misunderstood by everyone. After a life of tragedy, he died and was reborn. This time, he will discard his humanity, and begin his journey to become an unrepentant monster. (Source: Bilibili, translated)
Moe confesses to Yuuka who rejects her harshly in a haughty manner different from her usual "good girl" personality... but Moe seemed to enjoy it?

From the perspective of an alien planet with super-advanced technology and tiny (1/60th the size of a human) inhabitants, planet Earth was the perfect location to banish their worst criminals. Five of said criminals were sent to the planet to be exiled, attached to little critters like frogs and rabbits so they can never be fully active.

Exorcists Gotsuji and Uruka spend their days exorcising evil spirits on request, inching ever closer to their goal: to cut down a specific spirit as a means of mourning the woman it killed. Uruka, mystified by Gotsuji's actions, accompanies him in his quest for revenge, but where will their journey lead...? Bunny outfits or traditional garb—doesn't matter! Just cut those spirits down!

Branded as a cursed child, Princess Osiria spent most of her life locked in an attic. In actuality, Osiria is the divinely chosen, the one who could’ve saved the empire of Trionfo. Instead, she was sold to a neighboring kingdom and left in the care of Sir Fedelius, a handsome young knight. Although her heart beats faster when Fedelius is around, she doesn’t plan on staying for long.

t.n: 異世界転生…されてねぇ!

entries.d: Kosuke Yuki, an ordinary high school boy on his first day of school, He saved an old man (actually God) who was almost hit by a train and died. As an apology, he was supposed to be reincarnated in another world with God's cheat powers, But he was accidentally sent back to the real world. ...... cheating ability as it is.

A collection of stories: 1-3. The Heart of Miscalculation "Why don't you date me?" And that's how Miki started going out with Udou, from next door's classroom, who was fighting with his ex-girlfriend. It was because of a whim, just a "game". But being with Udou, he started getting comfortable? During the sex, Udou took control of him with tricks, making him tremble in pleasure.

t.r: Ore ga Kokuhaku Sarete Kara, Ojou no Yousu ga Okashii.
t.n: 俺が告白されてから、お嬢の様子がおかしい。
t.u: Ore ga Kokuhaku Sarete Kara, Ojou no Yousu ga Okashii.

sy: After I Was Confessed to, the Young Lady Looked Strange
entries.d: Hoshine, the super high-spirited young lady of the Tendou family, has had feelings for Kageito, her servant, ever since she was a child. One day, she overhears another girl in her class confessing her feelings to Kageito! The moment she heard that… her attack on Kageito begins, using all of her skills (physical, intellectual, financial, and a woman's sixth sense)....

t.n: フランケンシュタイン

entries.d: Junji Ito meets Mary Shelley! The master of horror manga bends all his skill into bringing the anguished and solitary monster—and the fouler beast who created him—to life with the brilliantly detailed chiaroscuro he is known for. (Source: VIZ media)

A beautiful transcendent Ichika just entered high school but since then, she hasn’t talked to anyone since she’s so shy. One day, out of bad luck the rumored former Yankee Yotsuya Takuya, decided to talk to her out of the blue behind the school and for some reason went to karaoke together… “I want to return the lost item I picked up.

t.r: Moto Ansatsusha, Tensei Shite Kizoku no Reijou ni Narimashita.
t.n: 元暗殺者、転生して貴族の令嬢になりました。
t.u: Moto Ansatsusha, Tensei Shite Kizoku no Reijou ni Narimashita.

sy: A Former Assassin Was Reborn as a Noble's Daughter
entries.d: The story is about Serena, a former assassin who was reincarnated as a duke's daughter after failing her mission. She initially thought that pretending to be a noble would be easy, but she struggled with the gap in perception between herself and her mother, who had a flighty personality, and her adoptive sister, who deceived those around her in an attempt to push Serena out of the picture.

t.r: Gariben Jimi Moe Reijou wa, Ore-sama Ouji nado Oyobi denai
t.e: The Lady Likes a Nerd over Princes
t.n: ガリ勉地味萌え令嬢は、俺様王子などお呼びでない
t.u: Gariben Jimi Moe Reijou wa, Ore-sama Ouji nado Oyobi denai

entries.d: Cheerful and free-spirited Sharina first met the studious and somber Riol when he saved her from mortal danger, and she fell in love with him at first sight. Using the adage, “the way to a man’s heart is through his stomach,” Sharina makes Riol homemade food in hopes it will get him to fall in love with her too.

t.e: Fairy Tail S: Tales from Fairy Tail

entries.d: Compilation of side stories not included in the main entry. Volume 1 1. Aoneko Happy (あおネコハッピー); Doujinshi, Pray for Japan (2011) 2. Yousei-tachi no Batsu-game (妖精たちの罰ゲーム); Magazine Special 2013-08 3. Okaeri, Frosch (おかえり、フロッシュ); Bessatsu Shounen Magazine 2014-04 4. 413 Days (413DAYS); Magazine Special 2014-04 5. Sono Onna, Erza (その女、エルザ); Young Magazine 2014 #18 6. Natsu vs. Mavis (ナツ vs.

t.n: 私の可愛い子猫ちゃん

entries.d: Rena and Yuna have been roommates since school, and decided to rent a place together after graduation. They’ve lived together as friends for five years, but things suddenly change the day Yuna adopts a kitten, even though their apartment doesn’t allow pets.

sy: I will be waiting for you in 1999
entries.d: I want to protect you forever... Because you and I have no other loved ones in this world. The coming-of-age story of two orphans who become best friends.

t.n: 少年のアビス 番外編

entries.d: In a world where opposites attract, a chance encounter sparks a connection between a serious black-haired girl and a charismatic blond delinquent, painting a cute tale of young love and friendships. As the series unfolds, their seemingly carefree lives take unexpected turns, delving into the shadows that haunt their lives.

Prepare for a full dive! Even in the future, all the advances and innovation in the world can't change the dynamics of the school playground. And for Haruyuki Arita, a fat kid in junior high, that means he's destined to always be at the bottom of the food chain, prime pickings for the school bullies.

Takato Kei is just an ordinary college student, training for an ordinary life, when he falls into a strange and appealing part-time job.
