He’s been hired to tutor a teenage girl at home for 10,000 yen an hour! The girl in question, Fujioka Yukari, is not a high school student, but a highly successful day trader who has already amassed 170 billion yen!

Yamanaka Suguru always viewed his "first times" as challenges to overcome. But when a girl suddenly confessed to him and become his girlfriend, she introduced him to countless new challenges that he's never known about. (Source: Comikey) Note: The chapter count includes 3 extra chapters.

GE: Good Ending is a one shot that follows main character Utsumi's interactions with Kurokawa Yuki, a member of the school tennis team, in order for Utsumi to confess his feelings to the captain of the tennis team. It is implied that the title of the manga is derived from the "good endings" that are achieved in visual novels.

Primabelle is astonished when she wakes up to find herself in a novel of her own creation as an obscure painter who gets killed by the male protagonist, Prince Rainsis. The world she created has not been kind to Rainsis.

t.r: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 3-bu - Ryoushu no Youjo
t.n: 本好きの下剋上~司書になるためには手段を選んでいられません~第三部「領主の養女」
t.u: Honzuki no Gekokujou: Shisho ni Naru Tame ni wa Shudan wo Erandeiraremasen Dai 3-bu - Ryoushu no Youjo

entries.d: Part 3 of Honzuki no Gekokujou. Following a disastrous encounter with a noble, Myne finally resolves to say goodbye to her family and friends in the lower city, changing her name to “Rozemyne” and beginning her new life as the adopted daughter of Ehrenfest’s archduke.

t.n: ハイリスクミッションセラピー

entries.d: Iori Kandono is suffering from a new illness called Monderella Syndrome, thanks to which she would suddenly experience severe pain in her chest. To make the pain go away, she can either take the medicine or get a massage by a male person.

The story is set in Meiro-chou, a town where all-female diviners (uranaishi) live and where girls from all over the country yearn to become the top diviner — "Urara." Today, a solitary girl named Chiya enters the town's gates. However, she has another purpose coming here, besides becoming the Urara.

Heli Yun, notorious degenerate, shocks everyone by suddenly turning from his lowlife ways. No one realizes he's been possessed by Lee Siwoon, the author of Heli's story! Trapped in the martial arts novel he wrote, Heli knows that unless he gains power, he's headed for a villain's death.

So you’ve decided to forget about your high-school crush after graduation, going on to college without ever telling them how you felt. That’s the plan for quiet college freshman Mae-Hwa Yang. But even the best laid plans can go astray, as Mae-Hwa discovers when he learns that his crush, Jae-Won Myeong, goes to the same college!
Ray and Trice grew up together in this post apocalyptic world. She was his only friend. But then one day... An unwelcome guest arrives and proclaims "Glory to Humans"... Includes chapter 0.

Wazu was an ordinary townsman who shut himself off in the “mountain” because of an unfortunate course of events. After 2 years, he decided to come down from the mountain to meet with people. But there were various misunderstanding about the “mountain” which he shut himself off in. And then he repeatedly had encounters with people. And after that...

t.r: Ringoku kara Kita Yome ga Kawaisugite Doushiyou.
t.n: 隣国から来た嫁が可愛すぎてどうしよう。
t.u: Ringoku kara Kita Yome ga Kawaisugite Doushiyou.

entries.d: With his brash personality and muscular physique, and his fierce presence fighting against his country's foes, Salyu is known as the “Winter Bear of Tidros." Until one day when he finds himself engaged to Citron, a young lady whose betrothal was broken off in a neighboring country! Starting with a kiss on the forehead, he fidgets awkwardly around this unfamiliar woman.

A secret relationship with a mysterious entity... In a world with demonic monsters called Shenguai, a young orphan named Kou lives alone in the mountains with a mysterious Shenguai named Chiyou. But Chiyou has a tragic past, and Kou will have to give all of himself in order to save her. A beautiful East Asian adventure now begins! (Source: MANGA Plus)

sy: The Chick Hunter Is Being Filial!
The Chick Class Hunter Is Being Filial!
entries.d: At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited.

t.r: Kami no Techigai de Shindara Cheat Gun Zumi de Isekai ni Hourikomaremashita
t.n: 神の手違いで死んだらチートガン積みで異世界に放り込まれました
t.u: Kami no Techigai de Shindara Cheat Gun Zumi de Isekai ni Hourikomaremashita

entries.d: Tomoya Sadoshima died after a serious accident after returning to a convenience store. Then, after regaining consciousness in a pure white world, a woman of divine beauty emerged, she introduces herself as "The Goddess of Creation." The goddess of creation prepared a remedy for her suffering, she offers him to reincarnate a different world than his own.

On a school trip to shinobi-themed Ninjatown, a young man named Ichi Kuno accidentally springs a mystical ninja trap which sends him back to the Age of the Ninja. Having no other path, he must pose as a girl and infiltrate an Kurenai Academy, a school of kunoichi students, to retrieve a mystical scroll that can return him to the future.

Direct sequel to the first Rozen Maiden series though still named the same. Jun is an adult in college trying to live his life after a hikikomori youth. He has a job at a convenience store and is the subject of much ridicule. One day a magazine is mistakenly sent to the store. A magazine entitled "How to Make a Girl".

Traversing into another world, Zhang Xuan finds himself becoming an honorable teacher. Along with his transcension, a mysterious library appears in his mind. As long as it is something he has seen, regardless of whether it is a human or an object, a book on its weaknesses will be automatically compiled in the library. Thus, he becomes formidable.

t.n: 魔法使いと赤のピルグリム

sy: The Wizard and the Red Pilgrim
entries.d: Haukatul, a wizard who only talks, and Beni, an innocent girl.The two meet in a world overrun by wizards who kill for blood. Haukatul, who is always hungry, and Beni, who has nothing but her name, set out on a journey with no destination. But it is a world full of cruelty and love... (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated)

t.n: マーメイドメロディーぴちぴちピッチ

entries.d: Lucia is the new girl at school. She and her sister run a public bath that's all the rage. When Lucia meets a terrific-looking surfer boy, there's just one little problem: Lucia is a mermaid-not just any mermaid, but a princess on an important mission to save the seven seas from an evil force bent on taking control of the marine world. Such a responsibility doesn't leave much time for romance.
Meguru Ukiyo has fallen for his childhood friend, Sara Tatsumi. One day, he stumbles across a white snake that…says it can see the future?! (Source: Manga Plus)

t.r: Roku Hime wa Kami Goei ni Koi wo Suru: Saikyou no Shugo Kishi, Tensei Shite Mahou Gakuen ni Iku
t.e: The God-Tier Guardian and the Love of Six Princesses
t.n: 六姫は神護衛に恋をする　～最強の守護騎士、転生して魔法学園に行く～
t.u: Roku Hime wa Kami Goei ni Koi wo Suru: Saikyou no Shugo Kishi, Tensei Shite Mahou Gakuen ni Iku

sy: Six Princesses Fall in Love With God Guardian
entries.d: In order to stay by the side of his liege, Arsmeria, the devoted knight Vance chose to reincarnate with her a thousand years into the future. In his new life he’s known as Lloyd, the foster son of Countess Myuria and the wielder of colorless magic.

t.r: NARUTO Gaiden: Michita Tsuki ga Terasu Michi
t.e: Naruto: The Path Lit by the Full Moon
t.n: NARUTO-ナルト-外伝 ～満ちた月が照らす道～
t.u: NARUTO Gaiden: Michita Tsuki ga Terasu Michi

sy: NARUTO Side Story: The Road Illuminated by the Full Moon
entries.d: A side story telling the back story of Boruto's teammate, Mitsuki, including his mysterious relation to Orochimaru.

t.n: ライフ・イス・マネー

entries.d: One billion, and death ...? To get a surgical bed for his sister, Meguru has chosen to participate in an underground community. Between illegal gambling and games, he will participate in a nightmare. (Source: GanGan Online)

t.r: Haru Tsuzuru, Sakura Saku Kono Heya de
t.n: 春綴る、桜咲くこの部屋で
t.u: Haru Tsuzuru, Sakura Saku Kono Heya de

sy: Composing Spring in This Room Where Cherry Blossoms Bloom
entries.d: On her first day of university, Haruki had a fateful encounter with Sakura in the lecture hall. They were attracted to each other and lived together after graduation, but suddenly they had to part ways. Sakura had disappeared from this world. Five years have passed since then, and it is the fifth cherry blossom season. Haruki, who was still in a state of grief, happened to find a diary.

t.n: ポケットモンスターSPECIAL: ルビー・サファイア

entries.d: This chapter features the journeys of Ruby and Sapphire who are trying to conquer all the Pokémon Contests and Gyms in Hoenn respectively within the span of 80 days. However, this gets interrupted by two new evil organizations, the land-loving Team Magma and the sea-loving Team Aqua. Sapphire and Ruby have to worry about something else, too: their feelings for each other. (Source: Bulbapedia)

t.e: Isabella Bird in Wonderland: Unbeaten Tracks in Japan

entries.d: British adventuress Isabella Bird journeys to Japan in 1878 and becomes the first Westerner to travel to many remote locations, heading northward towards Hokkaido to study the aboriginal Ainu people. A true story based on the book "Unbeaten Tracks in Japan".

A new adventure that follows Alex, the eldest son of Duchess Edna and Duke Eli, as he sets out to experience the world on his own. While gathering his travel companions, Alex feels strangely drawn to a shabby young boy named Kenny, not realizing that they’ve met before.

Tsukimiya is a dutiful kid who has been looking after his family since his mother's passing, and a popular pretty boy at school, but he rejects all those who confess to him due to an unrequited love he holds for one of his teachers. However he suddenly finds himself kidnapped by a group of beautiful women, who promise him a life of daily torture from now on.

t.n: 恐ろしい殺し屋と拾われた少女

sy: A Terrible Hitman & Picked Up Girl
entries.d: A homeless girl is rescued and brought home by a Hitman. He then helps her out and gives her a place to live. Compiled version contains two omake chapters and a special chapter.

Her blood runs hot, and her temper is even hotter – even when it’s the cold of winter. To lift the flaming curse she’s carried since she was a little girl, high schooler Ember must find her cold equivalent… But finding a match whose blood runs as cold as her’s does hot isn’t going to be easy, especially when the only way to turn the powerful curse away is to KISS that person right on their frigid …

t.r: "Mou.... Hatarakitakunai ndesu" Boukensha nanka Yamete yaru. Imasara, Taiguu wo Kaerukara to Onegai sarete mo Okotowari desu. Boku wa Zettai Hatarakimasen.
t.e: I... Don't Want to Work Anymore. I Quit Being an Adventurer For Good and You Can't Stop Me.
t.n: 『もう‥‥働きたくないんです』冒険者なんか辞めてやる。今更、待遇を変えるからとお願いされてもお断りです。僕はぜーったい働きません。
t.u: "Mou.... Hatarakitakunai ndesu" Boukensha nanka Yamete yaru. Imasara, Taiguu wo Kaerukara to Onegai sarete mo Okotowari desu. Boku wa Zettai Hatarakimasen.

entries.d: Ex, an E-rank adventurer, makes a decision one day after five years of slaving away at the guild. "I'm quitting this job!" Ex was belittled for only being able to use beginner magic, but as it turns out, it had a special trait... Even if people threaten him or ask him to do anything, it's too late for them. "I'm neeeever gonna work anymore!" (Source: Manga UP!)

Thanks to the scar on my face and I guess my “vibe,” I always thought I, Qi Shi (Hiro Qi), would end up forever alone. That is until Nan Jue (Duke Nan) made his way into my life! He’s the classmate I saved from bullies (which led to my scar) and it turns out this cheerful, friendly guy works as a wellness guru.

It’s 1935 in Gyeongseong, and struggling artist I-Ho Yun has been commissioned by the reclusive, elderly Madam Jeong-Hwa Song to paint a portrait. Madam Jeong-Hwa Song allows I-Ho to set eyes upon her -- an unprecedented event -- and standing before him is a young woman. But why does she ask him to paint an elderly version of her?

sy: ALICE อลิสบนเส้นทางมรณะ
entries.d: The manga follows "another Alice," a female high school student who curses her everyday life. When by chance she loses her way on the "Borderroad," she is forced to participate in deadly survival games with other female high school students. (Source: Anime News Network)

t.n: 元ヤンパパとヒツジ先生

entries.d: In high school, studious Hitsuji had a secret crush on one of his guy friends–a friendly delinquent named Hatoyama–but never confessed. Years later, Hitsuji is a slightly anxious but responsible adult who found his calling as an elementary school teacher. One of his young students is upset with a sloppy and nonconformist dad–who turns out to be Hatoyama!

t.r: Shiou no Kikan: Moto Yuusha no Ore, Jibun ga Soshiki Shita Chuuni Himitsu Kessha o Tomeru tame ni Futatabi Isekai ni Shoukan Sareteshimau
t.n: 屍王の帰還　～元勇者の俺、自分が組織した厨二秘密結社を止めるために再び異世界に召喚されてしまう～
t.u: Shiou no Kikan: Moto Yuusha no Ore, Jibun ga Soshiki Shita Chuuni Himitsu Kessha o Tomeru tame ni Futatabi Isekai ni Shoukan Sareteshimau

sy: The Return of the Corpse King
entries.d: "How can my past self get so excited doing all those embarrassing things!?" When he was in the third year of middle school, Hizaki Shiou was summoned to another world to save it. After defeating the Demon King, he was forcibly returned back to the present day.

“I didn’t follow you, you came next to me.” Ian Gloucester, a paladin of the religious country 'Derwin', secretly traces the source of the rumor for Cardinal Heron, who took him away when he was a child, when rumors of preparations for war in 'Arcaia', a great country with a peace treaty, circulate.

With all his memories wiped out, Jesse wakes up in the hospital and in front of him stands a man that suggests he's Jesse's lover. However, the only fragmented memory Jesse has of that man is him trying to kill Jesse. But is his fragile memory reliable? Who's telling the truth and what is actually going on? Why was he in the hospital to begin with?

sy: Ms. Vampire who lives in my neighborhood
entries.d: High school girl Akari was lost in a forest when she was rescued by a vampire girl named Sophie. Since then, Akari has developed a liking for Sophie, who prefers to be alone. Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

t.e: Witches Are In Their Prime In Their Three-Hundreds

entries.d: Once, Kurokawa Mikage was the fearful “Witch of Moonlight,” but now, 300 years later, she’s just an office lady and teased by her co-workers for still being single. Mikage thinks she’s fine with her ultimate spinster life, posting fake photos of a pretend relationship… Until the young and handsome Kobayashi Satoru joins her company! Is this the start of a real, bewitching romance at last!?

After losing her parents at an early age, noble lady Elissa Lohengrin is brought into the powerful House Rubelin by the duke so that she can marry his grandson, Richard. However, having read this story in her past life, Elissa knows Richard is destined to murder her! To avoid this, Elissa makes a deal with Richard to divorce when they become adults.

t.e: Cupid is Struck by Lightning: Second Strike
t.n: キューピッドに落雷 追撃

entries.d: When Su Xiaobai is dying from an illness, he accidentally comes to another world with the remaining soul of Long Ming, Star King, the strongest human in this world, in his body. He gains the strongest ability called "Infinity of Darkness" at the price of feeling terrible pain whenever he gets an erection.

t.r: Zelda no Densetsu: Yottsu no Tsurugi+
t.e: The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords
t.u: Zelda no Densetsu: Yottsu no Tsurugi+

sy: The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords +
The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords Adventure
The Legend of Zelda: Four Swords Plus
entries.d: On a stormy night, Princess Zelda and the shrine maidens fear that the reason for these events is that Vaati's seal is weakening. She summons Link and brings him to the castle so he can protect her and the other maidens while they open the portal to the Four Sword Sanctuary. When they do, however, a shadowy figure appears from the portal.

Maeda Gin is a student who enjoys drawing graffitis at an abandoned apartment complex building near his school, with his friends and acolytes, Teppei and Kon-chan. One night, while they're at work on one of their masterpieces, they're interrupted by a mysterious ghastly pale-skinned woman who scares them.

Ryou Sagimiya has a rare condition called TSS, Transsexual Syndrome. While touring Tensei Academy, Ryou meets Nagisa Minakami, another student with TSS, and decides to enroll in the school. Note: Includes six extra chapters.

t.r: Koi to Yobu ni wa Sasayaka desu ga
t.n: 恋と呼ぶにはささやかですが
t.u: Koi to Yobu ni wa Sasayaka desu ga

sy: It's Not Quite Love Yet, but...
entries.d: High school girl Umi Sayama is placed in the care of the neighboring Hiroi family while her mother is away on a long business trip. The Hiroi household is home to Shouya, a guy eight years older than her. Umi admires him, and her heart races at their long-awaited reunion. But the Shouya she encounters is completely different from the one in her memories...

sy: The Dragon, the Hero, and the Courier
entries.d: "Hello fellow citizens. I am Yoshida the half-elf, working for the post office of the Imperial City of Idazig. My job is to deliver letters and documents to wherever you need them to be, whether it be a castle in the sky or the bottom of an abyss." This is a comedy written by the biggest Medieval Ages geek, hitting the fantasy genre from an entirely new angle!

Hello, viewers! Welcome to the world of monsters, where certain people are awakened with specific characteristics and can become hunters. But our MC, Si-U, was awakened with absolutely no characteristics. How useless! Just when he'd lost hope... Ding!

t.r: Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai
t.e: My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me!
t.n: 友達の妹が俺にだけウザい
t.u: Tomodachi no Imouto ga Ore ni dake Uzai

sy: My Friend's Little Sister is Annoying Only Towards Me
entries.d: If a girl teases you, that means she likes you! Unfortunately, Akiteru knows from experience that isn't the case. Because every girl he interacts with shows him nothing but scorn, and he's not scored a single date from it! Luckily, he's more concerned with securing a spot for him and his game-development buddies at his uncle's business.

t.e: Adopted by a Murderous Duke Family

sy: Adoptée par la famille des Assassins
entries.d: After ten years of being exploited by Duke Gerwehr for her healing powers, Agnes meets her death in a dungeon. When she wakes up, she finds herself in her uncle’s house before she was sold to Duke Gerwehr in the slave market. Desperate for her past life not to repeat itself, she lets Duke Rodwick adopt her and starts her new life with a new name, Tuariche Rodwick.

t.e: Can't Take My Eyes Off You!

entries.d: Taeho’s barely scraping by after moving out of his parent’s home when he catches just the lucky break he needs: an easy, overpaid job as the manager of top celebrity, Wooyeon (overpaid being the key word here). The job starts to take a weird turn when Taeho notices that people tend to like Wooyeon a little too much... Fans are one thing, but the adoration Wooyeon ignites is something else.

Let's go exploring with a cute girl!! A landscape painted by the beautiful stroke of a paintbrush can be found anywhere!! An exploration manga filled with comedy that will make you say, "Let's go there tomorrow!" Note: Chapter count includes 5 extra chapters.

sy: Aragane no Ko: Diamante en Bruto
Diamond in the Rough - Vom Schicksal geschliffen
entries.d: A world where "stone" is at the center. Akaboshi, an ore craftsman visits an underground village and meets a boy whose left foot is petrified. The boy's goal is to find the man with a three-line piercing but he holds a secret...?! The two of them set off on a journey to save his family! (Source: MANGA Plus)

t.r: Beelzebub-jou no Oki ni Mesu Mama.
t.n: ベルゼブブ嬢のお気に召すまま。
t.u: Beelzebub-jou no Oki ni Mesu Mama.

entries.d: Beelzebub--the formidable right hand of Satan--commands fear and respect throughout Pandemonium. What her underlings don't realize, though, is that she's an airhead with a love for all that is fluffy and adorable! The only thing she might enjoy more is teasing her new attendant, Mullin, who is learning that serving Beelzebub is both heaven and hell... (Source: Yen Press)

A mysterious man known as "the King of Death" roams the streets of pre-war Shanghai in this action-packed prequel to Fist of the North Star. Shanghai in the 1930s is a dangerous place. Foreign governments and Chinese factions have carved the city into different quarters, each with its own laws and government, and all rife with corruption.

t.e: The Gardener in a Hunter World

entries.d: Jiha is living a relatively quiet life, gathering resources after raids and selling potions from his general store as a worker-class hunter. Little did he know, taking a nap on top of an ancient text would completely change his life.

t.n: アブソリュート・デュオ

entries.d: To avenge the death of his younger sister, Tor Kokonoe enters the prestigious Koryo Academy, a high school dedicated to training its students to wield Blaze—individualized weapons that are manifestations of one’s soul. While the future of a student is often determined by the form their weapon takes, Tor is an Irregular, whose Blaze appears as a shield instead of a melee weapon.

t.r: Attouteki Gacha Un de Isekai wo Nariagaru!
t.n: 圧倒的ガチャ運で異世界を成り上がる！
t.u: Attouteki Gacha Un de Isekai wo Nariagaru!

entries.d: It was a gacha experience in a world of swords and magic that the late Jinta Kazama reincarnated in after an accident. But after the reincarnation, a status abnormality was found. His [Luck] stat had a numerical value of [999,999], when its normal maximum was [99], he has become... The Strongest weapon of mythological grade was won in the first gacha!

t.r: Hazure Skill [Mapping] wo Te ni Shita Shonen ha Saikyou Party to Dungeon ni Idomu
t.e: Mapping: The Trash-Tier Skill That Got Me Into a Top-Tier Party
t.n: 外れスキル【地図化】を手にした少年は最強パーティーとダンジョンに挑む
t.u: Hazure Skill [Mapping] wo Te ni Shita Shonen ha Saikyou Party to Dungeon ni Idomu

entries.d: Note used to dream of becoming a top-tier adventurer, but now he spends his days drinking away his profits at the local tavern and reminiscing about the past. Funny a boy with the Mapping ability could get so lost, huh? That’s right. Note’s dreams of becoming a big name in adventuring died the day he pulled the infamous trash-tier skill Mapping.

t.r: Onna ga Nigate na Yankee to Shoujo no Hanashi
t.n: 女が苦手なヤンキーと少女の話
t.u: Onna ga Nigate na Yankee to Shoujo no Hanashi

sy: Tale of a Girl and a Delinquent Who's Bad with Women
entries.d: A "delinquent" who freezes up and says violent things when around women meets a small girl in the library when he's out studying. To his surprise, she tutors him, even though an elementary student shouldn't be able to. As it turns out, she's a high school student and his classmate; she's eager to befriend him. Also surprising to him is the fact that he isn't afraid of her.

He knows her secret. She knows his secret too. He is the coolest guy in school. She is the curve wrecker of class. They make a deal in exchange to keep each other's secret. They should be strangers after that promise. But he offers to help her confess to her crush at the same time. Is that true? Is he just teasing her? Or...? (Source: WebComics)

This is Bleach as a different take with him becoming a substitute Soul Reaper thanks to an alien being. It is a simple storyline that revolves around Orihime and her father and after all is said and done, Ichigo goes back to being his normal self.

sy: The Corpse-Picking Genius Warrior in the Broken Game
Cursed Game's Genius Knight That Picking Corpses Up
entries.d: It has already been two years since I possessed a character in this insanely difficult game. In order to go back to Earth, I have no choice but to stop the downfall of this world and reach the ending of this game.

t.n: せいちゃんキャパオーバーです!

sy: Sei-chan, Your Love Is Too Much!
entries.d: When my favorite childhood friend Sei-chan moved in with us, he started teasing me such as pushing me over, sneaking into my room, and taking other liberties! The daily flirting attack from the handsome Sei-chan is too overwhelming!

Akasegawa Naoya's mother remarried recently and he suddenly finds himself trying to get along with his new big sister Amane, a student of the prestigious Kasugano Girls' School. But his new big sister isn't like what you might first expect.

t.r: Kono Sekai no Kouryakuhon wo Hirotteshimaimashita
t.e: I Picked Up This World's Strategy Guide
t.n: この世界の攻略本を拾ってしまいました
t.u: Kono Sekai no Kouryakuhon wo Hirotteshimaimashita

sy: I Picked Up This World's Strategy Guide!
entries.d: Sana is the hardworking daughter of a shop owner, and she often ventures out into the forest to gather the herbs needed for the restorative potions they sell. But on one trip, she happens to pick up a mysterious strategy guide for a game—and it's filled with detailed information about her town, those around her, and even what's yet to come!

After failing his colllege entrance exams a second time, Kawashima is forced to move out of his home and into an apartment complex. No sooner has he moved in does the neighbor girl crash through his wall! Now his apartment is connected to hers, and it looks like his fantasy of meeting a cute high school girl has come true. However, there are some odd things about Imori.

t.r: Inkya no Ore ga Sekigae de S-kyuu Bishoujo ni Kakomaretara Himitsu no Kankei ga Hajimatta
t.n: 陰キャの俺が席替えでS級美少女に囲まれたら秘密の関係が始まった
t.u: Inkya no Ore ga Sekigae de S-kyuu Bishoujo ni Kakomaretara Himitsu no Kankei ga Hajimatta

entries.d: My peaceful school life... is officially over. Izumiya Ryouta, an introverted otaku, suddenly finds himself surrounded by the top three beauties of the class after a seat change. In front of him sits the little-sister-type Miyama Airi. To his left, the cool and detached gyaru, Ichinose Yuria. And to his right, the refined, black-haired class rep, Kuroki Ruri.

sy: Abnormal Immortal Record of Spooky Daoist
entries.d: High schooler Li Huowang can close his eyes and be transported to an uncanny world. Over there, he is a medicine primer who will be made into pills by his "Master" at any given time. Meanwhile, in the real world, Li Huowang is living in a mental hospital, unfit to continue school. The doctor told him that the uncanny world is just his hallucinations. What is real, and what is fake?
A martial arts historical series about a peasant turned samurai and caught in the turmoil of the final year of the Edo Period (1868). Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

t.e: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse

sy: Hiding a Logistics Center in the Apocalypse
entries.d: Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That’s exactly what’s happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world.

t.r: Kono Setsugen de Kimi ga Zutto Waratteirareru You ni
t.n: この雪原で君が笑っていられるように
t.u: Kono Setsugen de Kimi ga Zutto Waratteirareru You ni

sy: Kono Setsugen de Kimi ga Zutto Waratte Irareru you ni
May This Snowfield Keep You Smiling All the Time.
entries.d: Muku Shiroshika’s happy and carefree childhood comes to an abrupt end after her father’s tragic death. In the ten years since, she’s worked a thankless job as a caregiver for her dementia-suffering grandfather. Between taking care of her family, searching for a job, and enduring her grandmother’s constant criticism, Muku finds herself drowning.

t.r: Bungou Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Juugosai
t.e: Bungo Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Age Fifteen
t.n: 文豪ストレイドッグス  太宰, 中也, 十五歳
t.u: Bungou Stray Dogs: Dazai, Chuuya, Juugosai

entries.d: Not long after Ougai Mori takes the reins of the Port Mafia, he orders a young Osamu Dazai to investigate an ominous rumor of something called “Arahabaki.” Whoever or whatever it is seems to have some connection to Mori's deceased predecessor—and the new boss would very much like for the dead to stay buried.
Discover HERO’S, the ultimate crossover in the Hiro Mashima universe, featuring your favorite characters from Mashima-sensei’s past megahits Rave Master, Fairy Tail, and Edens Zero! Yup, it’s true!

t.r: Dakara Boku wa, H ga Dekinai.
t.n: だから僕は、Ｈができない
t.u: Dakara Boku wa, H ga Dekinai.

sy: Dakara Boku wa H ga Dekinai
entries.d: One day, first-class Grim Reaper Lisara, for her own reasons, secretly enters the human world. After searching in vain for her target, Lisara is completely exhausted. That's when Ryosuke Kaga approaches her. To help Lisara out, he leads her out of the rain and to his cozy home, where he tells her, "I will do anything to help you." When Lisara hears that, she suddenly embraces Ryosuke and......?!

t.r: Zense wa Kentei. Konjou Kuzu Ouji
t.e: Sword Emperor previous life, Prince Trash this life.
t.n: 前世は剣帝。今生クズ王子
t.u: Zense wa Kentei. Konjou Kuzu Ouji

sy: Previous Life was Sword Emperor, This Life is Trash Prince.
entries.d: He was called a Sword Emperor who lived for the sword and died by the sword. And his end was a tragedy. However, by strange coincidence, he was reincarnated as the third prince in a country. He was enjoying his lazy lifestyle away from swords and heroism. As a consequence, people began referring to him as Prince Trash.

Renowned for its exclusivity, only the children of Korea’s elite can attend International Island High. But when Kang Do-Ha, an ordinary girl from an average family, is given a lucky chance to enroll, she’s thrust into an unfamiliar world of money and power. Despite trying to fly under the radar, she somehow ends up in the same dorm as Rowoon, the most popular guy in school!

19 year old Reikan Yuuki moves into an apartment that's supposedly haunted by a female ghost. And sure enough, said ghost shows up at night to get rid of him, but instead of running away in fear he joyfully introduces himself to the puzzled ghost! After all, the only reason he moved in was to meet his fated (ghost) person!

t.r: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu Ex
t.e: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Ex
t.n: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活Ex
t.u: Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu Ex

sy: Re: Life in a different world from zero Ex
Re:Zero รีเซทชีวิต ฝ่าวิกฤตต่างโลก Ex
Re:Zero EX – Começando uma Vida em Outro Mundo
entries.d: The bestselling series from author Tappei Nagatsuki continues in this spin-off where some of your favorite characters capture the spotlight! (Source: Yen Press)

t.n: 魔法少女おりこ★マギカ

entries.d: Oriko, a magical girl with the gift of foresight, knows the fate that awaits all who accept Kyubey's offer of supernatural powers. But when she is struck with a terrible vision of the future-of the devastation caused by a single, powerful witch-she decides to prevent the girl from becoming a magical girl in the first place.

sy: Bloody Monday Season 2: Zetsubou no Kou
entries.d: Two years after the end of Bloody Monday, a new threat emerges intent on destroying Japan. But what will happen now that "Falcon" has since disappeared? Who will face the deadly "Shooter of the Magic Bullet"? (Source: MangaUpdate)
A wandering spirit searching for peace in the afterlife occupies himself with gristly "jobs" assigned to him by another ghost. (Source: JoJo's Bizarre Wiki)

t.r: Kyou kara Ore wa Loli no Himo!
t.n: 今日から俺はロリのヒモ!
t.u: Kyou kara Ore wa Loli no Himo!

sy: I'm Living off a Loli from Today!
Kyou kara Ore ha Loli no Himo!
entries.d: I, Tendou Haru, who was somehow aiming to become a mangaka, became a winner in life: super-rich bishoujo elementary school student, Nijou Touka, was a big fan of mine and, on top of that, she said that she was going to be my patron. Just like that, my ideal lifestyle of living off someone had started.

t.r: FAIRY TAIL & Nanatsu no Taizai Gassaku Manga
t.e: Fairy Tail x The 7 Deadly Sins Christmas Special
t.u: FAIRY TAIL & Nanatsu no Taizai Gassaku Manga

entries.d: A small holiday collaboration between Hiro Mashima and Nakaba Suzuki.

He was a boy. She was a robot. Well...not really. In all actuality, Marie is completely, totally, 100 percent human, but because her strange new employer seemingly despises humans, the powers-that-be are paying a handsome sum for her to pretend she's the latest and greatest android while protecting said eccentric master from the seemingly endless attempts on his life.

Witness the touching relationship between young vampiress Misaki and her human companion, the former vampire hunter turned investigative author, Kurose Kuroe, whom she'd die to protect. For recently turned vampire Minato Misaki, vampirism and the beastly powers that come with it are something that she wouldn't wish upon her worst enemy, let alone her beloved Kuroe.

t.e: The Roguish Guard in a Medieval Fantasy

sy: A Rogue Guard in a Medieval Fantasy
entries.d: In a brutal medieval world where innocence means life and guilt means death, Aron, captain of the castle guard, enforces order within the fortress. But when demons begin to corrupt men’s hearts, violent events erupt, including repeated attempts to assassinate the lady of the castle.

Once known as Mr. Perfect, MMA legend Sanghyuk Kang dies undefeated, only to be reborn as a nine year old young master in Murim. In a world without rules, where only strength decides life or death, he aims to become champion again. (Source: Toomics)

Ayano-san is a beautiful housewife with a son, Yuusei, who doesn't seem to approve of her carefree ways. Always smiling and well-meaning, Ayano-san still finds a way to make herself an object of curiosity and appreciation by passing people.

This is the first time Monkey Punch's original, classic series has been published in the U.S. International man of mystery and master thief extraordinaire, Lupin III comes from a long line of high stakes bandits, all committed to stealing from the rich and giving to themselves. Fortunately, Lupin tends to avoid robbing society's virtuous and, instead, targets some pretty shady characters.

For his art project Mikuriya Jin carved a statue from the recently chopped local sacred tree. As he is about to bring it to school, the goddess of the tree, Nagi, descends upon the statue, having slept until now, not knowing of her demise. Since the sacred tree can no longer protect the surrounding area from impurities, Nagi has to do it herself now, dragging poor Jin with her.

A story set in the near future, about a middle-aged loser whose only refuge is a virtual bishoujo game. Takurou, the main character, is a stereotyped, low self-esteem, adult male in a dead-end job. Because he feels he has nothing to live for, he let himself go, becoming fat, miserable, and lonely.

t.r: Sankaku no Kyori wa Kagirinai Zero
t.n: 三角の距離は限りないゼロ
t.u: Sankaku no Kyori wa Kagirinai Zero

entries.d: Yano Shiki, a boy who only shows a facade. Minase Akiha, a quiet and reserved transfer student. Minase Haruka, the other side of Akiha. This is their bizarre love story, one where the distance between them is limitless/zero.

t.r: Kimi no Na wa. Another Side: Earthbound
t.u: Kimi no Na wa. Another Side: Earthbound

entries.d: Mitsuha is a young girl living in a rural town named Itomori and is fed up with her life. One day, her family and friends notice she's suddenly acting strange. Little do they know, a high school boy from Tokyo named Taki Tachibana found himself randomly switching places with her when he fell asleep. But he has no clue how to act as a high school girl in an unfamiliar place!

t.n: おにいちゃん☆コントロール

entries.d: Noa's brother has a huge sister complex. So huge, he attends college in Tokyo just to escape it! Years later, his sister Noa shows up and informs him that she's taking the Tokyo University Entrance exam and that she may me moving to Tokyo as well. Little does Noa's brother know, she has a similarly huge brother complex.

Do you ever wonder what the most popular boy at school is really like? As it turns out, he might be just as awkward and shy as any of us. That’s what wallflower Ja-Yu Nam begins to discover after a chance encounter with Ja-Hyeok Yeo, a boy in her class who seems to excel at everything in life. Well, almost.

t.n: 偽りのマリィゴールド

entries.d: Kasumi Hana visits her late brother's pen pal, Urushizawa Lily, to inform her of his death. If she had been misleading her brother, she would have murdered Urushizawa Lily. However, Lily is a blind girl who genuinely cared about Hana's brother. For Lily's sake, Hana decides to become her brother.

Sequel to Tenkuu Shinpan. This series follows a different cast of characters and explores new areas. Senya is just an ordinary guy, who wanted to become an astronaut as a kid. One day and suddenly, he's transported into another world after seeing on the rooftop of his school something like a "tower" going across the sky.

Ayato Sanada, a serious first year student attending Okuma East High School, joins the photography club but one of it's members, a second year student named Kazuki Shindou, constantly distracts him with her embarrassing ideas and activities. How can he deal with such an uninhibited person?! Note: Includes two extras.

Haiba Sumio is a student at a Tokyo High School with an interesting ability... He occasionally falls asleep and wakes up with premonitions of the future written out on his "Dream Diary". With this ability, Sumio helps out people in trouble before anything bad happens, until one day when his peaceful life completely changes.

t.n: 宇宙海賊キャプテンハーロック

entries.d: Introducing Captain Harlock, the fiercely independent space pirate who fights totalitarianism in every corner of the Universe. When a mysterious alien force invades Earth, teenager Tadashi Daiba joins up with the only people brave enough to defend the planet: Captain Harlock and his ragtag crew of renegades!

A Virtual Reality game praised for its extreme difficulty. Hansung was once a top-tier ranker, but he got trapped inside the game! It’s hard to survive with his current stats. However, Hansung has a high level of luck! Obtaining SSS class skills from random boxes? That’s easy! Hitting the jackpot from the slot machine? A piece of cake! He is overflowing with luck!

Tightrope tells the tale of the reluctant heir of a yakuza family and his childhood friend, and follows their love relationship that started budding in their school days and keeps developing slowly but surely. Note: Includes the one-shot "Doushiyoumo Nai Keredo Returns" (どうしようもないけれどリターンズ).

t.r: Goshujin-sama to Kemonomimi no Shoujo Meru
t.n: ご主人様と獣耳の少女メル
t.u: Goshujin-sama to Kemonomimi no Shoujo Meru

sy: Goshujinsama to Kemonomimi no Shoujo Mel
entries.d: A story about a maid with animal ears and her mistress. Note: Includes the side story "Goshujinsama to Aki no Hi".

t.e: Why Are You Obsessed With Your Fake Wife?

entries.d: Nadia Valajit thought she had nothing more to lose until her family and fiancé betrayed her. After she finds herself thrust back in time prior to the events that ultimately led to her death, Nadia kicks off her plans for payback by marrying Glenn Winterpel, the icy marquess to the north and the Valajit family’s favorite punching bag.

t.n: 凛子ちゃんとひもすがら

entries.d: An elementary school girl is paying a young man to spend time with her so she isn't lonely anymore. Note: Includes four extra chapters.

t.n: マズ飯エルフと遊牧暮らし

sy: Mazu meshi Erufu to yūboku kurashi
Mazu Rice Elf and Nomadic Life
entries.d: Reborn in another world! But there's too much rice! The elves are cute and have a nice atmosphere, but I can't live as they do! With the cooking skills of a professional, I'll surprise the elves!! Cutting-edge!! Of a different world gourmet. Note: Includes 6 extra chapters.

t.e: This Time I Will Find Happiness!
t.n: 今度こそ幸せになります！

sy: This Time I Will Definitely Be Happy!
entries.d: Before the hero, Graham, goes on his journey to defeat the demon lord, he asks his beloved Louisa to promise to wait for his return. He is both her childhood friend and beau. Except, she has no intention of waiting for him at all. The truth is, she's been reincarnated three times, and all three times the heroes were always her childhood friend and boyfriend.

sy: "X" Method In The Dead Of Night
entries.d: Kamiya Hiroki always thought women had it easy. This thought was throttled by the fact that his 24-year-old sister does not work and plays games all day. Why couldn't he have it this easy? He wanted to become a woman and be lazy like his sister. After blogging about his rants about his sister online, a mysterious reader comments on his blog, stating that there are ways to swap bodies with others.

t.n: 君の涙を飲み干したい

sy: I Want to Drink Your Tears
entries.d: Kippei is a highschool boy feared for his mean look, but in reality, he's just a kind and gentle boy that cries a lot. Umegami is the beautiful and popular school idol, adored by many, however she also has a hidden side... One day, their fates unexpectedly intertwine when cry baby Kippei asks her out expecting to be rejected... A clumsy and unusual love story begins! (Source: Comikey)

t.n: 理想的ボーイフレンド

entries.d: "You're far from my ideal type and we hardly have any common features. From now on too, we won't get involved with each other that much." That was what I thought, about what kind of person you were.

Night, phenomena that were once known as natural disasters. Faced with the threat of inexplicable destruction, children offer their prayers in the form of dance in order to borrow the power of the gods, quell the Night's fury, and deliver the world from ruin.

Akamori Mitsuo wants to be an ordinary salaryman but... He is a genius murderer born into a family that has been practising the ancient art of killing for centuries. Akamori faces obstacles like Yakuza, fighters and gangs in the path that goes to his want. Note: The manga was cancelled after the author passed away.

Yukimi is her real name but everyone calls her Bambi. She is the student discipline committee member who locks students out of the school if they're a minute late, but sneaks cigarette breaks on the roof.

sy: Fullmetal Alchemist - A Terra da Areia
entries.d: The mining town of Xenotime has seen better days. Once renowned for its skilled goldsmiths, it now lies forgotten in a sea of sand, its mines empty and its fields barren. The townsfolk's only hope lies with the talented state alchemist Edward Elric and his brother, Alphonse. But who is the real Edward Elric?

t.r: Souzou Renkinjutsushi wa Jiyuu wo Ouka Suru: Furusato wo Tsuihou Saretara, Maou no Hizamoto de Chouzetsu Kouka no Magic Item Tsukuri Houdai ni Narimashita
t.n: 創造錬金術師は自由を謳歌する 故郷を追放されたら、魔王のお膝元で超絶効果のマジックアイテム作り放題になりました
t.u: Souzou Renkinjutsushi wa Jiyuu wo Ouka Suru: Furusato wo Tsuihou Saretara, Maou no Hizamoto de Chouzetsu Kouka no Magic Item Tsukuri Houdai ni Narimashita

entries.d: Thor Regus, a boy who lived in the empire, was banished to the territory of the Demon Lord by the hands of his father, the Duke. The reason was that he could only use [Alchemy] and didn’t have any combat skills. The empire was a military country, and those without combat skills were discriminated against. That is why the Empire decided to make him a hostage and sacrifice to the Demon Territory.

My wife seems very suspicious!! I don't understand why she would marry a guy like me!? Why would a beautiful, smart, and thoughtful woman like Yoshino be with the very ordinary Naotsugu!! There's no marriage blues here, just a suspicious case of marriage gray!!

t.r: Idol Yameru kedo Kekkon Shite Kuremasu ka!?
t.n: アイドル辞めるけど結婚してくれますか!?
t.u: Idol Yameru kedo Kekkon Shite Kuremasu ka!?

sy: Will You Marry Me If I Quit Being an Idol?
Will You Marry Me Because I Quit Being an Idol?
entries.d: Sato Itto is an ordinary salaryman who has been shy about love due to past trauma. One day, a school reunion is held for the first time in several years. While they are having a good time talking about the good old days, Hebo, a recently retired idol, suddenly shows up! Sato is upset to see Hebo, who was his first love in school.

t.e: My Cute Cousin Always Gets Her Way

entries.d: His more-than-friends, less-than-lovers cousin is so cute that he could die? Nozomu is a boy staying at his uncle's house over summer vacation. In the countryside, where there are no convenience stores, or any busses even, the boy has a problem. That problem is his younger cousin, Sou.

sy: How to Survive as the Devil's Child
Sobrevivendo Como a Herdeira do Mal
entries.d: Bliss has been endlessly reborn and forced to watch the world be destroyed at the hands of Lucas Brandt, king of the demon world. In her most recent life, she comes to... as a newborn baby lying right outside of Lucas' manor! Not only that, but she resembles Lucas so much that she could only be his daughter!

sy: Nukoduke! Diary of raising strange animals
entries.d: A pocket-sized cat-human: have you met a Nuko? In a world where these curious creatures evolved from ordinary cats, part-timer Yuya finds two abandoned nukos on the side of the road and brings them home out of the rain. Kei needs his ducks to be in a row, while Sasame charms everyone she meets.

Zhu Yunwen, who barely survived the Jingnan campaign received the souls of two of the world's strongest martial artists. The First Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Cult and Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of the Shaolin Temple in his body and was reborn as a Pacheon. This is where the story of the Heaven Destroyer's journey toward absolute supremacy begins! (Source: Naver, translated)

t.e: Hell Is Dark with No Flowers
t.n: 地獄くらやみ花もなき

sy: There is No Flower in Hell
Hell Is Dark with No Flowers
Keine Blumen im Dunkel der Hölle
entries.d: Seiji Tohno sometimes sees the people around him as monsters. It's a curse that has driven him to a life of despair...but all that changes one evening when he stumbles across a bewitchingly beautiful boy in a huge European mansion. The boy introduces himself as Shiroshi Saljou, and before he knows it, Seiji has agreed to become Shiroshi's part-time assistant.
Haru, a fun, lovable, easygoing guy, has a problem, he burnt his girlfriend to death along with 5 buildings with his bare hands. What will happen to this human torch?

sy: The Late Game Healer Is Way Too Strong
entries.d: Top Korean hunter Siu 'The Rabid Hound' Min defeated the Demon Lord with his disciples, only to be trapped in a monster-filled otherworld for 100 years. However, a century of struggles did not break Siu—it drove him to break his limits instead. Now, he returns to Earth with Pred, his mysterious partner, only to learn that his name and legacy have been erased, along with his disciples’...

t.n: いいんちょと不良くん

entries.d: Contrary to her appearance, Hatsuse Sakura is an idiot. Because of her, "honor student looks," she is appointed as the class president. To meet up to everyone's expectations, Sakura tries her hardest, however, for some reason since then Shinokura, who is rumored to be a delinquent, has been starting to approach her? The romance of two awkward people. Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.
Follows Kyoko Kirigiri's past of working as a detective with the 16 year old Yui Samidare.

Tista leads a dual life as the grim reaper of New York City and a university student studying to be a teacher. With extraordinary eyesight allowing her to make long-range shots with unrivaled accuracy, she has come to be feared by the criminal underground. Tista knows she’s doomed, but can her feelings for a young man she just met bring her back from the abyss?

Return to the world of Shaman King! Before the Shaman Fight, there were countless tales of heartache and worry as Yoh and the others worked their ways toward the tournament...and they're here in Shaman King: Zero! (Source: Kodansha USA) Note: Volume 1 contains a bonus chapter.

t.r: Ore no Kanojo to Osananajimi ga Shuraba Sugiru
t.n: 俺の彼女と幼なじみが修羅場すぎる
t.u: Ore no Kanojo to Osananajimi ga Shuraba Sugiru

entries.d: Eita enters high school aiming for the National University School of Medicine. Because of his parents' divorce--and his goal--he shuns anything to do with romance or love. One day Masuzu, the school beauty with the silver hair, who's just returned to the country, enters his life in a most unexpected way. Chiwa, his childhood friend since elementary school, will not let this go without a fight.

Mizuki Konno is your typical high school junior at Yanno Prefectural High School. Like many teens her age she is studying hard for college and when she has some down time she likes to fuss over fashion and make-up. While she may not be one of the class elites, Mizuki is fortunate to be on the right side of her class’s idols.

t.n: 押しかけギャルの中村さん

entries.d: Akiyama and Nakamura-san are polar opposites. As an easily flustered otaku, Akiyama can’t even imagine a world where an outgoing, flashy gal like Nakamura wants anything to do with him. But after she saves his life, she demands something unbelievable—to live with him! Proud, bold, and unafraid to show off her body, Nakamura is the perfect image of a gyaru.

A series of Naruto novels. Naruto's allies and enemies take center stage in these fast-paced adventures, which each volume focusing on a particular clanmate, ally, team...or villain. 1. Kakashi Hiden: Hyouten no Ikazuchi [Higashiyama Akira] The story revolves around Kakashi Hatake, who is melancholy despite his new position as the Sixth Hogake. 2.

t.n: シンデレラクロゼット

sy: Cinderella Closet - Debut into the New World
entries.d: Haruka is a “plain jane” who left the countryside to start her college life in Tokyo. She’s secretly in love with Kurotaki, a coworker at her part-time job, but she lacks the self-confidence to confess her feelings to him.

t.n: ガンバレッド×シスターズ

sy: เรดซิสเตอร์ X กระสุนเดือด
entries.d: In a decaying gothic city, warrior nun Dorothy is tasked with hunting down and slaughtering supernatural creatures. A member of the elite Crimson Sisters, she seeks to rid the city of the vampire population that plagues it. One fateful night, she encounters a wounded woman, Maria, only to discover that she has fangs and a strange parentage.

t.r: Akatsuki no Yona: Tsuki no Shita de
t.n: 暁のヨナ 同じ月の下で
t.u: Akatsuki no Yona: Tsuki no Shita de

sy: Akatsuki no Yona: Under the Same Moon
entries.d: The novel is divided into three segments: Jae-Ha’s Counseling Room – Part 1, Under the Same Moon – Parts 1-5, and Jae-Ha’s Counseling Room – Part 2. When listening to a nostalgic voice in the crowd of people, Soo-Won looked back without thinking. However, it was not the girl of his memory... Note: Chapter count includes the prologue chapter.

t.n: フルメタル・パニック!

entries.d: Sagara Sousuke isn't your typical high school student. He reads military enthusiast magazines; he responds to questions with "affirmative;" he brings grenades to school in his bag. Though everyone at school takes him for a hopeless military geek, Chidori Kaname thinks there might be something more to him.

t.r: Hazure Skill «Kinomi Master»: Skill no Mi (Tabetara Shinu) wo Mugen ni Taberareru You ni Natta Ken ni Tsuite
t.e: Bogus Skill <<Fruitmaster>> ~About that time I became able to eat unlimited numbers of Skill Fruits (that kill you)~
t.n: 外れスキル《木の実マスター》~スキルの実(食べたら死ぬ)を無限に食べられるようになった件について~
t.u: Hazure Skill «Kinomi Master»: Skill no Mi (Tabetara Shinu) wo Mugen ni Taberareru You ni Natta Ken ni Tsuite

entries.d: Light has obtained a bogus skill known as “Fruitmaster”, a skill that specializes in the cultivation of fruits. Weighed down by the vast difference between him and his childhood friend who became an S-Rank adventurer, he spends his days working the farm and practicing his swordsmanship.

sy: The Rebirth Of The Demon God
entries.d: The Almighty Demon Lord, Resurrected!: The once-reigning demon lord, Lord Shitian, was betrayed by his confidantes during his critical ascension to become a demon saint. With the combined powers of the Five Benevolent Sects, the demon lord was vanquished. Just when the world thought it was rid of the demon lord, he reincarnates into the body of the disciple Mo Fan.

While Ice Age is approaching, after being killed by the girl i had a crush on, I was reborn and gained a magical ability. Snacks I ate suddenly turned into plants? Surprisingly, this ability can still be used in other ways too?!... With crises looming, I'll live for myself in this life! (Source: Webnovel)

Undertaker by day, biker by night, Kaido Wataru dreams of one day riding at an unsurpassed speed. But the moment he finally reaches 300 kmh, a terrible accident sends him into a 3-year coma. When Wataru awakes, he finds that the Japan he once knew is long gone. Now followed by an otherworldly creature and equipped with a mysterious transplanted eye, Wataru embarks on his very own road movie...

The long-lasting war between the Northern and the Southern Kingdoms is unbearable. So the northern Prince Johane and the southern Princess Euda decide to tell everyone they are in love, because their marriage can stop the war. But the truth is they don’t get along at all!

Kinnikuman (a.k.a. Kinniku Suguru) is a cowardly, clumsy, moronic, gyuudon-devouring excuse for a superhero (or Choujin)... who just happens to be the prince of an alien planet. But despite his pathetic appearance, he is very honorable and can become quite powerful when he needs to be.

t.r: Uragiri wa Boku no Namae wo Shitteiru
t.n: 裏切りは僕の名前を知っている
t.u: Uragiri wa Boku no Namae wo Shitteiru

entries.d: Abandoned as a baby and raised in an orphanage, the kind-hearted high-schooler Yuki Sakuragi is driven by a need to find the reason for his existence. Plagued by mysterious dreams, Yuki also possesses the strange ability to read the deepest, darkest thoughts of anyone he touches.

The hunks at Hanamaru Academy are putting the boot (and booty!) to expectations. Instead of wearing drab blazers, these studs are obsessed with the length of their skirts and the size of their chests as they try to navigate high school. This high-energy comedy takes being cute and being cut to a whole new level! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment) Includes 2 bonus chapters.

t.r: Murabito Tensei: Saikyou no Slow Life
t.n: 村人転生 最強のスローライフ
t.u: Murabito Tensei: Saikyou no Slow Life

entries.d: God messed up. I reincarnated. Born in a countryside village, I’m surrounded by beautiful imoutos and a childhood friend who’s a girl. No electricity and no water, this’ll be the ultimate slow life! Helping with farm work and animals, and yet my house turned into a huge shop where female adventurers happen to come around! Today is also very busy for me. This is the story of my slow life.

t.n: 伊藤くんは恋を知らない。

entries.d: The new transfer student, Itou Kazuki, comes with a secret, hidden behind his bandage... When Itou-kun, clueless in love, meets Yoshiuchi Aika, clumsy romantic, what will become of this unconventional couple?

A young man who discovers he can have out of body experiences, which he uses at first to have fun but quickly leads him to discover that his life isn't what he thought it was, and people he knows have lives he never imagined. And then he meets this girl who has the same power and much more control...

t.r: Koushinchou no Kouhai (♀) to Teishinchou no Senpai (♂) ga Renai ni Hatten suru made
t.n: 高身長の後輩（女）と低身長の先輩（男）が恋愛に発展するまで
t.u: Koushinchou no Kouhai (♀) to Teishinchou no Senpai (♂) ga Renai ni Hatten suru made

entries.d: A younger, tall, conceited female kouhai doing as she pleases towards her short senpai! A senpai who is teased about his height and treated as a kid...but unexpectedly shows a manly side of him! Will their relationship develop into romance...?
“Asako” depicts the relationship between an 11-year-old boy living in a seaside fishing village, Masashi Aoshima, and a mysterious beauty, Asako, who came to stay at his guest house from Tokyo.

A new highschool student with a complex about her height - Tsubame. Being unathletic and clumsy she seeks to join a cultural club, and despite her height she gives off the persona of a small and shy girl. Enter her upperclassman, Ibis, a small girl with a big presence, who suddenly invites her to the basketball club?! Note: Originally published as a one-shot.

Ukai Zero saves three troubled teens from a Suicide Website, and together chooses to work as 'Robin Hoods' of society. However, one of Zero's friends are caught by an organization he got in trouble with, and Zero is forced to enter a gambling competition hosted by a rich, rotten old man who is looking for talented gamblers to be his rep player. The reward money? ONE TRILLION YEN.

Namiji Ogawa is a high school student who teaches himself oil painting every day in order to draw the ultimate nude. After an encounter with a certain "witch", the goal is to take the entrance exam to Tokyo University of the Arts...!?

sy: How to Survive as a Wandering Knight
entries.d: After dying due to an unexpected accident, Kim Yohan reincarnated as Johann Aitz of the prestigious Aitz Family. He may have been born a noble, but Johann Aitz ranks at the very bottom of the family hierarchy. To make matters worse, this world revolves around a ruthless medieval society.

t.r: Watashi no Koto Suki ja Nakatta no ka yo!?
t.n: 私のこと好きじゃなかったのかよ!?
t.u: Watashi no Koto Suki ja Nakatta no ka yo!?

entries.d: Okabe vowed to focus on his studies in high school, but for whatever reason, the girls around him keep sending him mixed signals… (Source: MANGA Plus)

sy: I Was Reincarnated as a Baby Fox God
entries.d: With a warm family that showered her with love, Iyanelle’s life was a bed of roses. That is, until the day she found herself bleeding out on the ground beside her dead father. The culprit? Her beloved brother, Crown Prince Agris de Roahim. Heartbroken and betrayed, Iyanelle could only accept her impending death.

t.r: Touhou Bougetsushou: Silent Sinner in Blue
t.n: 東方儚月抄 ~ Silent Sinner in Blue
t.u: Touhou Bougetsushou: Silent Sinner in Blue

entries.d: One of the manga that take place in the Touhou series (mainly known for the games by Team Shanghai Alice). Taking place between part 10 and 10.5 of the doujin game series, Silent Sinner in Blue follows Yukari Yakumo as she prepares Reimu for a new threat originating from the Lunarian capital of Gensokyo's moon.

t.r: Dekiru Neko wa Kyou mo Yuuutsu
t.e: The Masterful Cat Is Depressed Again Today
t.n: デキる猫は今日も憂鬱
t.u: Dekiru Neko wa Kyou mo Yuuutsu

sy: Mon chat à tout faire est encore déprimé
Mèo siêu đỉnh hôm nay lại buồn thinh
entries.d: When Saku took in a stray black cat, she never expected that he would become the equivalent of a housekeeping life partner. But Yukichi, a giant cat who towers over Saku, is not your ordinary feline. He takes great pride in his culinary skills, and a good sale at the supermarket always gets his whiskers twitching. Saku may not have her act together yet, but at least she has Yukichi!

Cohabitating can make or break any relationship, but with a little luck, a lot of love, and a healthy dose of patience, living together can bring out the best in a couple! There’s a lot to navigate—clashing personalities, age gaps, business trips, conflicting feelings, jealousy, sex, and even the supernatural—but these women in love find a way to make it work!

t.r: Shin Seiki Evangelion: Koutetsu no Girlfriend 2nd
t.n: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン 鋼鉄のガールフレンド2nd
t.u: Shin Seiki Evangelion: Koutetsu no Girlfriend 2nd

sy: Neon Genesis Evangelion: Girlfriend of Steel 2
entries.d: In this alternate retelling of Neon Genesis Evangelion everything is different. Shinji and Asuka have grown up together as childhood friends, Rei is the new kid at school, Misato is their teacher, NERV is just beginning to assemble teenagers for their experiments, and the second impact never happened. The story proceeds as a romance rather than an action series, with love triangles a-plenty.

sy: Admission Is a Waste of Time
entries.d: Ban Yuwon just wanted to get into college. But instead, he was summoned to an academy in another dimension. There, every student must climb the legendary Tower of Babel, built by Yuwon's own ancestor. Armed with the "Babylonian Code," an ability that lets him absorb and manipulate all languages, he sets out to conquer the tower and reclaim his family’s lost honor.

t.e: It Was a Mistake, Grand Duke!

sy: Grand Duke, It Was a Mistake!
entries.d: Vivian Louis is the twenty-one-year-old daughter of a Count, a sweet and seemingly harmless girl who has only one guilty pleasure in life: thirsting after her crush, the breathtakingly handsome Grand Duke Lennox Elphidion Glenn! For her, it was love at first sight at the tender age of fourteen. That’s when she began obsessing over him, creating endless works of fan art and fan fiction.

t.e: Immortal Lord Reborns In The City

entries.d: He was the paragon of cultivation, on the verge of immortality, but instead he abused his sect's ultimate technique to reverse time, back to his life in the city! This time, he will right his wrongs and make up for all of his past regrets. This time, he will have wealth, power, and women! (Source: Tencent, translated) Note: Main storyline was completed with 414 chapters on 2023-09-27.

t.n: 放課後ビッチクラフト

entries.d: Ririka Kirise’s a style-savvy high school girl who’s struggling to keep up in her chemistry class. Looking for some extra help, she opens the door to her teacher’s office—breaking his magic barrier in the process! Unbeknownst to Ririka, Renji is actually a sorcerer…and Ririka has the makings of a sorceress herself.

Ken, a modern age chef, finds himself in back in the 16th century during the warring states period. Lacking any recollection of who he once was or how he arrived to such a time, he only has his knowledge and skills in cooking to rely on. But as he gains reputation for his incredible food, who else would come to demand his services than Oda Nobunaga himself.

sy: En un Rincón del Cielo Nocturno
Dans un coin de ciel nocturne
In a corner of the Night Sky
entries.d: Hoshino is a timid grade school teacher. Sudou was one year his senior in high school. They meet again for the first time in over a decade and discover that Sudou's son is Hoshino's student. The two of them try to figure out how they feel about each other, and try to remember what it was that had brought them together and ultimately drove them apart in high school.

Mitsumine High School is known as the school with the most juvenile delinquents in the country. The students are so violent that even the teachers are scared for their lives. Sunahara is the leader of the first years and is the strongest dude of his class.

t.n: 交響詩篇エウレカセブン

entries.d: Renton Thurston is a young 14-year-old who is tired of his monotonous life. The only thing that makes him happy is when he "lifts", an extreme form of aerial hoverboarding.

t.r: Otaku no Tonari wa Elf Desu ka?
t.e: Does a Hot Elf Live Next Door to You?
t.n: おたくの隣りはエルフですか？
t.u: Otaku no Tonari wa Elf Desu ka?

sy: Otaku no Tonari wa ERUFU Desuka?
Does an Elf Live Next Door to You?
entries.d: The year is 202X, and Japan has entered an age of inter-isekai exchange thanks to its light novel and manga industry! Inudou Keita is a high school student living on his own and working to become a top mangaka. When the nerdy, knightly (and cringy) high elf Surt moves next door, will she blast him sky-high for disrespecting elvenkind in his latest manga, or are other sparks going to fly?!

The year is 20XX... A time when every household owns cute maid robots known as OrderMaids. Average grade-schooler Bondo dreams of having his very own robot. But what he got was... Unable to compute!!! Life is gonna get a whole lot weirder when Roboco, the most powerful clumsy maid ever created, shows up at his door! (Source: MANGA Plus)

There was once a high school band whose pop songs warmed and thrilled the hearts of all who listened. Now, three girls have been inspired to start a pop music club of their own, but will things turn out like they hope? It’s a new generation of slice-of-life hijinks from kakifly, the original author of K-ON! (Source: Yen Press)

t.n: 制服のヴァンピレスロード

entries.d: Normal high school girl Irie Yuunagi suddenly has her blood sucked by a strange man one night. Yuunagi wakes up as a vampire and learns that she has been added to the man who bit her, Rin's, family. She begins to learn about the rules of the vampire world from Rin.

Hanmi told a lie on the first day of her new school just to get Lee Gun to notice her. But her shallow plan backfired and now everyone thinks she's dating Junhyuk...her actual cousin! (Source: Lezhin)

t.r: Nejimaki Seirei Senki: Tenkyou no Alderamin
t.n: ねじ巻き精霊戦記 天鏡のアルデラミン
t.u: Nejimaki Seirei Senki: Tenkyou no Alderamin

entries.d: The Katjvarna Empire and the Kioka Republic are at war, and Katjvarna is currently defending their border against Kioka's attacks. Yatorishino is from an influential family in the empire, and she's taking the high ranking officer exams.

sy: ID ของฉันคือดอกไม้พลาสติก Beauty Newbie
entries.d: A new school, new friends, new romance, and a new face?! After going through major plastic surgery, freshman Mirae is ready for a fresh start. At her university, she becomes recognized as a pretty yet somewhat unnatural “Gangnam beauty.” However, all Mirae wants is to have a normal campus life without being judged by her looks.

Decades ago, a being known as the Giant of Light joined together with Shin Hayata of the Science Special Search Party to save Earth from an invasion of terrifying monsters called Kaiju. Now, many years later, those dark days are fading into memory, and the world is at peace.

After ingesting an illegal drug that makes her hunger for blood, Finé Hera makes a pact with a beautiful but wolfish Red Riding Hood. Iris Redhood offers herself up to help Finé slake her bloodlust, but her…services come with a price. Now, the two are narcotics officers on the hunt for the very drug that changed Finé! (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

t.r: Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan
t.e: Today's Menu for the Emiya Family
t.n: 衛宮さんちの今日のごはん
t.u: Emiya-san Chi no Kyou no Gohan

entries.d: TYPE-MOON's Fate/ series is renowned for its unique take on the fantasy genre. But in Today's Menu for the Emiya Family, instead of experiencing the fantasy and lore of Fate/, we are invited into the Emiya family home to dine with Shiro, Saber, Rin, Taiga and more. So enough talking (and fighting)―Emiya, what's for dinner?!

This manga is about the job of cleaning up scenes of death, and discusses the meaning of life and death. Through interactions between the deceased's family and friends with the death sweepers, we understand the meaning of death. No matter is it is a peaceful death at the ends of one's life, murder, suicide, death from illnesses, when death comes, who would be able to predict it, or prevent it?

t.n: ヴァンパイア騎士〈ナイト〉 memories

entries.d: After a fierce battle between humans and vampires, a temporary peace was established, but Kaname continued to sleep within a coffin of ice… Yuki gave Kaname her heart to revive him as a human being. These are the stories of what happened during those 1,000 years of Kaname’s slumber and at the start of his human life. (Source: VIZ Media)

sy: I say "I love you" now! Senpai!
entries.d: Koharu’s has lived her young life by her mother’s motto: a good woman never gets rejected. But when the most popular guy in school turns her down before she even gets the words out, her whole world comes crashing down … until she realizes, if she just keeps confessing, she’ll never get rejected!

t.n: 12BEAST トゥエルヴ ビースト

entries.d: Eita Touga, a seemingly normal high school student, is secretly the heir apparent to a distinguished line of ninja. Unfortunately for the Touga Clan, Eita has no interest in taking over the family business. More interested in the virtual reality of video games than real life, Eita has sequestered himself to a life of digital bliss.

Arata, a member of the photography club, and Shotaro, a member of the basketball club, are childhood friends. The photos of Shotaro that Arata takes are very popular with girls. While Shotaro continues to turn down confessions almost every day, Arata continues to hide his own feelings for Shotaro. Then one day, Shotaro tells Arata that there's someone he likes...

t.n: 心霊写真師 鴻野三郎

entries.d: Saburou, a mysterious man who specializes in spirit photography, becomes the tenant of a room where a malicious ghost is said to appear.

Se-Jun and Se-Wa are siblings with a dark, complex relationship. Se-Wa, a girl considered psychotic by others, is attached to her brother... a little too attached. In her eyes, there is only Se-Jun, and no one else. And what of Se-Jun's feelings?

sy: The Delusional Hunter in Another World
The Hunter of the Other World Who Is Being Misunderstood
被誤認為S級的異世界獵人
entries.d: Gi-ryeo has a secret: he's really an alien from another world! As High Wizard of the planet Alpha Uri, Gi-ryeo slaved away day in and day out working his soul crushing job. But, after perfecting his transmigration magic, Gi-ryeo escapes into the body of a starved Hunter on Earth.

t.n: みゆちゃんはずっと友達

sy: Miyu-chan Will Always Be Your Friend
entries.d: During the summer of his second year in high school, Yuushin Tahara’s childhood friend, Miyu Fukagawa, moves back into the house next door after being away for a while. Miyu has grown up to be very cute, but she seems a bit strange somehow... (Source: ComicWalker, translated)

t.r: Uchi no Hentai Maid ni Osowareteru
t.n: うちの変態メイドに襲われてる
t.u: Uchi no Hentai Maid ni Osowareteru

sy: My Hentai Maid is Assaulting Me
My Pervert Maid is Attacking Me
entries.d: Spring has come. Haruto, now fully fledged university student can live in an apartment independently, but his father suddenly sent him a "maid" because he was worried about his living conditions. The maid who came to his apartment is a huge pervert. With her erotic behavior and dirty mind, the adolescent boy is assaulted by her every day.

Being a teenager is never easy… especially for a centaur! Himeno is a sweet, shy girl, who like many teens her age, struggles with the trials and tribulations of attending high school. The difference is she’s a centaur; but she’s not alone. In fact, all of her classmates are supernatural creatures, sporting either horns, wings, tails, halos, or some other unearthly body appendage.

t.e: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads

sy: The Male Leads Trapped in My House
entries.d: After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she’s determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters.

t.n: ツバサ WoRLD CHRoNiCLE ニライカナイ編

sy: TSUBASA WoRLD CHRoNiCLE - Thánh Địa Linh Hồn
entries.d: Sequel of Tsubasa RESERVoir CHRoNiCLE. It will also tie with xxxHOLiC Rei. It was announced that the sequel will be published in short period.

Dreams come and go, but this nightmare is here to stay. A-Reum keeps a note to keep track of her dreams and premonitions, which, to her horror, oftentimes become true. One day, she discovers a set of pages she doesn’t remember writing, and that’s when all hell breaks out in her school. Can she piece the broken parts of her dream together and survive the terror that lurks in the dark?

In a world swarming with yokai demons... One day, mediocre exorcist Kazami encounters a beautiful girl named Paira. But who is she?! And could the seemingly useless Kazami actually have a special ability? Get ready for a new generation of yokai battle comedy manga! (Source: MANGA Plus) Note: Includes the epilogue.

Chen Beiming, a young member of the Star Alliance, was assassinated under the order of the Five Emperors. Unexpectedly, his soul went back to the past of 10 years ago, granting him the chance to change his destiny, as well as to take his revenge on those who was behind his death. (Source: Webnovel)

t.r: Kimi wa Mada Torikago no Naka
t.u: Kimi wa Mada Torikago no Naka

sy: You are Still in a Bird Cage
Kimi wa Mada Tori Kago no Naka
entries.d: Amane and Madoka had been friends since middle school, but even though Amane had hidden feelings for her friend, something completely changed their lives.

Born twelve years apart, siblings Koshiro and Nanoka were separated when their parents divorced and moved to different parts of Japan; as a result, they both grew up hardly aware of the other's existence. The story begins when 15-year-old Nanoka moves to Tokyo to live with her father and brother, the latter being 27 years old and employed by a marriage-arranging company.

A love triangle is never straightforward! As long-time best friends, Jin-Geon has always been there to listen to Hui-Seo ramble about his latest crushes -- and cry about his most recent heartbreaks. So when Hui-Seo asks Jin-Geon to fill in for him at work and make sure no one steals away the adorable coworker he’s been eyeing, Jin-Geon readily agrees.

t.r: Gokufuri Kyohi shite Tesaguri Start!: Tokka shinai Healer, Nakama to Wakarete Tabi ni Deru
t.n: 極振り拒否して手探りスタート！　特化しないヒーラー、仲間と別れて旅に出る
t.u: Gokufuri Kyohi shite Tesaguri Start!: Tokka shinai Healer, Nakama to Wakarete Tabi ni Deru

entries.d: Many people suddenly find themselves in a white, empty space, where a God-like figure tells them that they are to be reincarnated and sent to an isekai known as Tesla. They are given a limited number of points to spend in various attributes, such as their race and abilities, which will determine their reincarnation into Tesla.

t.r: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka
t.e: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle
t.n: 千歳くんはラムネ瓶のなか
t.u: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka

sy: Chitose-kun is Inside a Ramune Bottle
entries.d: “After all, death is better than an unbeautiful life.” Saku Chitose is living the good life. He’s got his friends, his harem of hotties, and his haters. What more could he ask for? However...his reputation as a problem-solver may be more trouble than it’s worth. So when a teacher saddles him with the task of bringing a shut-in back to school, it’s not like he can just brush it off. But no sweat!

t.n: モネさんのマジメすぎるつき合い方

sy: Mone-san's Overly Serious Way of Dating
entries.d: An alluring and popular honor student who goes by the name of Mone. Steadfast and diligent, she only has one foreseeable flaw; her philosophy on love is utterly trash! But both her mind and her heart might be swayed sooner than she thinks in this school love manga. Includes 9 bonus chapters.

Nito is living a quiet high school life while taking care of his disabled grandpa, but thanks to an encounter with a schoolmate striving to be a pro female MMA fighter, his life is about to flip. Sometimes, you just have to fight! This serious MMA story is an all-out battle! (Source: MANGA Plus)

t.n: 異世界迷宮でハーレムを

sy: Slave Harem in the Labyrinth of the Other World
Isekai Meikyuu De Dorei Harem wo
entries.d: A man was about to commit suicide and decides to search for a way to die in the internet, but then he found an odd site that asked a lot of questions and had a point based system that allows you to create skills and abilities for a character.

sy: Today's Han Yoil Is a Woman
entries.d: Sang-Hyeon Kim has the talent and the drive to become a K-pop star—but one thing keeps holding him back: a false school bullying accusation. After countless rejections, his dream feels more distant than ever.

t.r: Shimekiri Mae ni wa Yuri ga Hakadoru
t.u: Shimekiri Mae ni wa Yuri ga Hakadoru

sy: Making Progress on Yuri Before the Deadline
entries.d: Ayu Shirakawa left the countryside and set off for Tokyo. There, her cousin Miyako Shirakawa introduced her to the popular author, Hikari Kairou, and it was decided that she would work for her as both her caretaker, and as a warden. This is just the ordinary love story about how a lonely person became not alone.

Dinosaurs are alive! In 1946, a remote island was discovered where dinosaurs never went extinct. Through breeding and genetic manipulation, dinosaur populations increased and dino-mania reached a fever pitch worldwide…until a certain terrible incident occurred. Afterward, dinosaur reserves like Enoshima Dinoland fell on hard times. Enter Suma Suzume, a kindhearted rookie dino-keeper!

Accepting the post of Royal Tutor at the court of the king of Grannzreich, Heine Wittgenstein is a little professor with a big job ahead! Each of the kingdom's four princes has a rather distinct personality. Does their diminutive new instructor have what it takes to lay down some learning? It's a comedy of educational proportions! (Source: Yen Press)

High school student Yang Ming is a typical underachiever. He gets into fights, skips class, and cheats on his schoolwork. When the school flower confronts him, he feels ashamed and wants to change, but he has fallen too far behind. However, by a stroke of fate, he ends up gaining a pair of contacts that allow him to change his visual perspective, completely altering the course of his future!

t.e: The Secret Life of Empress Isana

sy: The Moon Witch and the Sun King: My Salvation
entries.d: College student "Sa-Na" wakes up in the Body of "Isana Castilla" of the Titan Empire, sentenced to burn at the stake for practicing witchcraft! A chance encounter with Ludwig, the Crown Prince leads her on a path to become Empress, as she embarks on a journey to help the now Emperor combat evil rivals! What lies in store for the new Empress and her little secret?

t.n: 人狼ゲーム ビーストサイド

entries.d: In this game, there are 12 players with 3 werewolves - all from the same school again. There's a diviner again, along with a new position- the bodyguard, who can protect a player per night against the werewolves.

As a child Sakura Mamiya mysteriously disappeared in the woods behind her grandma's home. She returned whole and healthy, but since then she has had the power to see ghosts. Now a teenager, she just wishes the ghosts would leave her alone! At school, the desk next to Sakura's has been empty since the start of the school year.

sy: .hack//La leyenda del brazalete de la oscuridad
entries.d: Welcome to The World, the most advanced online game ever created. In The World you can be anyone you want to be, act out your adventure fantasies and through teamwork and determination, you can even become a hero.

Himoto Sora is a transfer student with a sense of justice and dreams of becoming a knight. Upon arriving at Utopia Gakuen, she learns of a virtual reality-like game played by the male students in which they use girls as weapons in battles for status and treat them as commodities.

Yu-Jeong Seo is a hardworking tattooist who loves nothing more than to eat good food while reading her favorite novel during her downtime. One particular day, she is doing exactly that when she suddenly hears a strange voice coming from outside her apartment. She steps out to see what’s going on but loses her footing and falls down a flight of stairs.

t.e: The Price of a Broken Engagement
